note: Weighty noun, used of nations and institutions as well as people: 建立友谊 · 深厚的友谊 · 友谊赛 friendly match. 友情 is more literary-personal, 交情 the casual 'we go back'.
The pleasant kind of cool: 天气凉快 · 屋里挺凉快. Also works as a verb, cool off: 凉快凉快 · 到树下凉快一下. Food that has gone cold is 凉了, never 凉快.
Written-register 怎么/怎么样. Before a verb: 如何解决 · 该如何是好. Sentence-final assessment: 你看如何？ Fixed: 无论如何 in any case.
In the PRC this is your spouse, husband or wife alike, and sounds like the older generation. In Taiwan/HK it reads as lover instead. Younger mainlanders say 老公/老婆/对象.
Two senses: bad-sounding (唱得难听 · 声音难听) and offensive to hear — 他把话说得很难听 he put it very harshly. Same frame as 难看 · 难闻 · 难吃.
V-O compound that wants a place: 去老师家做客 · 到朋友家做客 · 在他家做了几天客. You are the guest; the host's side of it is 请客/招待.
V-O compound, so the person invited cannot follow it: 我请客 I'm paying · 今天我请你吃饭, not 请客你. 我请 alone works too: 这顿我请.
A court or field, not a stadium building: 篮球场 · 足球场 · 网球场 · 进球场. The big stadium itself is 体育场; an indoor arena is 体育馆.
An organized evening programme with performances: 举办晚会 · 联欢晚会 · 迎新晚会 · 春节联欢晚会 (春晚). A private party at someone's flat is 聚会/派对.
Adverb pointing back at something just mentioned: 从中学到经验 · 从中受益 · 从中吸取教训. Also 'in between': 从中调解 mediate · 从中作梗 obstruct.
Takes an abstract result as object, above all 作用: 起到…的作用 · 起到重要作用 · 起到了很好的效果. Slightly more formal than plain 起作用.
Cover term for public holidays plus days off, mostly in notices and official talk: 节假日期间 · 节假日照常营业 · 法定节假日. Your own time off is 假期/放假.
In everyday mainland speech this is the e-bike or scooter you 骑: 骑电动车 · 电动车充电. An electric car is usually 电动汽车 or 新能源车, and you 开 that.
Colloquial and northern; a verb phrase follows directly: 没法儿专心 · 这事儿没法办 · 没法儿比. The neutral equivalent 没办法 can also stand alone as a whole reply.
Separable V-O: 聊聊天儿 · 聊了半天天儿 · 我们聊了一会儿. The person you chat with goes after 跟/和 — 跟他聊天儿 — not after the verb.
The reading passage inside a lesson, not the book: 念课文 · 背课文 · 预习课文 · 第三课的课文. The book itself is 课本/教材.
Public square: 天安门广场 · 在广场上 · 广场舞 the square-dancing older women do. Also the -Plaza in mall names (万达广场).
Written register, the word of reviews and news: 一部影片 · 影片上映 · 故事片. In speech you say 电影, or 片子 for the really casual version.
For things and organizations, never a person: 公司名称 · 产品名称 · 名称变更. A person's is 名字/姓名; how you address them is 称呼.
Counts years elapsed since an event, so a number comes first: 成立十周年 · 结婚五周年 · 周年纪念 · 建校百周年. A person's age uses 岁.
Only for groups of people, usually right before the noun: 全体员工 · 全体师生 · 全体起立 · 全体通过. Things and amounts take 全部; a thing viewed as one unit is 整体.
Also attributive for anything that stands out: 明星产品 · 明星企业 · 明星球员. Chasing them is 追星; 影星/歌星/球星 name the field.
Neutral term for someone in trade: 富商 · 精明的商人. 生意人 is the colloquial equivalent, 企业家 the flattering one; 商家 is the shop or vendor side.
Housing as a resource or policy issue, not a building you point at: 住房问题 · 住房条件 · 住房公积金 · 改善住房. The concrete thing is 房子.
Surname + 太太 = Mrs Wang (王太太); with a possessive it means wife — 他太太 · 我太太, polite and very common in TW/HK. 老婆 is casual, 妻子 formal/written.
Lives in wishes and reassurance: 一路平安 · 平平安安 · 平安到家 · 报个平安 let them know you're safe · 平安夜 Christmas Eve. For low-risk safe use 安全.
On-the-job training in your future field: 在医院实习 · 实习生 · 实习期 · 实习教师. 见习 is its stiffer twin; 练习 is drilling a skill, unrelated.
Means both the field and the practitioner: 看中医 see a TCM doctor · 学中医 · 中医认为… . The herbal medicine itself is 中药. 西医 works the same way.
Locative — takes verbs of existence or motion: 天上有几朵云 · 从天上掉下来 · 飞在天上. 天空 is the sky as something described (天空很蓝). Stock line: 天上不会掉馅饼.
Time word used bare before the verb: 半夜醒了 · 半夜起来. 大半夜的 (with a complaint in it) · 半夜三更 in the dead of night · 前/后半夜. Exact midnight is 午夜.
Separable: 爬了两个小时山 · 爬过那座山. 去爬山 is what Chinese says where English says going hiking; the serious mountaineering sense is 登山.
Said to someone setting off, not about your own trip: 祝你一路顺风. 一路平安 is the all-purpose version (some avoid 顺风 for flights); 一帆风顺 wishes a venture well.
Coverage of every aspect: 全面发展 · 全面了解 · 全面提高. Also adverbial in official language: 全面推进 · 全面禁止. 全部 is quantity, 全面 is coverage.
The two sides of an interaction, as subject or attributive: 双方同意 · 双方家长 · 男女双方 · 中美双方. More than two is 各方/多方; the other side from where you stand is 对方.
Mostly attributive: 商业区 · 商业模式 · 商业价值 · 商业化. 商务 is business-as-dealings (商务舱, 商务谈判); 生意 is the everyday business you 做.
Life's work, not a day job: 事业有成 · 事业心 drive · 干一番事业 · 教育事业. 工作 is the job, 职业 the profession. 事业单位 is the public-institution category.
Making art or writing: 创作歌曲 · 文学创作 · 创作灵感 · 创作了一部小说. 创造 is creating in general (创造条件/价值/纪录); 制作 is producing or manufacturing.
Officialese for setting an activity going; the object is abstract: 开展工作 · 开展活动 · 开展调查 · 开展合作. Also intransitive — 工作开展得很顺利.
Announcement and news register for 去, and a destination must follow: 前往上海 · 前往现场 · 请前往三号登机口. In conversation you would just say 去.
A praise word for technology or for people singled out for merit: 先进技术 · 先进设备 · 达到世界先进水平 · 先进个人 model worker. Its opposite here is 落后.
Reserved for the monumental: 伟大的祖国 · 伟大的领袖 · 伟大的事业 · 母爱是伟大的. For 'that's great' in daily talk use 太棒了/了不起.
Attributive or predicate: 合法权益 · 合法收入 · 这么做不合法 · 合法化. Same family: 合理 reasonable · 合适 suitable · 合格 up to standard.
A senior guiding a junior: 指导工作 · 指导老师 supervisor · 在老师的指导下 · 请多指导 (modest). Peer help is 帮助; classroom teaching is 教.
Adjective and transitive verb both: 明确的目标 · 态度很明确, and 明确责任 · 明确分工 spell out who does what · 明确表示/指出 state in no uncertain terms.
The carrier is the subject, the abstract quality the object: 体现了人民的意志 · 体现出他的水平 · 充分体现 · 体现在细节上. 反映 mirrors a fact; 体现 embodies a value.
News and sports register: 一名女子 (police reports) · 女子单打 women's singles · 女子组. In speech it's 女的/女人; 妇女 is the institutional word (妇女节).
With a noun, fight to get: 争取时间 · 争取机会 · 争取支持. With a verb phrase, aim to: 争取明天完成 · 争取考上. 力争 is the emphatic version.
Spread of something intangible or contagious: 传播疾病 · 传播文化/知识 · 谣言迅速传播 · 广泛传播. Also the field name: 新闻传播学 media studies.
Sits before the predicate or opens the clause: 他显然不知道 · 显然，这行不通 · 很显然. It judges a whole statement, not a noun. Chengyu twin: 显而易见.
Intensity of feeling, light or shock: 强烈要求 · 强烈反对 · 强烈的愿望 · 强烈的阳光 · 强烈地震. Physical strength is 强/强大; wind and rain just take 大.
Formal 'work in'; the object is a field, often ending in 工作/行业/研究: 从事贸易工作 · 从事教育 · 从事科研. CV and bio language — day to day you'd say 做.
The thing seen as one indivisible unit: 一个整体 · 整体水平 · 从整体上看 · 整体而言 on the whole. 全体 is all the people; 全部 is all the items.
Beyond 'concept': 对…没(有)概念 = have no feel for it, 我对一亿这个数字没概念. Also 基本概念 · 概念不清 · 偷换概念 shift the goalposts · 炒概念 hype.
Officialese for driving a process along: 推进改革 · 推进项目 · 稳步推进 · 工作正在推进中. Also literal advance (部队向前推进). Pushing an object is plain 推.
Two lives. Formal target group: 研究对象 · 服务对象 · 针对不同对象. Mainland colloquial steady partner, marriage implied: 找对象 · 处对象 · 谈对象.
An edge relative to a rival: 有优势 · 占优势 · 发挥优势 · 竞争优势 · 明显的优势. 优点 is a good quality in itself (他的优点是耐心).
Usually mass and institutional: 培养人才 · 引进人才 · 人才市场 · 高级管理人才 · 人才流失 brain drain. Sarcastic in speech too: 你真是个人才.
Economic register: 消费者 · 消费水平 · 刺激消费 · 高消费 · 在这儿消费了两百块. Newer figurative use: 消费某人 = milk someone's fame or a tragedy for attention.
For texts and plans: 修改文章 · 修改计划 · 修改密码 · 修改宪法. A broken machine is 修/修理; a mistake is 改正; 修订 is revising an edition.
Spreading something good into wider use: 推广技术 · 推广经验 · 大力推广 · 推广普通话. In business it means marketing: 网络推广 · 推广活动. The end state is 普及.
Takes its filler directly, no preposition: 充满信心 · 充满希望 · 充满活力 · 房间里充满了烟味. Also 对未来充满信心. 满 alone is the plain adjective (杯子满了).
做实验 is the collocation: 实验室 · 实验结果 · 化学实验 · 动物实验. Its near-twin 试验 (shìyàn) is a trial run of a device or method: 试验田 · 核试验.
Noun: 公众形象 · 树立形象 · 形象受损 · 品牌形象. Also an adjective meaning vivid and concrete: 他讲得很形象 · 形象的比喻 — the opposite of 抽象.
An authority signs off; the object is the application or the person: 批准申请 · 批准他加入 · 经上级批准 · 未经批准不得入内. Casual agreement is 同意, permission 允许.
占…的比例 make up a share · 男女比例 · 按比例分配 · 成/不成比例 · 1:100 的比例 scale. A percentage figure is 百分比; a rate is 率 (增长率).
For nations, forces and capabilities: 强大的国家 · 军事实力强大 · 功能非常强大 (of software). A strong body is 强壮; inner toughness is 坚强.
Nothing missing from it: 完整的句子 · 完整的资料 · 保持完整 · 领土完整. Adverbially with 地: 完整地演奏 · 完整地保存下来. 完美 claims flawlessness instead.
Intransitive — the thing that vanishes is the subject: 太阳消失在云层后 · 症状消失了 · 从视线中消失. To make something vanish, use 消除 or 使…消失. Missing persons 失踪.
Both the person and the act: 这部片子由他导演 · 名导演. Figurative: 导演了一场闹剧 stage-managed a farce. The writer is 编剧, the lead actor 主演.
Noun: 关键时刻 · 历史性的时刻 · 时刻表 timetable. Also an adverb, at every moment: 时刻准备着 · 时刻提醒自己. 时候 is the ordinary 'when'.
Of distance, time or figures: 快接近终点了 · 接近零度 · 接近尾声 drawing to a close. Of people it can hint at motives: 接近某人 · 他很难接近 hard to get close to.
Written and legal twin of 应该: 应当尊重老人 · 当事人应当在30日内提出申请. In conversation, and as a standalone reply (应该吧), you want 应该.
Weighty, usually about a whole life's course: 掌握自己的命运 · 改变命运 · 命运的安排 · 悲惨的命运. 运气 is everyday luck; 命 alone is more fatalistic and colloquial.
Almost always attributive, and most often about people: 广大人民 · 广大读者 · 广大农村地区. For a vast area you'd more often say 辽阔; 广泛 means wide-ranging (广泛的兴趣).
Demonstrable capability: 有实力 · 实力雄厚 · 靠实力说话 · 实力相当 evenly matched · 实力派演员. Do not mix with 势力, which is influence or a faction.
Time-frame noun: 中国古代 · 在古代 · 古代文学. The historian's ladder is 古代 → 近代 → 现代 → 当代. Colloquially 古时候; the adjective 'ancient' is 古老.
Adverb before the verb, stressing an unbroken stretch and often paired with a negative: 始终没学会 · 始终坚持 · 始终如一. 一直 is the everyday equivalent.
Adjective and verb both: 制度很完善 well-developed, and 完善制度 · 不断完善 · 完善相关法律. 改善 lifts a poor situation; 完善 fills in what is still missing.
The currency's name, not a unit — prices are 100块/元. Use it when contrasting currencies: 美元兑人民币 · 人民币升值 · 收人民币吗？
合理的要求 · 价格合理 · 不合理, and adverbially 合理安排时间 · 合理利用资源. 有道理 is 'fair point' about what someone said; 合法 is about the law.
Good outcomes of effort only: 研究成果 · 取得成果 · 成果丰硕. A neutral outcome is 结果, a bad one 后果, and the effect produced is 效果.
Ripe crops, ripe conditions, ripe people: 小麦成熟了 · 技术很成熟 proven · 时机还不成熟 · 想法不成熟 half-baked · 他很成熟. 熟 alone is cooked food, or familiar (跟他很熟).
Adverbial before the verb: 深入研究 · 深入了解 · 深入讨论. As a verb it takes a place: 深入基层 · 深入敌后. Set phrase 深入人心. 深刻 is for impressions (印象深刻).
Noun: 民间传说 · 传说中的凤凰. Also opens a clause like 据说: 传说这座山住着神仙. 神话 is myth proper; a rumour about a real person is 谣言.
买保险 · 上保险 · 保险公司 · 医疗保险. Also an adjective, safe bet: 这样比较保险 · 为保险起见 to be on the safe side. And 保险丝 is a fuse.
Forward movement itself; a destination needs 向/到 — 向山顶前进 · 继续前进 · 前进的方向 · 前进一步. To go somewhere specific is 前往/去.
Physical fitting and software alike: 安装空调 · 安装软件 · 安装完成. 装 alone does the same job colloquially (装个APP); 设置 is configuring afterwards; 组装 is assembling.
An incident with damage, and it 出 or 发生: 出了事故 · 发生交通事故 · 事故原因 · 责任事故. 意外 frames it as a mishap; 出事 is the everyday 'something happened'.
Trust in a person's character: 信任父母 · 得到信任 · 失去信任 · 信任危机. 相信 takes facts and clauses (我相信他会来); 信任 takes people.
Adverb before the verb, or with 的; the subject must be plural: 他们各自工作 · 各自回家 · 各自的想法 · 各自为政. 分别 is 'separately, one by one'; 各 attaches to a noun (各国).
Handing out shares from above: 分配任务 · 分配资源 · 把房间分配给他 · 按劳分配 · 收入分配. 分 alone is splitting among people (分蛋糕).
Intransitive rise of figures, levels or smoke: 物价上升 · 上升趋势 · 上升到新的高度. Prices specifically 上涨; you 提高 a standard (transitive). Opposite 下降.
Hold back or hold on to: 保留意见 · 保留权利 · 保留传统 · 给你保留座位. As a noun: 毫无保留地 holding nothing back. 保存 is preserving a thing from spoiling.
Written and administrative: 房屋出租 · 房屋中介 · 房屋结构 · 房屋倒塌. In speech it's 房子; 住房 is housing as a policy issue; 楼房 is multi-storey buildings.
Always followed by an adjective or descriptive phrase: 显得很年轻 · 显得有点紧张 · 这样显得不礼貌. It reports the impression given, often against expectation; 看起来 is neutral.
Keeping something from perishing or being lost: 保存食物 · 保存文件 save a file · 保存完好 well preserved · 保存实力. 保留 holds on to a right or an opinion.
A rival in a contest: 竞争对手 · 强劲的对手 · 与对手竞争. Idiomatic: 我不是他的对手 I'm no match for him. 敌人 is an enemy proper; 对方 is just the other side.
Adverb before the verb, usually with 了 or a resultative: 早已搬走了 · 早已习惯了 · 早已不复存在. Written-leaning; the spoken version is 早就.
Formal collective for offspring: 独生子女 · 子女教育 · 他有三个子女 · 子女抚养. In speech it's 孩子; 儿女 is the warmer literary cousin (儿女情长).
Literal and figurative alike: 打破杯子 · 打破纪录 break a record · 打破沉默 · 打破僵局 break the deadlock · 打破常规. 破 alone is the result complement (碗破了).
Intransitive — say 写小说, not 写作小说: 写作水平 · 写作技巧 · 从事写作 · 他在写作. Watch the parse trap: 写作业 is 写 + 作业, doing homework.
Processing raw material: 加工食品 · 加工零件 · 加工厂 · 深加工 · 来料加工. The object is the material, not the finished item. Figurative: 艺术加工 embellishing a story.
V-O compound, so no object follows: 自己创业 · 创业公司 startup · 创业者 · 创业初期 · 艰苦创业. The classic phrase for it is 白手起家 build from nothing.
Attributive: 人工智能 AI · 人工降雨 · 人工湖 · 人工客服 a human, not a bot. Also labour as a cost: 人工费 · 省人工. 手工 is handcrafted; 人造 labels materials (人造革).
Speaking formally at a meeting; V-O, so no object follows: 在会上发言 · 他先发了言 · 发言权 the right to speak · 发言人 spokesperson. A full speech is 演讲/讲话.
A physical crowd: 挤进人群 · 人群中 · 人群聚集. Also a demographic segment in market and health talk: 目标人群 · 高危人群 · 特定人群.
Trade and formal register: 服装行业 · 服装设计 · 服装厂 · 儿童服装 · 民族服装 costume. What you actually put on day to day is 衣服 — 穿衣服.
Formal, and mostly in fixed pairs from signs and regulations: 公共场所 · 娱乐场所 · 经营场所 · 消费场所. An ordinary place is 地方; a venue for an event is 场地.
Takes a fact or a clause: 否认事实 · 否认自己参与 · 矢口否认 flatly deny · 不可否认 undeniably (opens a sentence). 拒绝 refuses a request; 否定 rejects the value of something.
Signals the outcome holds either way: 反正我今天没事 · 不管你去不去，反正我要去 · 反正也来不及了. Heads its own clause and carries a shrug, so it stays colloquial.
Adverb before the verb, implying the person could have sent someone else: 亲自去一趟 · 亲自出马 · 校长亲自打电话. 自己 carries no such implication; 本人 is 'in person' on forms.
客观事实 · 客观条件 · 客观地评价 · 客观上. Its pair is 主观. In officialese 客观原因 is the excuse outside your control, against 主观原因 your own fault.
Opens the clause with no subject before it: 据说纽约物价很贵. Name the source with 据…说: 据他说 · 据报道 · 据了解. 听说 is what you personally heard.
The inner feeling itself, formal and analytic: 情感表达 · 情感丰富 · 情感教育. 感情 is the everyday word and also covers the bond between people — 他们感情很好 · 有感情.
Of people, information and equipment: 可靠的消息 · 消息来源可靠 · 质量可靠 · 不太可靠. 靠得住 is the colloquial version, 靠谱 the slang; 可信 is about believability.
Of a piece of writing: 文章的标题 · 起个标题 · 小标题 subheading · 标题党 clickbait. A book or film's name is 书名/片名; 题目 also means an exam question.
The civil-service job everyone tests into: 考公务员 · 公务员考试, shortened to 考公 · 国家公务员 · 公务员待遇. 干部 is the older cadre word; 官员 is officials in the news.
A noun despite the card's tag: 进入决赛 · 打进决赛 · 总决赛 the finals · 决赛圈. The ladder below it: 初赛/预赛 → 半决赛 semifinal → 决赛.
Noun with 下 or 有: 下定决心 · 有决心 · 决心很大. Also straight before a verb phrase, resolve to: 她决心戒烟 · 决心改变. 决定 is the neutral decision itself.
Stays a noun: 实现愿望 · 美好的愿望 · 强烈的愿望 · 愿望落空. It cannot head a clause the way 希望 does — 希望你来, but not 愿望你来. Making a wish is 许愿.
Goes with 大/小/轻 rather than a number: 他年纪不大 · 上了年纪 · 年纪轻轻 · 一大把年纪. For a figure use 年龄; 岁数 is the colloquial one for older people.
Verb with a direct object: 危害健康 · 危害社会 · 危害公共安全, or with 对 — 对健康危害很大. Also a noun: 吸烟的危害. 伤害 is personal injury or hurt feelings.
Before the verb: 定期检查 · 定期举行 · 定期更新. Also attributive: 定期存款 fixed-term deposit · 定期体检. 按时 is on schedule; 经常 is just often, no fixed interval.
Bare time word, no 在 needed: 年初定了目标 · 今年年初. Its partners: 年底/年末 · 年中 · 月初/月底. New Year's Day itself is 元旦.
One thing pulls another along: 带动经济发展 · 带动就业 · 带动气氛 · 起到带动作用. The object is a trend or a group. 推动 pushes a process; 带领 leads people directly.
好 is read hào here, the 'be fond of' one as in 好学. The target takes 对: 对…感到好奇 · 好奇心 · 好奇地问 · 出于好奇 out of curiosity.
Both 'become widespread' — 智能手机已经普及了 · 普及率 — and 'spread to everyone': 普及知识 · 普及九年义务教育. 推广 is the active pushing that leads to it.
Verb: 把握机会 · 把握方向 · 把握好分寸. Noun 'certainty': 我有把握 I'm sure I can pull it off · 没什么把握 · 有几成把握. 抓住机会 is the concrete-feeling verb.
Social dealings in general: 与人交往 · 人际交往 · 交往能力. Also dating when it's two people: 他们交往了三年. The other party takes 与/跟, not a direct object.
Inner toughness under hardship: 坚强的意志 · 你要坚强 · 坚强起来 · 坚强的后盾 a solid backing. A strong body is 强壮, a strong country 强大, dogged persistence 顽强.
A remote past with no reference point — the fairytale opener 从前有座山. 以前 is relative and can attach to a phrase (吃饭以前), which 从前 cannot; 过去 is the neutral one.
The materials a course is taught from, seen from the teacher's side: 编写教材 · 选用教材 · 这套教材. What the student carries is 课本; the formal word is 教科书.
The object is a difficulty in the situation or in yourself: 克服困难 · 克服缺点 · 克服恐惧 · 克服时差. Colloquially 克服一下 = put up with the inconvenience. Beating a rival is 战胜.
对…感到乐观 · 保持乐观 · 乐观的态度 · 盲目乐观. News register: 形势不容乐观, the situation gives little cause for optimism. Opposite 悲观.
Separable V-O: 录了一段音 · 给他录音 · 正在录音. Also the noun: 一段录音 · 录音笔 voice recorder · 录音室. Video is 录像/拍视频.
办手续 go through the formalities · 办理出国手续 · 手续费 handling fee · 手续齐全 papers all in order · 手续繁琐. It's the paperwork steps, not the rules (规定).
Rejecting the worth or truth of something: 否定他的成绩 · 全盘否定 · 不能一概否定. Also a grammar term: 否定句 · 否定形式 · 否定的答案 a no. 否认 is denying you did it.
Metaphorical brightness: 前途光明 · 光明的未来 · 走向光明. Set phrases 光明正大 above-board · 光明磊落. A well-lit room is 亮/明亮 instead.
The geometric outline only: 什么形状 · 形状很特别 · 不规则形状 · 保持形状. 样子 is overall look or manner; 外形 a product's exterior; 形象 a public image.
Chiefly a modifier: 影视行业 · 影视作品 · 影视明星 · 影视圈 the industry. When you need a full phrase in a sentence, 电影和电视 is what you say.
In daily use it's the guard himself: 小区保安 · 当保安 · 叫保安来. The abstract sense survives in compounds: 保安措施 · 保安公司. 警卫 guards officials, 保镖 is a bodyguard.
Formal receiving of visitors at work: 接待客户 · 接待来访者 · 接待处 reception · 热情接待. Guests at home are 招待, which also covers wining and dining them.
Three lives: the block entrance in an address (三号楼二单元), a textbook chapter (第三单元), and 单元测试 unit test. 单位 is your work unit or a unit of measure.
Your closest family, the ones you'd grieve for: 想念亲人 · 失去亲人 · 亲人团聚. 亲戚 is the wider circle you visit at New Year; 家人 is the household you live with.
The person asked takes 向: 向老师提问. In a classroom it flips — 老师提问 means the teacher calls on students. Also a noun: 提问环节 the Q&A · 大家的提问.
Attributive, in graded sets: 初级班 · 初级阶段 · 初级水平 · 初级会计师. The ladder is 初级 → 中级 → 高级. A beginner person is 初学者.
Takes an object directly, or 向…告别: 告别朋友 · 告别过去 · 告别单身 · 告别演出 farewell performance. Weightier than 再见; funerals use 遗体告别仪式.
当志愿者 · 招募志愿者 · 志愿服务 · 志愿者活动. Note that bare 志愿 also means your college-application choice — 填志愿 · 第一志愿 — an unrelated everyday sense.
Literary and nostalgic, the word of poems and essays: 思念故乡 · 回故乡 · 故乡的味道. In speech you say 老家 (我老家在东北) or 家乡.
Checking in on arrival: 新生报到 · 到公司报到 · 报到处 · 报到时间. Homophone trap: 报道 (bàodào) is a news report — 新闻报道 · 据报道.
The auditorium where live shows happen: 去剧场看话剧 · 小剧场 fringe theatre. 剧院 names the institution or building (国家大剧院); a cinema is 电影院.
Attributive, meaning in colour: 彩色照片 · 彩色电视 · 彩色铅笔, against 黑白. The colour of a thing is 颜色 (什么颜色); 色彩 is colour as tone or quality (色彩鲜艳).
Colloquial and three-way: a machine fault (出毛病 · 机器有毛病), a personal bad habit (改掉这个毛病), and the jab 你有毛病吧. Formal write-ups use 问题/故障.
The one-time opening of a new business or practice: 下个月开业 · 开业典礼 · 开业大吉. Daily trading hours are 营业 (营业时间); closing for good is 停业/关门.
Goes immediately before a quantity to stress it's a full one: 整整一个月 · 整整两年 · 整整十岁. Note 整整齐齐 is a different word, the reduplication of 整齐.
Broadcast register, what the announcer says: 收看新闻联播 · 欢迎收看. Radio is 收听; watching a live event is 观看; everyday watching is just 看.
练武术 · 学武术 · 武术表演 · 武术套路 forms. 功夫 is the everyday and export word for the same thing; 武打 is film fight choreography, 武侠 the swordsman genre.
For songs, stories and scenes that stir you: 动人的歌声 · 动人的故事 · 动人的场面 · 动人心弦. 感人 is specifically the moving-to-tears kind.
Separable, and the other person takes 跟/和: 跟他握手 · 握了握手 · 我们握过手. Set phrase 握手言和 shake hands and make peace.
Oct 1 in the PRC: 国庆节 · 国庆期间 · 国庆长假 · 十一黄金周, and people often just say 十一. It names that holiday specifically, not national days in general.
A prowess you display, admiring and slightly old-fashioned: 有本领 · 真本领 · 本领高强 · 看家本领 one's signature skill. 能力 is the neutral ability, 技能 a trained skill.
Neat in arrangement, things lined up: 摆得很整齐 · 队伍很整齐 · 整整齐齐 · 整齐划一 uniform. A tidy room or person is 整洁/干净.
The drawing as an object, typically a child's or a textbook's: 画一幅图画 · 图画书 picture book. Adults usually say 画 (一幅画) or 图片 for an image; painting as an art is 绘画.
Asking around informally for information: 打听消息 · 向他打听 · 打听一下 · 四处打听. It goes after facts, not opinions; 询问 is the formal counterpart.
Medical and formal, from the doctor's side: 治疗疾病 · 接受治疗 · 治疗方案 · 化学治疗. The patient's side is 看病/看医生; 治 alone is the colloquial verb (治好了).
A large formal assembly: 召开大会 · 全国代表大会 · 大会发言 · 联合国大会. An ordinary meeting is 会议/开会; a sports meet is 运动会.
Before a noun: 平均水平 · 平均分 · 平均年龄; before a measure phrase, on average: 平均每天两小时. As a predicate it means evenly spread: 速度很平均 · 平均分配.
Only for meetings and conferences, and only from the organizer's side: 召开会议 · 召开大会 · 会议将于明天召开. Attending is 参加/出席; the everyday version is 开会.
文章的主题 · 会议的主题 · 围绕主题 · 主题公园 theme park · 主题曲 theme song. 题目 is the title or an exam question; 话题 is a topic of conversation.
The object is a positive process, not a person: 促进发展 · 促进交流 · 促进理解 · 促进消化 · 起促进作用. 推动 pushes a cause; 促使 takes a clause (促使他改变主意).
Takes a post as its object, CV register: 担任班长 · 担任经理 · 担任评委 · 曾担任副总. Colloquially you'd say 当 (当老师); 承担 takes on responsibility or costs, not posts.
Lifts an existing condition: 改善关系 · 改善环境 · 改善生活条件 · 得到改善. 改进 is for methods and products, 改正 for mistakes, 完善 for filling in what's missing.
Standing in a hierarchy: 社会地位 · 地位很高 · 提高地位 · 地位平等 · 处于不利地位. A physical spot is 位置, a job post 职位, your role or identity 身份.
Standard reading is xiàzài (载 zài, to load), though xiàzǎi is everywhere in speech: 下载软件 · 下载到手机上 · 下载完了. The opposite is 上传 upload.
A physical spot or slot: 位置很好 · 找个位置 · 换个位置 · 放在原来的位置上. A booked seat is 座位, standing in society 地位, a job opening 职位.
Adverb, at the head or before the verb: 或许明天会放晴 · 他或许不知道. Written-leaning; 也许 is the everyday twin, 可能 the most neutral and the one you use to answer alone (可能吧).
Mostly attributive and often abstract: 巨大的变化 · 巨大的影响 · 巨大的损失 · 巨大的成功. For sheer physical bulk 庞大 suggests unwieldy size (庞大的机构).
Attributive only — it takes no 很 and does not stand as a predicate: 大型企业 · 大型活动 · 大型超市. The set is 大型/中型/小型/微型; as a predicate say 规模很大.
Intransitive, with 在/于 for where: 主要分布在南方 · 分布广泛 · 分布不均. Same form as a noun: 人口分布 · 分布图. Handing things out is 分配.
Nearly always 采取措施: 采取有效措施 · 安全措施 · 具体措施 · 措施得力. Abstract and plural-feeling; a single practice is 做法, a policy 政策, a method 办法.
挑 is tiǎo, provoke (as in 挑衅), not tiāo pick. Noun: 面临挑战 · 接受挑战 · 有挑战性. Verb: 挑战极限 · 挑战权威, or 向他挑战.
Takes a person or their feelings: 伤害身体 · 伤害感情 · 伤害自尊心 · 受到伤害. Getting hurt yourself is 受伤; harming interests or reputation is 损害; 危害 endangers the public.
Three shapes: pour resources in (投入资金/人力), put into operation (投入使用 · 投入生产), and an adjective for absorbed (工作很投入 · 演得很投入).
Object is an abstract capacity, usually your own: 发挥优势/特长/想象力 · 发挥作用 play a role · 充分发挥 give full play to · 正常发挥 perform to form (exams, sport).
Sets up a then-vs-now contrast, so it usually opens the clause: 如今…了. 现在 is the neutral 'now'; 如今 carries 'these days, unlike before' and is a shade more written.
Short-course skills training, a noun as often as a verb: 参加培训 · 培训班/课程 · 岗前培训 · 培训员工. Long-term nurturing of a person or an interest is 培养.
Two jobs: data or works 反映 reality (反映了…的想法), and you 向领导反映情况/问题 report an issue upward. Different word from its homophone 反应 fǎnyìng, a reaction.
Formal; the object is an abstract state or standing, not a place: 处于…阶段/状态/地位 · 处于劣势/领先/困境. Physical location takes 位于.
Adverbial before verbs of change or removal: 彻底解决/改变/清除/失败 · 彻底的胜利. It means all the way to the root, so 彻底失败 is utter failure, not partial.
Takes people or slow-growing abstractions: 培养人才/接班人 · 培养兴趣/习惯/能力 · 培养感情. Literal in labs too: 培养细菌. Short job-skill courses are 培训.
The intrinsic nature of a thing or event: 问题的性质 · 性质严重 · 化学性质 · 性质相同. A person's disposition is 性格, their moral character 品质.
Hands-on running of equipment or a procedure: 操作机器/电脑 · 操作系统 · 操作简单 · 违规操作. Modern slang: 这波操作 'that move'. Driving a car is 开.
Neutral factual account: 描述当时的情况/过程 · 详细描述 · 对…的描述 (noun). Literary depiction is 描写; 形容 is groping for words that capture a quality.
Verb and noun alike: 测试新系统/性能 · 压力测试 · 性格测试 · 内测/公测 beta. 考试 is the graded exam; 测试 is checking how something performs.
Bookish 'still, as before' — same slot as 仍然, while 还是 is the spoken default: 依然没变 · 依然坚持 · 依然如故. Also trails a noun for effect: 风采依然.
The whole holds the content inside, often abstract: 包含着深意/感情 · 价格包含服务费. When enumerating members, 包括 is the usual pick: 包括A、B在内.
Parts make up the whole: 由A和B构成 · 组成部分/构成部分. Also fixed abstract uses: 构成威胁 pose a threat · 构成犯罪 · 构成污染.
Formal — attending a meeting or ceremony as an invited party: 出席会议/婚礼/典礼 · 出席率 · opposite 缺席. Everyday 'take part in' is 参加.
Formal: shutting down operations or systems, often passive — 工厂被关闭 · 关闭机场/账户/程序/网站. Closing a door or switching off a light is plain 关.
Noun: emblem or landmark — 城市的标志 · 交通标志 road sign · 标志性建筑. Also a verb, always with 着: 这标志着…的开始 marks the beginning of.
Formal, with abstract objects: 作出决定/选择/反应/贡献/让步/牺牲. Written 做出 just as often — same word. Concrete making (a cake, a table) is plain 做.
Two senses: 'temporary' before a noun — 临时工/临时会议/临时政府; and 'at the last minute, unplanned' — 临时有事 · 临时决定 · 临时抱佛脚 cram at the last minute.
Consult for guidance rather than copy: 参考资料/书/文献 · 参考别人的意见 · 供你参考 · 仅供参考 'for reference only', the set formula on documents.
Deliberate, sustained thinking, faintly formal: 思考问题/人生 · 独立思考 · 深入思考 · 值得思考 worth pondering. Everyday 'I think that…' stays 觉得/想.
Mutual swap where both sides give: 交换名片/礼物/意见 · 交换生 exchange student · 交换条件. Ideas flowing over time is 交流; simply replacing a thing is 换.
Announcement register, adverb before a (usually two-syllable) verb: 即将开始/到来/举行/上映. Conversation says 快(要)…了 or 马上.
Object is a hoped-for future thing or a clause: 期待你的回复 · 期待着见到你 · 期待已久 long-awaited · 值得期待. 期望 places hopes on a person (对孩子的期望).
Formal; the object is a qualification or prerequisite: 具备条件/资格/能力/素质 · 具备…的实力 · 不具备. Owning physical things is 有/拥有.
Usually modifies: 大众文化/媒体/口味 · 大众化 popularized · 受大众欢迎. 群众 is the political 'masses'; 公众 the public of 公众人物/公众场合.
Three uses: adjective 'thrilling' (很刺激); verb 'stimulate' (刺激经济/消费/食欲); and 'provoke, upset' a person — 别刺激他 · 受了刺激 be traumatized.
Adjective 'in agreement': 看法/意见一致 · 与…一致 · 保持一致 · 言行一致. Also adverbial 'unanimously' before decision verbs: 一致同意/通过/认为 · 一致好评.
You take it on by duty or choice: 承担责任/后果/风险/费用/义务 · 承担任务. Its twin 承受 is enduring what lands on you (承受压力/痛苦).
Adverb sitting after the subject, before the verb: 居民大多以种地为生 · 大多来自南方 · 大多是学生. To quantify a noun directly, use 大多数(的)人.
Cover-all 'things' in the abstract: 新事物 · 周围的事物 · 事物的本质/发展规律. Physical objects are 东西; a matter to deal with is 事情. Not 事务 (affairs).
Adverb after the subject, flagging a result opposite to expectation: 不但没…，反而… · 越…反而越… · 这么做反而不好. The thwarted expectation must be in the air.
Adjective and verb both. Adj: 固定收入/工作/时间/资产 · 固定的位置. Verb 'fasten': 把电话固定在墙上 · 固定下来 settle into place.
Attributive — it modifies rather than stands alone: 学术研究/论文/会议 · 学术界 academia · 学术水平/氛围 · 学术不端 misconduct.
Adverbial as often as adjective: 充分利用/发挥/体现/说明 · 充分的理由/证据/准备. A plentiful supply of a physical resource is 充足: 资金/阳光充足.
Opens the conclusion clause after the evidence: 大家都不及格，可见考试很难 · 由此可见 from this we see. Also literal 'visible': 清晰可见 · 可见光.
Takes a noun or a whole clause: 想象一下…的样子 · 难以/无法想象 · 想象不到. Noun too: 想象力 · 超出想象. Also written 想像; same word.
Typically the predicate, not before the noun: 时间/能力/名额有限 · 资源十分有限. Fixed: 有限公司 Ltd · 有限责任. Modest self-deprecation: 我水平有限.
Big-picture political, economic or military situation: 经济/国际形势 · 形势严峻/紧张 · 形势好转. Everyday particulars are 情况. Homophone trap: 形式 = form, format.
Adverb before the verb, 'on one's own, separately': 单独去 · 单独跟他谈谈 · 单独包装 · 单独一个人. Being unaccompanied, not lonely — that's 孤独/寂寞.
Two senses: goods' quality with a premium ring — 品质优良 · 高品质生活; and a person's moral character — 优秀/高尚的品质. Plain product quality is usually 质量.
Two layers: the pay-and-benefits package — 待遇不错 · 工资/福利待遇; and how someone is treated — 享受同等待遇 · 不公平的待遇 · 特殊待遇.
The verbs it lives with: 签(订)合同 sign · 履行合同 fulfil · 违反/解除合同 breach, terminate · 续签 renew. Counted with 份. 根据合同 per the contract.
Attributive only — straight onto the noun, no 的 and no 很: 新型手机/材料/技术 · 新型冠状病毒 novel coronavirus. To predicate it you say 是新型的.
Verb-object: 业 is already the job, so nothing follows — 失业了 · 失业半年 · 又失业了. Noun-ish uses need no change: 失业率 · 失业保险 · 大量失业.
Companion in a shared activity: 合作伙伴 business partner · 伙伴关系 partnership · 小伙伴 buddies (playful, very common online). A life partner is 伴侣/对象.
Written register, putting goods on the market: 出售房屋/股票 · 对外出售 · 待售/已出售 on signs. Everyday selling to a person is 卖 (卖给我).
Intransitive — the goal arrives via 为: 为理想/未来而奋斗 · 艰苦奋斗 · 奋斗目标 · 奋斗了一辈子. Years-long striving, not effort on one task (that's 努力).
Modifies nouns, often loftily: 无限可能/潜力/风光 · 无限流量 unlimited data · 无限期 indefinitely · 无限接近. A mundane 'no cap on X' is 不限.
The ground outdoors or a hard floor surface: 地面湿滑 · 地面部队 ground troops · 地面塌陷. A room's wooden floor is 地板; casual 'on the floor' is 地上.
Noun 'obligation': 尽义务 fulfil one's duty · 权利和义务 · 有义务做… . Also attributive 'unpaid, compulsory by duty': 义务教育 compulsory schooling · 义务劳动/献血.
Sets up a flip: 最初我以为…，后来才发现… . Attributive too: 最初的想法/计划/阶段. 当初 is 'back then' with a tinge of regret; sequential 'first' is 首先.
The formal, legal adult: 成人票 · 成人教育 · 成年人. Speaking with children you'd say 大人. It also flags 18+ content, as in the example sentence.
Setting two things side by side to bring out difference: 把A和B对比 · A和B形成鲜明对比 sharp contrast · 相比之下 · 对比强烈. 比较 is the everyday 'compare'.
Object is what you give up: 付出努力/时间/心血/代价 · 付出了生命 · 有付出才有回报. Handing over money at a till is 付/付钱.
Bringing something in from outside — abroad or another organization: 引进技术/设备/人才/外资 · 从国外引进. Introducing people to each other is 介绍.
Object is abstract and important: 忽视问题/健康/孩子的感受. Set phrases carry it: 不容忽视 not to be overlooked · 不可忽视的作用 · 被忽视. 忽略 is the accidental oversight.
Opens the wrap-up clause, with a comma: 总之，… . Two flavours — summing up ('in short') and brushing detail aside ('anyway'). Fuller written form: 总而言之.
Lives with a few verbs: 鼓起勇气 work up the nerve · 有/没有勇气做… · 需要勇气 · 失去勇气. The adjective is 勇敢 — 他很勇敢, not 他很勇气.
Attributive quantifier, usually with a measure word: 无数次 countless times · 无数个小时 · 无数人 · 无数事实证明. Spoken equivalent: 数不清的.
Points back at a set already named and means its remainder: 其余的事情 · 其余人 · 其余三个. 其他 is 'other(s)' generally, implying no leftover.
Physical: 吸收水分/营养/热量. Abstract: 吸收知识/经验/外来文化. Organizational: 吸收新成员/会员 admit into a group.
Rated with 高/低, never 大/小: 效率很高 · 提高效率 · 工作/学习效率 · 效率低下. Attributive: 高效率的方式, or just 高效.
Endearment for a child or lover (宝贝，过来), and a prized possession (这是我的宝贝). Also a verb 'to dote on': 她可宝贝那台相机了. Online shops call listings 宝贝.
Two uses: 'just a few, isolated' — 个别人/个别现象/个别情况, often faintly critical; and 'one-on-one' — 个别谈话/个别辅导/个别对待.
Neutral or positive reliance on a support: 依靠自己/群众/科技 · 依靠…生活. Also a noun: 老人的依靠. Unhealthy dependence is 依赖; the spoken word is plain 靠.
Object is a span of time or length: 延长时间/工期/寿命/合同 · 延长到明年 · 延长了两小时. Opposite 缩短. Making something bigger in scope is 扩大.
In practice only 亲爱的 — letter opener (亲爱的妈妈：, with a colon, not a comma) or 'honey' to a partner. Rarely stands as a predicate.
Hypothetical 'if', a touch more written than 如果 and well above spoken 要是. Opens the clause and pairs with 就/那(么): 假如…，我就… · 假如…的话.
Noun as much as verb: 露出/带着微笑 · 面带微笑 · 报以微笑 (as in the example). Verb takes 对: 对我微笑. Plain 笑 covers laughing too; 微笑 is the silent one.
A person's reticence (他这个人很沉默) and a silence in progress: 保持沉默 · 打破沉默 break the silence · 沉默了一会儿 · 沉默寡言. A quiet room is 安静.
Counted with 对: 一对老夫妇. Formal, especially after a name — 张教授夫妇 'Prof. Zhang and his wife'. For the marriage relation itself, 夫妻 (夫妻关系).
A 代替 B = A takes B's place: 机器代替人 · 用蜂蜜代替糖 · 你能代替我去吗. 取代 is supplanting for good; the spoken shorthand is 替 (替我去).
Enduring what is imposed on you: 承受压力/痛苦/打击/损失 · 承受重量 · 承受不了/承受得住 (the potential complement is very common). Taking duty on by choice is 承担.
Of relationships and cooperation: 关系密切 · 密切合作/联系 · 密切相关 closely related. As an adverb it means 'closely, attentively': 密切关注/注意. Physical nearness is 近.
Tech attributive: 智能手机/家居/汽车 · 人工智能 AI · 智能化. A clever person is 聪明 and their intellect 智力 — 智能 is machine smarts.
Verbs: 举行/举办婚礼 hold · 参加婚礼 attend · 办婚礼 (colloquial). Counted with 场. The marriage itself is 婚姻; getting married is 结婚.
For what a substance holds inside — the label word: 含有糖分/维生素/酒精/添加剂. Abstract too: 话里含有深意. Listing members takes 包括/包含.
Railway-announcement register: 开往北京的列车 · 列车员 conductor · 列车长 · 末班列车. In conversation you say 火车 (坐火车去).
Reaching for words that capture a quality or feeling: 用…来形容 · 难以/无法形容 · 不能用言语形容. Hence 形容词 = adjective. A factual account is 描述.
Verb and noun: 做深呼吸 take a deep breath · 呼吸新鲜空气 · 呼吸困难 · 人工呼吸 rescue breathing · 呼吸道 respiratory tract.
Attributive noun: 商务谈判/会议/活动 · 商务舱 business class · 电子商务 e-commerce · 商务人士. A company's own operations are 业务; a deal or trade is 生意.
Written intensifier before two-syllable adjectives: 极其重要/复杂/危险/罕见 · 极其少见. Speech uses 特别/非常. Rarely before one-syllable 好/大.
Transitive — takes the person or the plight directly: 同情他 · 同情他的遭遇 · 值得同情 · 表示同情 · 出于同情. Noun: 同情心. It can imply looking down.
Intransitive, with the story as subject: 这个故事在村里流传了几百年 · 流传下来/流传至今 · 广泛流传. Actively spreading something is 传播 (传播消息/疾病).
Pivot verb needing a clause after the object: 促使他不断进步 · 促使问题得到解决. If you only have a noun to advance, use 促进: 促进经济发展/交流.
Arranging in an order, usually with 按/照: 按顺序/大小/笔画排列 · 排列整齐 · 重新排列. Math: 排列组合 permutations. Just putting things down is 摆.
Of objects and methods, worth their use: 简单又实用 · 实用价值/实用性 · 经济实用 · 实用主义 pragmatism. A down-to-earth person is 务实.
Pairs the currencies with 兑 or 对: 美元兑人民币的汇率 · 汇率上涨/下跌/波动 · 按今天的汇率. 率 reads lǜ here, as in 效率/利率.
Usually negative: 我不在乎 · 满不在乎 couldn't care less · 毫不在乎. Takes a noun or a clause: 在乎别人怎么看. 关心 is caring for someone; 在乎 is minding.
Praises how well something was done, and the person behind it: 出色的表现/成绩 · 一名出色的哲学家 · 表现得很出色 · 出色地完成任务. Close to 优秀.
Absence of turbulence — water, mood, or life: 湖面平静 · 心情/生活平静 · 恢复平静 · 平静下来. 安静 is 'no noise'; 冷静 is keeping your head in a crisis.
Half literal harvest, half 'what you got out of it': 收获的季节 · 这次旅行收获很多 · 很有收获 · 收获满满. As a verb it also takes abstract fruit: 收获友谊.
Alphabetic letters only: 大写/小写字母 · 字母表 the alphabet · 英文字母 · 按字母顺序排列 in alphabetical order. Chinese 字 are 汉字.
Computer copy: 复制粘贴 copy-paste · 把文件复制到U盘. Also replicas and repeats: 复制品 replica · 复制他人的成功. Photocopying a page is 复印.
Adverb before the verb, planning ahead of an event: 事先商量好 · 事先通知/说明/准备. Pairs with 事后 (事后才知道). 提前 is 'ahead of a set time': 提前十分钟到.
Formal appraisal, mostly attributive: 优良品质/品种/传统 · 优良作风 · 成绩优良. Praising a person is 优秀; in speech, 好/棒.
…的含量高/低: 糖分/酒精/维生素含量. Compresses to 含糖量/含铁量. Figurative and very common: 技术含量 — 没什么技术含量 takes no real skill.
Followed by a verb phrase, not a bare noun: 善于交流/表达/学习/发现问题 · 善于思考. For a skill named as a noun (擅长书法/游泳) use 擅长. Written register.
Noun only — the pleasure an activity yields: 带来/增添乐趣 · 享受其中的乐趣 · 生活的乐趣 · 乐趣无穷. 'That was fun' as a comment is 有意思/好玩儿.
Picking through concrete options with an eye for quality: 挑选礼物/蔬菜/人才 · 仔细/精心挑选. Abstract choices are 选择 (选择职业); spoken short forms 挑/选.
Object is a person or place you are apart from: 想念你/家乡/父母. Speech usually just says 想 (我想你了); 怀念 is missing a bygone time (怀念大学时光).
A career or a life's outlook: 有/没有前途 · 前途光明 promising · 前途无量 limitless promise · 前途未卜 uncertain · 影响前途. Plain future time is 未来/将来.
Almost always before an abstract noun: 宝贵的时间/经验/意见/生命/机会 · 宝贵的财富. Costly physical items are 贵重 (贵重物品); a treasured photo is 珍贵.
Adverb before a verb carrying a number: 总共有六个 · 总共花了三百块 · 总共三天. 一共 is the everyday equivalent; 总共 sounds a shade more formal.
The agency or agent for property and services: 房产/留学中介 · 中介公司/中介费 · 通过中介租房. A middleman in a one-off deal is 中间人.
Only of people and their hearts: 心地善良 · 善良的人 · 为人善良 · 天真善良. It names disposition, not deeds — doing kind things is 好心/热心.
Two uses: 'off-hours' — 业余时间/生活/爱好; and 'amateur' against 专业 — 业余选手/歌手. As a put-down it means sloppy: 你也太业余了.
Twin of 制定, same sound: objects are plans and schemes — 制订计划/方案/规则. For laws, standards and policies the standard choice is 制定: 制定法律/政策.
The mail sense is the everyday one: 寄/收/签收包裹 · 一个包裹 · 包裹单. Also a verb 'wrap up', with 起来/住: 用毛巾把伤口包裹起来.
Seen from the institution's side, so it usually appears in the passive: 被大学录取 · 录取通知书 admission letter · 录取分数线 cut-off · 录取率.
Fiscal quarters: 第一/第四季度 · 本季度 · 季度报表/业绩 · 每个季度. The four seasons of the year are 季节 (春季/夏季).
Literal grip (抓紧扶手/绳子) and, far more often, hurrying: 抓紧时间 · 抓紧完成/办 · 你抓紧点. As a nudge it means 'get on it, don't dawdle'.
Pocket and also sack: 一口袋米. 把…放进口袋 · 口袋里 · 掏口袋. Northern speech prefers 兜/衣兜; 口袋里没钱 = broke.
A scene as witnessed and felt: 当时的情景 · 感人/温馨的情景 · 情景再现. 情况 is the factual state of affairs; a staged or filmed scene is 场景 (情景喜剧 sitcom).
Mostly attributive or adverbial: 手工制作 handmade · 纯手工 · 手工艺品 handicraft · 手工费 labor charge. 做手工 = doing crafts, as a kids' activity.
Written and instructional register: 步行十分钟 · 步行前往 · 步行街 pedestrian street · 步行者. In speech people say 走路 (走路去上班).
Verb-object, so it splits: 充了两个小时电 · 充会儿电. The device takes 给: 给手机充电. Figurative and common: 给自己充充电 go learn something new.
Knowledge everyone is assumed to have: 基本常识 · 生活/安全常识 · 缺乏常识 · 常识性错误 an elementary blunder. Learned subject knowledge is 知识.
Two-reading trap: dàyé is father's elder brother; dàye (neutral) is both a polite 'sir' for an older man and the sense here — 当大爷 · 摆大爷架子 sit back and be waited on.
Literal: 帮助消化 · 消化不良 indigestion · 消化系统. Figurative and frequent: 消化知识/新内容 take it in · 消化库存 clear stock.
Colloquial for 嘴; either works for the body part (张开嘴巴). The idioms all use bare 嘴: 嘴甜 · 多嘴 · 闭嘴. One older sense of 嘴巴 is a slap: 打他一个嘴巴.
Praise as a predicate: 真了不起 · 了不起的成就. Its negation is a set put-down: 没什么了不起 'big deal' · 自以为了不起 thinks he's something. 不 is neutral: liǎobuqǐ.
Verb-object, so nothing follows it: 我在减肥 · 减肥方法/药/餐 · 减肥成功. To give an amount use 减: 减了五斤. 瘦 is being thin; 减肥 is the effort.
Label for a middle-aged or older woman — friendly from a child, faintly mocking otherwise: 广场舞大妈 · 中国大妈. To her face, 阿姨 is the safe address.
Adverb for 'more than usual, given the circumstances': 雨后空气格外清新 · 格外小心/热闹 · 显得格外年轻. 特别/非常 are neutral; 格外 implies a comparison.
Retail term: 搞/做促销 · 促销活动/手段 · 促销价. It names the whole campaign; the price cut itself is 打折/优惠.
Boiling content down to its gist: 用一句话概括 · 概括文章的主旨 · 概括起来说 · 概括性. 总结 is drawing lessons from experience or wrapping up a period.
Adverbial before the activity: 专心学习/工作/听课 · 专心做一件事. Formal 专心于研究. Negative: 上课不专心. Chengyu: 专心致志.
Literary; the everyday word is 眼泪 (流眼泪). 泪水 shows up in writing: 泪水夺眶而出 · 擦干泪水 · 满脸泪水.
Aesthetic grace in things that unfold or are shaped: 优美的风景/音乐/舞姿/文字 · 环境优美 · 姿态优美. A pretty face is 漂亮; elegance of manner is 优雅.
The botanical fruit on the plant; what you buy to eat is 水果. Figurative: 劳动的果实 · 胜利的果实 · 丰硕的果实 rich fruits.
Attributive only: 二手车/房/书 · 二手市场/交易. Extended: 二手烟 secondhand smoke · 二手资料 secondhand sources. A merely old item is 旧的.
Counted in pairs with 副: 一副手套. You 戴 gloves and 摘 them off — 穿 is for clothes and shoes.
Literal steps (坐在台阶上), plus a very live idiom: 给他一个台阶下 give him a way to save face · 找个台阶下 climb down gracefully.
Counted with 张; you 递/发/交换名片. Figurative and common in media: 这道菜是这座城市的名片 — its calling card.
The verb is 做: 做家务 · 分担家务 share the chores · 家务活儿 (colloquial) · 家务事 domestic matters, as in 清官难断家务事.
Object is a fault, usually one's own: 改正错误/缺点/坏习惯 · 及时改正. Correcting someone else's mistake or pronunciation is 纠正; revising a text is 修改.
Reply to an apology or a worry: 不要紧，我没事. Also 这不要紧，要紧的是… . Watch the parse — the card's 不要紧张 is 不要 + 紧张 'don't be nervous', a different string.
The whole school year: 新学年 · 上一学年 · 学年初/末. A term inside it is 学期 (这个学期); a class period is 节/课时.
Honorific for the other party's arrival, never your own: 欢迎光临 (shop greeting) · 敬请光临 · 光临寒舍 grace my humble home. For yourself you say 我去/我来.
Adverbial, attached to the verb of the reaction: 急忙跑过去 · 急忙解释/回答. 连忙 is near-identical; 匆忙 also modifies nouns (匆忙的脚步), where 急忙 stays adverbial.
Verb-object, so no object follows: 考试及格了 · 没及格/不及格 · 及格线/及格分 the pass mark · 刚好及格. Passing an exam as an achievement is 通过考试.
Counted with 个: 三个学分. 修(满)学分 earn credits · 拿到学分 · 学分制 the credit system · 学分不够.
Counted with 条; the verb is 围 or 戴: 围上围巾 · 戴着围巾 · 织围巾 knit one, as in the example.
Boiled, therefore drinkable — not merely hot: 烧开水 boil some · 白开水 plain boiled water · 凉开水 boiled then cooled. Water hot from the tap is 热水.
Verb-object, and it splits: 刷了牙没有? · 刷个牙就走 · 一天刷两次牙. The tools reverse the order: 牙刷 toothbrush, 牙膏 toothpaste.
Counted with 根: 一根吸管 · 插上吸管 · 纸吸管/塑料吸管 · 用吸管喝.
Describes a mass of mixed colors rather than one object: 五颜六色的花/气球/灯光. Attributive with 的, or a predicate: 打扮得五颜六色. Gaudy: 花花绿绿.
Shop-counter staff, a slightly dated state-store word: 商店/超市售货员. Today people say 店员, or 服务员 in restaurants; a company's sales staff are 销售.
Verb-object: 填空题 fill-in-the-blank question · 做填空 · 填个空. Figurative 'fill someone's slot', as in the example; the fuller phrase is 填补空缺.
A firm's line of work or a person's professional competence: 开展/拓展业务 · 主营业务 core business · 业务能力/水平 · 业务员 sales rep. A deal or trade is 生意.
Written and headline register: 今日头条 · 今日起 as of today · 截至今日. Speech uses 今天. Proverb: 今日事，今日毕 — don't put off today's work.
Adverbial before verbs of use and spread: 广泛使用/应用/传播/关注. Attributive: 广泛的影响/兴趣/支持 · 兴趣广泛. Physical width is 宽, not 广泛.
更 reads gēng 'to change' here, not gèng 'more' — same trap in 更改/更换. Uses: 系统/软件更新 · 更新设备 · 更新换代 upgrade a generation · 每周更新.
Both 'return to' and 'restore': 恢复正常/健康/体力 · 恢复秩序/联系/名誉 · 慢慢恢复过来 pull through. Recovering from illness specifically is 康复.
Physical labor and its institutions: 体力/脑力劳动 · 劳动力 workforce · 劳动合同/法 · 劳动节. As a verb it is intransitive: 在田里劳动. Everyday work is 工作.
Noun 'grounds': 有科学依据 · 毫无依据 baseless · 以事实为依据. Also a formal preposition: 依据法律/合同办事 — 根据 is the everyday equivalent.
Neutral in technical use: 技术/管理手段 · 通过法律手段. Of a person it often turns negative: 耍手段 play tricks · 不择手段 by any means. A way of doing something is 方法.
Takes what you enjoy as an object: 享受生活/美食/阳光 · 享受优惠/待遇/服务 (entitlements too). Noun: 这是一种享受. Habitual 'enjoy doing' is 喜欢.
Three jobs: predicate — 经验/资金/信心不足; noun — 不足之处 shortcomings, 弥补不足; and 'fewer than' before a number — 不足2000元. Also 不足以说明问题.
The business-relationship customer: 接待客户 · 客户服务/需求 · 大客户/老客户. A shopper in a store is 顾客; the market-level consumer is 消费者.
Signing up so you are on the books: 注册账号/用户 · 注册公司/商标 · 注册资本 · 注册会计师 CPA. Checking in or filing a marriage is 登记 (登记入住/结婚登记).
What it costs you to produce or do: 降低/控制成本 · 生产/人力/时间成本 · 成本高 · 成本价 at cost. 费用 is money actually paid out; 价格 is what the buyer pays.
Written causative: an event as subject, a clause as the result — 下雨使得我们取消了野餐 · 使得问题更复杂. A person telling someone to do something takes 让/叫.
Written variant of 或者, joining alternatives: A或是B · 或是…或是… either…or · 或是因为… . In a plain question the standard choice is 还是 (茶还是咖啡?).
Adverb supplying the decisive, concede-it reason: 毕竟他才十八岁 · 他毕竟是新人，别太苛刻 · 这毕竟是小事. Sits before or after the subject.
冠 reads guàn here, the 'crown' verb reading. 获得/拿到/夺得冠军 win the title · 世界冠军 · 卫冕冠军 defending champion. Second and third are 亚军, 季军.
Formal counterpart of plain 拍: 拍摄电影/电视剧/纪录片/照片 · 拍摄现场 the set · 正在拍摄中. In speech you just say 拍照/拍片子.
Mostly a noun: 造成/带来损失 · 经济损失 · 损失惨重 heavy losses · 挽回损失 recoup. As a verb it takes the amount: 损失了三万块. Mislaying an object is 丢.
Two uses: stiff self-reference in writing or formal speech — 本人认为/本人同意; and 'the person himself' after a noun — 需要本人到场 must appear in person · 我见过他本人.
Verb-object: 垃圾分类 waste sorting · 按用途分类 · 分类整理/管理 · 分好类. Also a noun: 这个分类不合理.
The verb is 发生: 昨晚发生了地震 — or 地震 acts as one itself: 地震了! Magnitude takes 级: 六级地震. 余震 aftershock · 震区 · 抗震 quake-resistant.
Showing something to an audience: 向我们展示商品 · 展示才华/实力/成果 · 展示柜/展示台. An exhibition as an event is 展览; a screen or data showing something is 显示.
Written connective heading the result clause: 下雨了，因而我们没出门 · 由于…，因而… . Interchangeable with 因此 in most places; the spoken default is 所以.
News-and-report register: 当前形势/任务/问题 · 当前的国际环境. Also stands alone as a time word: 当前，最重要的是… . Everyday 'now' is 现在, or 目前 which sits closest.
Object is a physical structure: 建造桥梁/大坝/船只/房屋 · 是五年前建造的. 建设 is developing a country, city or system; 盖 is the spoken word for putting up a house.
Two strands: mastery — 掌握技术/方法/一门外语; and control — 掌握大权/主动权 · 掌握第一手资料. It implies you can now use it, where 学 is only studying.
Gathering scattered things together: 收集资料/信息/证据/邮票/意见. 搜集 is the same act with more hunting; collecting as a hobby is 收藏 (收藏品/收藏家).
Closes the introducing sentence, right before the colon: 注意事项如下： · 具体安排如下 · 内容如下. Its mirror is 如上/以上. Document register.
Adverb for events in sequence: 学生们先后走进教室 · 先后担任过… · 先后三次. As a noun it is the ordering itself: 先后顺序 · 排名不分先后 in no particular order.
Object is a capacity that can grow stronger: 增强体质/信心/免疫力/实力. 加强 covers measures and efforts (加强管理/合作/联系); raising a quantity is 增加 (增加收入).
Pastoral flavor: 乡村生活/风光 · 乡村音乐 country music · 乡村振兴 rural revitalization. 农村 is the neutral socio-economic term (农村人口); 乡下 is colloquial.
Interpersonal and two-way: 跟/与他沟通 · 沟通能力 · 沟通不畅/有障碍 · 好好沟通一下. It aims at mutual understanding; exchanging ideas or culture broadly is 交流.
The art or activity, not the single act: 对摄影有兴趣 · 摄影师/摄影展/摄影作品. Snapping a photo is 拍照/拍一张照片 — 摄影 takes no object.
Systematic searching: 搜索引擎 search engine · 在网上搜索 · 搜索逃犯/失踪者 · 搜索范围. Looking a fact up is 查; looking for a lost object is 找.
Adjective and noun both: 价格很优惠 · 优惠价/优惠券 coupon · 优惠政策 · 享受优惠. The act of cutting the price is 打折 (打八折 = 20% off).
Business-ledger word: 净利润 net profit · 利润率 margin · 利润上升/下降 · 追求利润. 收益 is the return you get; 利益 is 'interests' in the abstract.
Intransitive — 汽车开始加速 — and transitive with an abstract process: 加速发展/老化/衰退. For 速度/步伐 the usual partner is 加快. Physics: 加速度.
Two strands: taking pleasure in art or scenery — 欣赏风景/音乐/这幅作品; and thinking highly of a person — 我很欣赏他, often a senior about a junior.
Narrative and written: 此时窗外下起了大雨 · 此时此刻 at this very moment · 此时的他已经… . Speech uses 这时候. Pairs: 此前/此后.
Reciprocal, before the verb or as its object: 彼此信任/了解/帮助 · 为彼此着想 · 不分彼此 no mine-and-yours. Replying to a compliment: 彼此彼此 'likewise'.
Noun for the process or mode of thinking: 逻辑思维 · 思维方式 way of thinking · 思维能力 · 打开思维. 思想 is the content or ideology; 思维 is the machinery producing it.
The field itself: 跨学科 interdisciplinary · 基础学科 · 学科建设. A subject on a timetable or exam is 科目; the one you major in is 专业.
Before a verb = the whole way there: 一路聊天 · 一路小跑 · 一路上 along the way. Farewells 一路平安 · 一路顺风; 一路走好 is now mostly said to the dead.
The written cover-term for songs as a category: 流行歌曲 · 儿童歌曲 · 一首歌曲. Everyday talk shortens to 歌 — 唱歌 · 听歌 · 这首歌好听.
Takes its center directly, 着 optional: 围绕太阳转 · 围绕这个问题展开讨论 · 围绕…进行. The figurative 'center a discussion on' is the frequent one in writing.
A trainable practical skill you possess: 职业技能 · 生活技能 · 技能培训 · 掌握一门技能. 技巧 is the knack in doing something; 技术 leans toward technology.
Formal — pulling apart what was joined: 分离出杂质 · 血浆分离 · 骨肉分离 · 分离主义. For people simply parting ways, speech prefers 分开 or 各奔东西.
Attaches to a process that has phases: 创业初期 · 建国初期 · 初期症状. 初期 is the opening stretch of that process; 早期 is 'early' relative to a whole span.
The art form and genre: 戏剧学院 · 戏剧演出 · 现代戏剧. One individual play is 一出戏 or 话剧; 'dramatic' in the figurative sense is 戏剧性(的).
不幸的是 unfortunately · 不幸遇难/去世 (formal 'died') · 遭遇不幸 · 不幸中的万幸 a blessing in the mishap. It names real misfortune; everyday bad luck is 倒霉.
Modifies something with a long span: 早期作品 · 早期人类 · 癌症早期. Medical set phrase 早期发现，早期治疗. Compare 初期, the opening stretch of one process.
Objects are abstract: 损害健康 · 损害利益 · 损害名誉/形象/关系. Breaking a physical thing is 损坏 (损坏公物); hurting a person or their feelings is 伤害.
Double object: 奖励他一台电脑 reward him with X · 奖励制度 · 物质奖励 · 以示奖励. Praise alone is 表扬; the cash itself is 奖金, the prize won is 奖.
Breeds and cultivars, and product lines in a shop: 优良品种 · 新品种 · 品种繁多/齐全. Looser 'kinds of things' is 种类; 品种 implies a bred or selected variety.
把…传递给…: objects are things passed along a chain — 传递信息/消息 · 传递能量 · 传递正能量 · 传递火炬. Handing an object over face to face is 递给.
Intransitive; the thing that rises is the subject: 物价/房价上涨 · 水位上涨 · 上涨了两成. You raise something with 提高/上调; the V-O version is 涨价.
Two lives: craftsmanship (传统工艺 · 工艺精湛) and industrial process (生产工艺 · 工艺流程 · 工艺水平). A handicraft object itself is 工艺品.
Bracketing frame 包括…在内, always trailing the noun: 包括我在内共十人 · 连运费在内 · 算上他在内. Negative is 不包括…在内.
Written-register 'from that point on', pointing back to a time just mentioned: 此后再也没有 · 此后的十年. Speech says 后来 or 从那以后; for time still ahead, 今后.
Mostly a modifier or stance adverb: 总体来说/总体上 on the whole · 总体规划 · 总体水平. A plain arithmetic total is 总数; 整体 is the whole treated as one unit.
Joint access to a resource: 共享资源/数据/文件 · 资源共享 · 共享单车/经济. Telling others your experience or handing out a portion is 分享 (分享心得, 分享蛋糕).
Qualitative difference between two things: 有/没有差别 · 差别很大 · 差别对待 discriminate. 差距 is a measurable gap that one side is behind on.
对…敏感 be sensitive or allergic to: 对花粉敏感 · 敏感话题/问题 · 敏感时期 · 敏感肌. Of a person it means touchy; being perceptive is 敏锐.
Neutral tone mǎimai = a business or deal: 做买卖 · 一笔买卖 · 小本买卖. Full tone mǎimài is literal buying and selling: 买卖双方 · 买卖股票. Everyday twin: 生意.
Mostly the event as a noun: 举办/参观展览 · 展览会 · 展览馆. As a verb an institution does it (作品在国博展览); putting individual items on show is 展出/展示.
Written simile, usually closed with 一样/一般: 如同阳光一样温暖 · 如同置身梦中. Speech says 就像…一样. 正如 is different — it cites what someone said.
Measure 件: 一件大事 · 出了大事. 人生大事 usually means marriage · 国家大事 · 大事化小，小事化了 play it down · 干大事.
Your standing frame of mind, not a passing mood: 调整/放平心态 · 心态好 · 心态崩了 lose it · 平和的心态. A momentary mood is 情绪.
Of manner and of matters: 表情严肃 · 严肃的话题 · 严肃对待. Verb-ish uses: 严肃处理 punish sternly · 严肃纪律. Being conscientious about a task is 认真.
Adverbial before the verb, often encouragement: 你大胆说 · 大胆地提出 · 大胆尝试 · 大胆假设，小心求证. Of a person it can tip into brazen (好大的胆子).
Opens a clause citing someone or a truism: 正如妈妈说的 · 正如你所说 · 正如人们常说的那样. Written; comparing two things is 如同/就像 instead.
The wrapping and the act both: 包装礼物 · 包装纸/盒 · 过度包装 · 精美的包装. The marketing sense is live: 把新人包装成偶像 package or hype someone.
Usually a criticism — one kind only, no variety: 品种/形式单一 · 收入来源单一 · 结构单一. Neutral 'the only one' is 唯一; 'a single item' is 单个.
A measurable gap where one side lags: 缩小/拉大差距 · 与先进水平还有差距 · 差距明显. A neutral difference in kind is 差别.
A noun — the count itself: 学生总数 · 总数超过五百 · 总数的一半. 'In all' as an adverb is 一共/总共; bulk amount rather than headcount is 总量.
Always takes an object, and an abstract one: 注重质量/细节/效率 · 注重培养能力. 重视 overlaps but also takes people and concrete things (重视人才).
Three uses: physically top-and-bottom (上下打量 look sb over) · after a quantity = roughly (三十岁上下 · 一千块上下) · a whole hierarchy (全公司上下).
Intransitive — the event is the subject: 展览会今天开幕 · 隆重开幕 · 开幕词/开幕式. It closes with 闭幕. A shop opening for business is 开业/开张.
Mostly abstract force: 有力的证据/理由 · 强有力的支持 · 有力地推动/回击. Having physical strength in you is 有力气 (我没力气了).
Labor as an input you spend: 投入人力 · 人力成本/资源 · 人力物力财力 · 节省人力. Also 'human-powered': 人力车. HR is 人力资源部, often just 人力.
Attributive and institutional: 不良习惯/嗜好 · 不良影响 · 不良反应 side effect · 不良记录 · 不良资产 bad debt. As a plain predicate people just say 不好.
Takes a clause or the thing griped about: 抱怨工作太累 · 向我抱怨 · 别抱怨了. Blaming a person for a fault is 埋怨; a formal complaint to a company is 投诉.
The industrial process: 印刷厂/机 · 印刷术 · 印刷品 printed matter · 彩色印刷. Running a file through your own printer is 打印.
Intensity as a measured level: 劳动/训练强度 · 高强度工作 · 强度大 · 地震强度. Materials too: 钢材强度. A person's own strength is 力量/体力.
Clinical and figurative organ word: 大脑发育 · 大脑一片空白 mind went blank · 用大脑思考. Everyday 'brains, head' is 脑子 — 动动脑子 · 脑子不好使.
Normally paired with 谈, and separable: 谈恋爱 · 谈了三年恋爱 · 恋爱关系 · 自由恋爱 · 恋爱中. On its own, 他们恋爱了 = they got together.
Mention: 提起这件事 · 别提起他. Also literal lifting (提起行李) and set uses 提起精神 buck up · 提起诉讼 file suit. Raising a topic for decision is 提出.
Recycling and recouping both: 回收利用 · 废品回收 · 垃圾回收 · 回收站 recycle bin · 回收成本 recoup an investment. Sorting trash at home is 垃圾分类.
Frame 对…不利: 这对我们很不利 · 不利因素/影响/条件 · 处于不利地位 · 形势不利. Formal variant 于…不利. Compare 不良, which only sits before nouns.
Changes to an arrangement, often a noun: 人事变动 · 价格有变动 · 略有变动 · 稍作变动. Things changing on their own is 变化; you changing them is 改变.
Verb-object, so it splits: 报了警 · 报个警 · 我去报警. Also machine alarms: 报警器 · 系统报警. Dialing is 打110; filing the case with police is 报案.
Formal 'replace with a new one': 更换电池/零件/设备 · 更换密码 · 定期更换. Speech just says 换 (换个新的); swapping between two parties is 交换.
Visual and conceptual: 照片模糊 · 模糊不清 · 记忆变得模糊 · 概念模糊. Also transitive — 模糊了两者的界限 blur the line. Deliberate vagueness is 含糊其辞.
An unforced slip while performing something: 工作失误 · 判断失误 · 出现失误 · 一次小失误. 错误 is a wrong answer or idea; 失败 is the whole attempt failing.
停留在… is the frequent shape, often figurative: 还停留在过去 · 不能停留在口头上 · 短暂停留 · 停留两天. A vehicle halting is 停 or 停靠.
Almost always a modifier: 休闲服/鞋 casual clothes · 休闲食品 snacks · 休闲娱乐 · 休闲时光 · 休闲农业. Relaxing as an action is 放松/休息.
Being physically at the scene when it happened: 当时他在场 · 在场的人 · 不在场证明 alibi. Attending an event is 出席/到场.
Physical and figurative: 拥抱他一下 · 相互拥抱 · 给你一个拥抱 (noun too) · 热情拥抱 · 拥抱变化/新技术 embrace.
Chiefly a noun — money on deposit: 一笔存款 · 银行/定期存款 · 存款利息 · 有多少存款. The action is usually said 存钱 — 把工资存进银行 · 存了三千块.
Attributive: 原有的计划/基础/制度/规模 · 在原有基础上 · 保留原有风貌. To say a thing existed before, use 本来就有 or 原来的.
An authority urging a practice; the object is a behavior: 提倡节约 · 学校提倡穿校服 · 提倡文明出行. Personally arguing a position is 主张; formal twin 倡导.
Written flavor: 交通便利 · 便利店 · 便利条件 · 为群众提供便利. Everyday speech uses 方便, which also asks about availability (你什么时候方便?).
For infrastructure: 修建公路/铁路/水库/机场/长城. A house you 盖 or 建; fixing something broken is 修/修理; abstract nation-building is 建设.
Adverb before the verb, slightly literary: 时常想起 · 时常出现 · 时常联系. The neutral everyday word is 经常; negation goes to 不常 or 很少.
Math and formal writing: 三大于二 · 大于等于 ≥ · 远大于 · 不大于. Ordinary comparison in speech uses 比 — 他比我高.
Frame 对…有害: 吸烟对健康有害 · 有害物质/气体 · 有害垃圾 hazardous waste. Formal variant 有害于. The opposite pattern is 对…有益.
Resigned helplessness: 感到很无奈 · 无奈之下 having no choice · 出于无奈 · 万般无奈 · 无奈地笑了笑. In writing it can also link clauses: 'but unfortunately'.
By chance, not by schedule: 偶然发现 · 一次偶然的机会 · 纯属偶然 · 偶然性. Don't blend it with 偶尔 'once in a while' (我偶尔去) — that one is frequency.
Place word sitting after the noun: 房子四周 · 环顾四周 look around · 四周都是树 · 四周静悄悄. The same string also reads 'four weeks' — 四周后.
Formal time word for notices, forecasts and schedules: 夜间施工 · 夜间航班/门诊 · 夜间气温. Everyday speech says 晚上 or 夜里.
Paired against 客观: 主观看法/判断/意愿 · 主观上 · 主观努力 · 主观能动性. Aimed at a person it means jumping to conclusions from your own view — 你太主观了.
Of supply on hand: 睡眠/阳光/雨水/资金/原料充足 · 供应充足 · 准备充足. Its abstract twin 充分 owns 充分利用 · 充分准备 · 充分理由.
Two lives: literal direction (向上滑动 swipe up · 向上生长) and character praise (积极向上 · 健康向上的年轻人). Reporting upward spells it out: 向上级汇报.
Emergency, against the clock: 抢救病人/伤员 · 全力抢救 · 抢救无效 (the phrase in death notices) · 抢救文物. General rescue from danger is 救 or 营救.
Grooming the whole look: 打扮得很漂亮 · 精心打扮 · 打扮成小丑 dress up as · 她的打扮 her getup (noun). Face makeup alone is 化妆.
Same sound as 必须, different job: 必需 hangs on nouns — 生活必需品 · 必需的证件/条件. 必须 is the adverb before a verb (你必须去). If a verb follows, it's 必须.
体力活 manual work · 体力劳动 · 消耗/恢复体力 · 体力不支 give out from exhaustion. Momentary muscular force is 力气 (没力气了); 体力 is the reserve you spend.
Nearly always the ambient light of a place: 光线好/暗/柔和 · 光线充足/不足. A beam you aim is 光束; sunlight is 阳光.
练书法 practice calligraphy · 学书法 · 书法家 · 一幅书法作品 · 书法展. Doing it in the moment is usually 写毛笔字.
Antonym of 积极 in both senses: unwilling (消极对待 · 消极怠工 work-to-rule) and harmful (消极影响/因素/情绪). A person feeling low is 情绪低落.
把汤加热一下 · 用微波炉加热 · 加热到八十度 · 加热食物. In the kitchen people just say 热一下 (热剩菜); 加热 is instruction-manual register.
喝中药 (it comes as a decoction) · 抓中药 fill a herbal prescription · 中药材 · 中成药 · 吃中药调理. 中医 is the discipline and the doctor; 中药 is the drugs.
Restaurant default: 剩菜打包 · 帮我打包 · 打包带走 takeaway. Separable: 打个包 · 打包好了. Extended to bundling — 打包下载 · 打包出售.
Adverb of manner = on the sly, not merely softly: 悄悄告诉你 · 悄悄溜走 · 悄悄地走近. 静悄悄 describes a place being still (屋里静悄悄的), a state not an act.
Verb-object and intransitive — the goods are the subject: 猪肉涨价了 · 又涨价了 · 涨了两次价. To name an amount switch to 涨了两块 or to 上涨.
Collective and slightly formal: 儿女双全 · 儿女情长 romantic sentiment · 中华儿女 sons and daughters of the nation. Your own kids day to day are 孩子.
Literal moisture: 补充水分 stay hydrated · 水分流失 · 含水分高. The figurative sense is common in news — 这份数据有水分 padded · 挤掉水分 squeeze out the fluff.
A standing trait, mostly about study and work: 勤奋学习 · 勤奋好学 · 勤奋刻苦 · 工作勤奋. 努力 is effort on a given occasion; 勤奋 is what a person is like.
Jan 1 on the solar calendar, a one-day holiday: 元旦快乐 · 元旦假期 · 元旦晚会. Lunar new year is 春节/过年, and 新年 can mean either.
扫二维码 or just 扫码 is the verb: 扫一下二维码 · 扫码支付/点餐 · 生成/识别二维码. The old striped barcode is 条形码/条码.
Degree complement after 得: 热得不得了 · 高兴得不得了 · 疼得不得了. Alone it is alarm — 不得了了，着火了! Related: 没什么大不了的 no big deal.
Measure 把: 一把扇子. To use one, 扇扇子 — the verb 扇 reads shān: 扇扇子 · 扇风 · 扇火. An electric fan is 电风扇/风扇.
交押金 pay a deposit · 退押金 get it refunded · 押一付三 (rental shorthand). It is refundable; earnest money on a purchase is 定金, and 首付 is the down payment.
Colloquial 子-form: in writing you'd see 水池 · 游泳池 · 池塘. 池子 is the spoken word for whichever basin or pool is in front of you.
Institutional register, the category rather than an individual: 妇女节 · 妇女权益 · 妇女儿童 · 农村妇女. To or about a specific person, speech uses 女的/女士/女性.
Verb takes the person: 他威胁我 · 威胁说要报警. Noun frames: 受到威胁 · 对国家安全构成威胁 · 一大威胁. Non-human sources work too — 洪水威胁着村庄.
Measure 支 or 个: 一支团队 · 团队合作/精神 · 研发团队 · 团队建设 team-building. A working subgroup is 小组; the old socialist 'collective' is 集体.
Elevated and bound to what follows: 中华民族 · 中华文化/文明 · 中华人民共和国 · 中华儿女 · 振兴中华. The ordinary country name in a modern sentence is 中国.
One contributing cause among several: 主要/客观/不确定因素 · 影响…的因素 · 考虑各种因素 · 因素之一. A single cause is 原因; a component of a substance is 成分.
Written superlative, sits before the noun: 最佳时间/时机 · 最佳选择/方案 · 最佳状态 · 最佳男主角 Best Actor. Speech just says 最好的.
Business-and-diaspora flavor: 海外市场/业务 · 海外华人 · 海外投资 · 海外版. Plain 'abroad' in speech is 国外 (去国外); the customs term is 境外.
Objects are levels and qualities: 提升能力/水平/效率/用户体验 · 提升为经理 be promoted. 提高 overlaps almost entirely; 提升 is the newer, more corporate choice.
Mostly noun or modifier: 娱乐活动/节目/设施 · 娱乐圈 showbiz · 休闲娱乐. As a verb: 娱乐大众 entertain the public · 娱乐一下 · 自娱自乐.
A live mood you can lose or control: 情绪激动/低落 · 控制/稳定情绪 · 闹情绪 sulk · 带着情绪 in a huff. A lasting outlook is 心态; feeling toward someone is 感情.
Verb-object, separable: 升了一级. Three uses — software (系统升级 · 升级到最新版), grade or rank, and escalation (矛盾/冲突升级). Objects go via 把.
Chiefly a noun: 社会实践 · 实践经验 · 在实践中 · 理论与实践相结合. As a verb it takes ideals — 实践诺言/理想. Everyday practising a skill is 练习.
打造/树立品牌 build a brand · 品牌形象/效应/价值 · 国产品牌 · 大品牌. A prestige label is 名牌 (名牌包); casually asking which brand, people say 牌子.
Consulting a professional: 咨询律师/医生 · 向公司咨询 · 咨询一下. Noun side: 咨询公司/服务/热线 · 心理咨询. Plain asking is 问; asking a senior is 请教.
City residents as a public: 广大市民 · 市民生活 · 全体市民 · 市民热线. 公民 is a citizen with legal rights; 居民 is a resident of any area (小区居民).
Attributive only — one and the same instance: 同一个班 · 同一天/时间 · 同一水平线上 · 同一目标. Saying two things are alike is predicative 一样/相同.
You start something others then join: 发起活动/募捐/倡议 · 发起进攻/挑战 · 发起人 initiator. Founding a business is 创办; convening a meeting is 召开.
Here as opposed to elsewhere: 本地人 · 本地产的 · 本地口音/特产. Tech sense is live: 本地文件/存储 (vs 云端). 当地 is 'there' when you narrate about another place.
总部设在北京 — the verb is 设(在) · 公司/集团总部 · 总部大楼 · 全球总部. Branches are 分公司/分部; a local office is 办事处.
本质上 essentially · 本质区别 · 问题的本质 · 透过现象看本质. 实质 overlaps for the real substance of a matter; 性质 is what type a thing is (问题的性质).
Physical output in units: 提高/增加产量 · 年产量 · 粮食产量 · 产量下降. Output measured in money is 产值; the capacity to produce is 产能.
Deep wisdom, not quick wits: 人类的智慧 · 智慧的结晶 · 充满智慧 · 集体智慧. Being clever is 聪明. New tech sense: 智慧城市/医疗/交通 = 'smart'.
Noun and verb both: 保持/失去平衡 · 打破平衡 · 平衡工作和生活 balance two things · 收支平衡 break even · 心理不平衡 feel hard done by.
Paired with 内部, and abstract: 外部环境/因素/条件 · 外部世界 · 对外部开放. The physical outside of a building, or 'outside' in speech, is 外面/外边.
动画片 is the cartoon you watch; 动画 alone is the medium — 动画电影 · 三维/二维动画 · 动画制作/效果. Japanese anime in fan talk is 动漫/番剧.
Quantifier before a noun, for things arriving in consignments or crowds: 大批货物/游客/订单/难民. 大量 is the general 'a large amount' and takes uncountables.
和/与…互动: 和学生互动 · 互动交流 · 增加互动 · 互动性强 · 良好的互动. 交流 is exchanging ideas; 互动 stresses the back-and-forth of participation.
Frame 跟/与…无关: 这跟你无关 · 与本案无关. Set uses 无关紧要 of no consequence · 无关人员 unauthorized persons. The mirror image is 与…有关.
Formal, in welcomes and notices, for motion toward where the speaker is: 欢迎前来参观 · 前来参加/领取/办理. Going the other way is 前往 (前往北京).
Modifier before nouns, or in 是…的: 优质产品/服务/资源 · 优质教育 · 优质蛋白. Plain 'the quality is good' is 质量好; the opposite label is 劣质.
Attributive: 全新的手机/体验/开始/面貌. It stresses a break with what came before, so 全新的生活 works as easily as an unopened product. 崭新 is about physical newness.
What something is made of: 主要成分 · 化学成分 · 营养成分表 · 成分复杂 (of a group, mixed backgrounds). One cause among several is 因素; a physical part is 零件/部分.
Two worlds off one word: a rookie (部门新人 · 培养新人 · 新人奖) and the couple at a wedding (新人入场 · 一对新人). Context alone separates them.
Two shapes: 富有 + abstract noun = full of — 富有经验/想象力/挑战性/感染力. Standing alone it means wealthy (富有的家庭); speech says 有钱.
讲信用/守信用 be good for your word · 信用卡/记录/评分 · 信用良好 · 失去信用. Trust between people as a feeling is 信任 (我信任他).
Dealing with something coming at you: 应对挑战/危机/突发情况 · 从容应对 · 应对措施/能力/方案. Answering a question is 回答; handling a task is 处理.
Adverb before institutional verbs: 大力支持/推广/发展/宣传/整治. The subject is nearly always a government or organization; a person trying hard is 努力.
Formal handing-in, upward or to a body: 提交申请/材料/报告 · 提交给委员会 · 提交审议 · 提交代码 commit. Turning in homework is 交 or 上交.
A countable noun more than an adjective: 给你一个惊喜 · 惊喜派对/礼物 · 充满惊喜. Pleasant only — an unpleasant shock is 吃惊/震惊, plain surprise is 意外.
Two uses: the midpoint of a span (项目中期 · 九十年代中期) and 'medium-term' in the 短期/中期/长期 series. Careful — a school mid-term exam is 期中考试.
Turning a channel on: 地铁/航线开通 · 开通业务/服务/会员/账号 · 开通网上银行. Also of a person's outlook: 思想开通 open-minded.
Technical taking-in: 接收信号/文件/邮件 · 接收难民/转学生 · 接收资产 take over. 接受 is accepting in the mind or socially — 接受意见/邀请/现实.
Adverb right before the verb, about a standing habit: 她从不喝酒 · 从不迟到. For never-yet-experienced use 从没…过 (我从没去过). 从来不 is equally normal.
Of documents and of attempts: 合同/证件/优惠券无效 · 宣布无效 · 治疗无效 · 无效劳动 wasted effort. Opposite 有效; losing validity you once had is 失效.
Institutional trade word for books as stock: 图书馆 · 图书销售/出版 · 图书管理员 · 电子图书. A book you're reading is 一本书; the written collective is 书籍.
Written anaphor pointing back before a stated moment: 此前从未出过国 · 此前的报道 · 在此之前. Speech uses 之前 or 以前; its partner in narrative is 此后.
Adverbial before the verb: 全力支持/配合/推进 · 全力以赴 give it everything · 尽全力/竭尽全力. The noun for stamina you actually have is 力气/精力.
Two jobs: coincidence (车刚好来了 · 刚好碰到他) and exact fit (大小刚好 · 刚好一百块). 正好 swaps in for nearly all of these; 刚才 'a moment ago' is a different word.
The built-up part of a city, in administrative talk: 老城区 · 城区人口 · 城区改造. For 'downtown, in town' people say 市区; the fringe is 郊区.
Written 'as if', before the verb: 仿佛回到了童年 · 仿佛什么都没发生过 · 仿佛…一般/似的. Speech says 好像…似的; 仿佛 carries a literary tinge.
Of manufactured things and buildings: 外观设计 · 外观漂亮/时尚 · 从外观上看 · 外观检查. A person's looks are 外表/长相, or 外貌 in formal writing.
Fixed coordinate pair, attributive or adverbial: 中外合资/合作 · 中外文化交流 · 闻名中外 famous at home and abroad · 古今中外 in all times and places.
Event-and-broadcast register: 特邀嘉宾 · 神秘嘉宾 · 嘉宾席 · 邀请嘉宾 · 现场嘉宾. A guest in your home, or at a hotel, is 客人.
Objects are relationships and wellbeing: 增进了解/友谊/感情/互信 · 增进食欲/健康. Raising a quantity is 增加; raising a level or standard is 提高.
Formal and approving, always followed by a verb phrase: 敢于创新 · 敢于承担责任 · 敢于说真话 · 敢于挑战. Plain 敢 handles everyday daring (我不敢去 · 你敢吗).
Intransitive; the subject is a situation: 病情/形势/经济/关系好转 · 有所好转 · 明显好转. A person recovering is 好起来 or 康复; 转好 is the same idea reversed.
Object is the person or the flow: 打断别人说话 · 别打断我 · 思路被打断 lost my train of thought. The literal sense survives too — 打断腿 break a leg (as a threat).
下暴雨 (the verb is 下) · 一场暴雨 · 暴雨预警 · 暴雨红色预警 · 特大暴雨. It's a graded weather-service term one step above 大雨, not just any heavy rain.
Separable: 低下头 · 低着头 · 低头看手机. Literal posture and figurative submission both: 向困难低头 · 决不低头. Its opposite in both senses is 抬头.
Modifier with a leisure-and-gear flavor: 户外运动/活动/装备 · 户外广告. The architectural opposite of 室内 is 室外 (室外温度); everyday 'outside' is 外面.
The uncooked grain you buy: 买大米 · 一袋大米 · 东北大米. Cooked rice on your plate is 米饭; the plant growing in the paddy is 水稻.
掌声雷动 · 热烈的掌声 · 一阵掌声 · 掌声响起 · 用掌声欢迎 · 报以掌声. The act of clapping is 鼓掌 (大家鼓掌); 掌声 is the sound it makes.
Time word — stands adverbially with no preposition: 傍晚出发 · 傍晚时分 · 到了傍晚. It's dusk, after 下午 and before 晚上.
Two senses: disposable (一次性筷子/杯子/口罩) and in one go (一次性付清 · 一次性补贴 · 一次性解决). It sits before the noun (with 的) or before the verb.
Trade word, short for 家用电器: 家电市场 · 家电城 · 大家电 (fridges, washers) vs 小家电 (kettles, blenders) · 智能家电. A single unit is 电器.
Verb-object and intransitive — the thing expiring is the subject: 会员/合同/签证到期 · 快到期了 · 到期日. Food going bad is 过期, which means you missed the date.
Notice-and-recording register: 请拨打客服热线 · 拨打120 · 拨打免费电话. In speech you 打电话 (给他打个电话); 拨 alone is the dialing motion (拨号).
The adverb sense is the useful one: 早晚会出事 · 早晚有一天 — sooner or later, usually warning of something bad; 迟早 is its twin. Literal: 早晚各一次 twice a day.
得了流感 catch flu · 流感疫苗/病毒 · 甲型流感 · 流感季. Short for 流行性感冒; an ordinary cold is plain 感冒, and medicine keeps the two apart.
发出响声 · 一阵响声 · 很大的响声 · 传来响声. It's an unidentified noise you hear — sound in general is 声音, and unwanted din is 噪音.
Potential complement taking an object or clause: 我受不了他 · 受不了这个天气. Also a degree complement: 疼得受不了 unbearably. Positive form 受得了 (你受得了吗).
和 goes neutral: nuǎnhuo. Of weather, rooms and clothes — 天气暖和 · 屋里很暖和 · 穿得暖和点. Reduplicated it's a verb: 进来暖和暖和. For food or water use 热/温.
Adverb before the verb — on the prescribed schedule: 按时吃药/完成/交作业 · 按时上下班. Being on the dot for an appointment is 准时; doing it promptly enough is 及时.
Of temperament and of style: 活泼开朗 · 天真活泼 · 生动活泼 (of writing or a meeting) · 气氛活泼. Mostly said of children and young people. Chemistry: 性质活泼 reactive.
The verb is 放: 放寒假 school lets out · 寒假作业 · 寒假期间 · 过寒假. Summer is 暑假; a working adult's time off is 假期/休假.
Wants a manner phrase alongside it: 认真/严肃对待 · 对待客人很友好 · 区别对待 treat differently. It's about attitude; handling a task is 处理, and pay-and-conditions is 待遇.
The result is its object: 形成习惯/共识/规模/对比 · 逐渐形成. What does the forming is marked 由…形成. Causing a bad result is 造成; making up a whole is 构成.
Colloquial and separable: 干了一天活儿 · 干重活儿 · 有活儿干 · 一起干活儿. It's hands-on work; office employment is 上班/工作. 活儿 alone = the job (这活儿不好干).
Duration goes after it: 迟到了十分钟 · 上班/上课迟到 · 迟到早退 late in, early out. Missing a bus you failed to catch is 没赶上; transport running behind is 晚点.
Marks the end point, and the main clause usually carries 才: 直到深夜才回家 · 直到现在才明白 · 直到今天 up to today. Spoken variant 一直到.
School-calendar word: 期末考试/成绩/论文 · 到了期末. Mid-term is 期中 (期中考试), and the term itself is 学期. Note 末期 is different — the terminal stage of an illness or era.
For messages, not questions: 回复邮件/消息/评论 · 等你的回复 · 一直没回复. Answering a question asked aloud is 回答; an organization's official reply is 答复.
Two frames: 熟悉这里的情况 (direct object) and 对…熟悉 (我对这个不熟悉). Of people it's acquaintance — 我们很熟悉, or in speech just 很熟. Being skilled is 熟练.
An authority making information public: 公布成绩/名单/数据/政策. 宣布 is declaring a decision (宣布开会/结束); 发布 is issuing something new (发布新产品/公告).
Separable: 道个歉 · 道了三次歉. The person owed it takes 向 or 跟 — 向他道歉 · 跟你道歉 · 公开道歉. What you actually utter is 对不起/抱歉.
Watch the string: 发表演讲 parses as 发表+演讲 (give a speech), not 表演. Real uses: 表演节目 · 精彩的表演 · 现场表演 · 表演者. Also faking it — 他在表演.
按顺序 in order · 先后顺序 · 排列顺序 · 打乱顺序 · 顺序颠倒了. It's the sequence itself; public order is 秩序 (维持秩序), a different word.
Machines and hardware: 修理机器/汽车/水管 · 修理工/厂. Speech shortens to 修 (修车 · 修一下). Slang 修理他一顿 teach him a lesson. Fixing a text or plan is 修改.
Takes a verb, not just a noun: 值得一看 · 值得注意 · 值得一提的是… · 不值得. With a noun it means 'deserves': 值得信任/表扬.
Colloquial, about what a thing costs you: 价钱贵/便宜 · 讲价钱 haggle. 价格 is the formal written term (价格上涨), 物价 the general price level.
Congratulating a person on something: 祝贺你毕业 · 向你表示祝贺 · 祝贺信. Speech prefers 恭喜; 庆祝 takes the occasion as object, not the person.
Short for 环境保护. Mostly attributive: 环保袋 · 环保意识 · 环保部门. As a predicate it wants a degree word: 更/很环保.
戴眼镜 wear (not 穿) · 一副眼镜 · 戴上/摘下 · 隐形眼镜 contacts · 墨镜 sunglasses. Distinct from 眼睛 yǎnjing 'eyes'.
Whoever is aboard a vehicle: 车上的乘客 · 乘客须知 · 提醒乘客. 旅客 is the traveler in transit at a station; 游客 the sightseer.
Formal/written, before the verb: 火车将要出发 · 将要举行. Bare 将 is the commoner written form; speech says 快…了 or 要…了.
推迟到下周 push back to · 推迟一个星期 by a week · 婚礼推迟了. Neutral scheduling word; 拖延 is blameworthy foot-dragging, 延长 extends a length.
考试分数 · 分数高/低 · 分数线 the cut-off score · 平均分. 成绩 is the broader 'results'. In math the same word is a 'fraction': 三分之一.
Goes after the noun: 桌子底下 · 树底下 · 在太阳底下. Swaps with 下面 in most spots; colloquially also 'next': 底下再说. Neutral tone dǐxia.
Adverb before the verb, usually with 都/是: 到处都是人 · 到处乱扔 · 到处找他. 处处 is the more literary, emphatic twin.
Modern spoken-word theater, as against sung 戏曲/京剧: 一场话剧 · 看话剧 · 话剧团/演员. 戏剧 is drama as an art form generally.
Written-register 有, with an abstract, modified object: 有着悠久的历史 · 有着密切的联系 · 有着重要作用. Plain possession stays 有; negation is 没有.
Formal, and it heads a noun: 众多的博物馆 · 众多读者 · 众多因素之一. For 'there are many' as a predicate, say 博物馆很多.
Colloquial 不但/不仅, paired the same way: 不光是你 · 不光…还/也…. 不仅 dominates in writing; 不光 sounds spoken.
The number follows: 零下五度 · 零下二十摄氏度 · 降到零下. Above zero is 零上, or just the plain number.
Abstract driving-forward, object is a process: 推动经济发展 · 推动改革 · 起推动作用. Physical pushing is 推; 促进 is the gentler 'facilitate'.
Head of anything ending in 院: 医院院长 · 学院院长 dean · 法院院长. Used as a title after the surname: 王院长 · 副院长.
菜式很多样 · 多种多样 all kinds of · 多样化 diversify · 多样性 diversity · 形式多样. Before a noun, 各种各样的 is the everyday choice.
Scientific/label register; everyday speech says 公斤 for the same amount, or 斤 = half a kilo. 五千克 · 每千克…元 · 克 = gram.
Works both ways: 会议结束了 (it ends) and 结束会议/结束这段关系 (end it). 结束语 closing remarks. For 'finish doing', use the complement 完: 看完、写完.
Concessive, answered by 但是/还是/仍然: 尽管天气不好，他们还是去了. Separately an adverb 'go right ahead': 有事尽管说 · 尽管用. 不管 is a different word.
Noun first: 问题的关键 the crux · 关键在于… · 关键是…. Attributive without 的: 关键时刻 · 关键人物 · 关键词 keyword.
Emotion running high — excitement or agitation, not anger: 很激动 · 激动得说不出话 · 激动人心 thrilling · 别激动 calm down. 兴奋 is happy excitement.
Two-way exchange, usually 和/跟…交流: 和他交流 · 交流经验/意见 · 文化交流. 交换 is swapping concrete things (交换名片).
Wants a small-quantity word after the verb or adjective: 稍微有点儿咸 · 稍微等一下 · 稍微改一改. 有点儿 alone carries a complaint; 稍微 stays neutral.
Chiefly a noun: 有耐心 · 没耐心 · 失去耐心. As a manner adverb it needs 地: 耐心地等待/解释. 耐心点儿 = 'be patient!'
Separable: 排了半天队 · 排两个小时的队. The purpose follows the whole phrase: 排队买票 · 排队上车. Cutting in is 插队.
填表格 fill in a form, or just 填表 · 一张表格 · 做个表格 make a table. The specific document is 申请表/报名表.
Only about speech and language: 说得很流利 · 一口流利的汉语 · 流利地朗读. A smooth process is 顺利; a practiced skill is 熟练.
Takes a clause or a fault: 承认错误 · 承认失败 · 我承认我错了 · 不得不承认. Also official recognition: 承认学历/政权. Confessing a crime is 坦白.
The object is the occasion, not the person: 庆祝生日 · 庆祝成立十周年 · 庆祝活动 · 为我庆祝. To congratulate someone it's 祝贺你/恭喜你.
Factory-scale making: 制造汽车 · 中国制造. Also stirring up abstractions: 制造麻烦/谣言/紧张气氛. Everyday making is 做; 创造 brings something new into being.
Attributive: 基本原则/条件/工资. As an adverb it means 'by and large': 基本完成了 · 基本上同意. 根本 is 'fundamental', and in the negative 'not at all'.
The stakes at play: 国家利益 · 切身利益 vital interests · 利益冲突 · 维护/损害利益. The accounting figure is 利润; the everyday perk is 好处.
Books and periodicals: 出版一本书 · 由…出版 · 出版社 publisher · 出版业. An article or a speech is 发表 instead.
The business entity in policy and economic talk: 国有/民营/外资企业 · 中小企业 · 企业家 · 企业文化. A specific named firm is 公司.
A school's sports ground, not a children's playground (that's 游乐场): 学校操场 · 在操场上跑步 · 操场集合.
读本科 · 本科生 · 本科毕业/学历 · 本科四年. Sits between 大专 junior college and 研究生 postgrad; the degree itself is 学士.
达成协议 reach one · 签(署)协议 · 协议书 · 和平/贸易协议. A binding commercial contract is 合同; 同意 is the verb 'agree'.
技术创新 · 创新能力/精神 · 鼓励创新 · 创新型企业. Watch the parse in 再创新高 — that is 创 + 新高 'hit a new high', not this word.
Noun: 实现理想 · 远大理想. Adjective 'ideal, satisfactory', often negated: 理想的工作 · 效果不太理想. 梦想 is the dream you may never reach.
Separable: 住了一个星期的院 · 住过院. 因骨折住院 · 住院费/手续 · 出院 be discharged.
Adverb with a bad flavor: 故意迟到 · 故意气我 · 不是故意的. For 'specially, going out of one's way' use 特意/专门: 特意来看你.
The traveler in transit: 旅客列车 · 旅客须知 · 站里挤满旅客. A sightseer is 游客; whoever is aboard the vehicle is 乘客.
A noun, so it pairs with 有/没: 很有礼貌 · 没礼貌 rude · 讲礼貌. As a modifier it needs 地/的: 礼貌地拒绝 · 礼貌用语. 客气 is surface politeness.
Read zháo: 着火了 · 房子着了火. The thing burning is the subject; setting a fire is 点火/放火. Same zháo in 着凉 catch cold, 着急.
The urban area as against 郊区 suburbs or 农村: 住在市区 · 市区内 · 开车进市区. The downtown point itself is 市中心.
Working something out with someone: 和他商量 · 商量一下 · 有商量的余地. 讨论 is a group on a topic, 协商 formal negotiation. Neutral tone shāngliang.
放暑假 be on/start summer break · 过暑假 · 暑假作业 · 暑假期间. 寒假 is the winter one; an adult's leave is 休假.
健身房 gym · 健身教练 · 健身器材 · 去健身. The everyday 'get exercise' is 锻炼(身体); 健美 is bodybuilding for looks.
The written round, paired with 面试 interview and 口试 oral: 笔试成绩 · 通过笔试 · 参加笔试.
A good quality of a person or thing: 他的优点是认真 · 优缺点 pros and cons. A competitive edge is 优势 (价格优势); a perk is 好处.
改正/克服缺点 · 优缺点 · 最大的缺点是…. For a person's habits the spoken word is 毛病; a product flaw is 缺陷; a shortage is 缺乏.
Two senses: eager/proactive (积极参加 · 工作积极 · 积极性 initiative) and 'positive' as against 消极 (积极作用/影响). Physically active is 活跃.
Transitive 'dislike' (我讨厌下雨) and adjective 'annoying' (这个人真讨厌 · 讨厌的天气). Milder than 恨; 烦 is the closest spoken twin.
Formal, and a verb must follow: 便于查找 · 便于携带 portable · 便于管理. 'Convenient for a person' is 方便: 这样对你方便吗?
内容与形式 · 各种形式 · 形式主义 going through the motions · 走个形式. Don't mix with its homophone 形势 'the situation, the trend' (国际形势).
Bringing something new into being: 创造条件/机会/奇迹 · 创造纪录 set a record · 创造性. 创作 is composing art; 制造 is manufacturing.
Polite, public register — signage and marketing: 男士专用 · 男士服装 · 各位女士、男士. Everyday talk uses 男的/男人; one person is 先生.
Transitive, often an exhortation: 远离毒品 · 远离危险 · 远离城市的喧嚣. Plain distance is 离…很远; simply leaving is 离开.
An attributive noun: 医疗条件/水平 · 医疗保险 · 医疗费用 · 医疗事故 · 医疗队. Treating a patient is 治疗/看病.
做/去体检 · 每年体检一次 · 体检报告 · 入职体检. Short for 体格检查; the everyday phrasing is 检查身体.
The lesson as a setting, not the room: 课堂上 in class · 课堂纪律/气氛 · 课堂练习. The physical room is 教室.
Noun 'inconvenience': 带来不便 · 给您带来不便，敬请谅解. Adjective: 行动不便 limited mobility. Also 'not in a position to': 不便透露.
Attaches to a named month: 三月份 · 几月份 · 月份牌. Durations and relative months drop it: 三个月 · 上个月 · 下个月.
Colloquial, chiefly the intercity coach: 坐大巴 · 大巴车 · 旅游大巴. City buses are 公交车; 中巴/小巴 are the smaller ones.
交学费 pay tuition · 学费上涨 · 减免学费. Figuratively 交学费 = paying for a costly lesson. Related money: 生活费, 报名费.
Sits after the subject, before the verb, flagging the speaker's surprise: 他竟然没来 · 你竟然给我打电话. 居然 is the near-twin; bare 竟 is written.
Takes an abstract standard: 符合要求/条件/标准 · 符合规定 · 符合事实 · 不符合. 适合 suits a person (这工作适合你); 合适 is the adjective.
The new circumstance is the object: 适应新环境/新工作 · 适应不了 can't get used to · 适应能力. 习惯 leans on habit; 适合 is 'be suitable for'.
Also a thank-you formula: 辛苦了 · 辛苦你了 · 让您辛苦了. As an adjective: 工作很辛苦 · 辛辛苦苦. 累 is being tired; 苦 is life being bitter.
Pattern 对…(要求)严格: 老板对我要求严格 · 严格要求自己 · 严格执行/遵守 · 严格来说 strictly speaking. Harsh in punishment is 严厉.
发脾气 lose one's temper · 脾气好/坏 · 脾气大 · 耍脾气 throw a tantrum. 性格 is the whole personality; 情绪 a passing mood.
Typically transitive, on a measurable level: 降低成本/价格/标准/风险 · 降低要求. 下降 is the usual intransitive fall (产量下降); cutting a price is 降价.
For abstractions: 失去信心/兴趣/机会 · 失去平衡 · 失去联系 · 失去亲人. A misplaced object is 丢了 (钱包丢了); losing a match is 输.
Coming into range of something: 和他接触 deal with · 接触新事物 be exposed to · 第一次接触. Getting in touch is 联系; touching physically is 碰/摸.
新闻/社交媒体 · 媒体报道 · 主流媒体 · 媒体人. Mass noun — one outlet is 一家媒体. 传媒 names the industry (传媒公司).
Before the verb, often with 地: 不断提高/增长/出现 · 不断地重复. Fixed tails: 源源不断 a steady stream · 连续不断. 一直 lacks the repeated-instances feel.
Two senses: your employer/organization (我们单位 · 事业单位 · 单位领导) and a unit of measure (计量单位 · 以…为单位). A firm is 公司, a department 部门.
Adverb only, before the verb: 忽然下起了大雨 · 忽然想起. 突然 covers the same ground but also modifies nouns and stands as predicate (突然的变化 · 太突然了).
Direction matters — letting out: 房子出租 · 出租给学生 · 出租广告. Taking a place is 租/租下. 出租车 taxi is a frozen compound.
Separable: 做了个梦 · 做过这样的梦 · 做噩梦 nightmare. What you dreamt of goes with 梦见/梦到. 别做梦了 = dream on; 梦想 is an aspiration.
Local to the place under discussion, usually somewhere other than here: 当地人/政府/居民 · 当地时间 · 当地风味. Where you yourself live is 本地.
召开/举行/参加/主持会议 · 会议室 · 会议记录 · 视频会议. For the plain act of meeting, the verb-object 开会 does the work: 我在开会.
