Conserving a resource, slogan register: 节约用水/用电 · 节约能源/成本/时间. 节省 sounds more everyday; plain 省 is the spoken one (省钱).
扔/倒垃圾 · 垃圾桶 · 垃圾分类 waste sorting. Also 'junk': 垃圾食品/邮件/短信, and slangily 太垃圾了 = rubbish, worthless.
Formal, and the object is an abstract achievement: 取得成绩/进展/成功 · 取得联系 · 取得资格. Physical getting is 拿/得到; 获得 is the written twin.
入学考试 entrance exam · 入学率 · 入学手续 · 六岁入学. Daily going-to-school is 上学; the term starting is 开学; registering on arrival is 报到.
Written register: 气温高于昨天 · 高于平均水平 · 高于市场价. Speech uses 比 (比昨天高). Same frame gives 低于/多于/少于/等于.
Listeners specifically — radio, a concert, a speech: 台下的听众 · 广播听众 · 一位听众. People watching are 观众; readers are 读者.
Corrects an impression the listener may hold: 其实不是这样 · 我其实不想去. It can sit before or after the subject. 实际上 is the more formal twin.
Hypothetical concession, answered by 也: 即使失败了也没关系 · 即使下雨也去. Written flavor; speech prefers 就是…也 or 哪怕. 尽管 concedes a fact.
Colloquial and slightly avuncular — an older speaker about a young man: 那个小伙子 · 好小伙子. The female counterpart is 姑娘; neutral is 年轻人.
照镜子 is the fixed verb for looking in one · 一面镜子 · 后视镜 rear-view. 眼镜, without 子, is glasses.
Covers bodily discomfort and emotional distress alike: 胃难受 · 心里很难受 · 难受得睡不着. 难过 leans sad; the physical opposite is 舒服.
The polite address for a tradesman or driver: 师傅，去火车站 · 出租车/修车师傅. Also a craft master with his 徒弟. 师父 (same sound) is a formal or religious master.
The number is what you pay, not what you save: 打八折 = 20% off · 打对折 half price · 打了个折. The discount as a noun is 折扣.
News reporting: 报道新闻 · 据报道… reportedly · 一篇报道. Same-sounding 报到 is checking in on arrival (新生报到); reporting to a boss is 汇报.
Data or a screen is the subject: 研究/数据显示… · 屏幕上显示 · 显示器 monitor · 显示出实力. A person showing something is 表示/表现.
出主意 offer an idea · 拿主意 make the call · 好主意 · 没主意 at a loss · 打…的主意 have designs on. It's a plan of action; an abstract idea is 想法.
It also invites an action: 欢迎参观 · 欢迎提意见 · 欢迎大家来. 受欢迎 = popular, well-liked. 欢迎光临 is the shop-door formula.
和/跟他联系 get in touch · 保持联系 · 联系方式 contact details · 联系不上 can't reach. Also 'link': 两者有联系 · 联系实际.
One of the 声 nouns for a sound heard at a distance — 歌声 · 笑声 · 掌声 — and it usually 传来: 窗外传来歌声. A person's voice is 嗓子/嗓音.
Both 'loosen' and 'ease up': 放松心情/肌肉 · 放松一下 · 放松警惕 let one's guard down (a warning). 轻松 is the adjective 'relaxed, easy'.
What you regret follows as a verb phrase: 后悔来晚了 · 后悔没听你的 · 后悔当初的决定. Feeling sorry toward someone else is 抱歉/遗憾. 后悔莫及.
Slightly formal beside everyday 午饭: 午餐时间 · 工作午餐 · 自助午餐. The verb is 吃: 吃午餐.
Attributive: 塑料袋/瓶/制品 · 一次性塑料 · 废塑料. Slang 塑料 = fake or flimsy: 塑料姐妹花 fake friends, 塑料普通话 shaky Mandarin.
Modifies telling and describing: 详细介绍/说明/讲解 · 详细的资料/地址 · 说得很详细. 仔细 is doing something carefully; 细节 is a detail itself.
Backing a person or a plan: 支持他/这个决定 · 得到支持 · 支持率. Also technical: 这个软件支持中文. Physical propping is 支撑; funding is 资助.
Weather and industry: 高温天气 · 高温预警 heat alert · 高温补贴 · 高温消毒. A person running a fever is 发烧/高烧.
Cut flowers as a gift or display: 一束鲜花 · 送鲜花 · 鲜花店. 花 alone covers flowers in general; 鲜 contrasts with 假花 artificial.
Traffic-and-planning register for making a trip: 出行方式 how you travel · 绿色出行 · 出行高峰. Stepping out of the house is 出门/外出.
Leaving home or the office for a while, purpose attached: 外出办事/旅游/就餐 · 外出人员. 出门 is the everyday spoken one; a business trip is 出差.
Broadcasts only: 收听广播/节目 · 收听率 listenership. Watching TV is 收看; everything else is plain 听 (听音乐).
Statement 'or': 喝果汁或者咖啡. A question needs 还是: 你喝果汁还是咖啡? Doubled 或者…或者… = either/or; 或者说 = 'or rather'.
The container as an object: 一个瓶子 · 空瓶子 · 瓶子里. When you count contents, the measure is bare 瓶: 一瓶水 · 两瓶啤酒.
考虑一下 · 让我考虑考虑 · 考虑到… taking into account · 考虑周到 thoughtful · 值得考虑. Takes a clause: 正在考虑要不要去. 思考 is deeper reflection.
读博士 do a PhD · 博士生 · 博士学位 · 博士后 postdoc · 经济学博士. Above 硕士 and 学士; as a title, 王博士.
收拾房间/屋子 · 收拾行李 pack · 收拾东西 · 收拾碗筷. Colloquially also 'sort someone out': 看我怎么收拾他. 整理 is the neutral 'organize'.
The visible result of a method: 效果很好 · 有/没有效果 · 达到效果 · 音响效果/特效. 作用 is the function exerted; 结果 is the outcome of an event.
Chiefly aircraft coming down: 飞机降落 · 安全降落 · 降落伞 parachute. The opposite is 起飞; 着陆 is the technical touchdown.
Self-satisfied, with a smug edge: 得意地笑 · 洋洋得意 · 得意忘形 carried away · 得意门生 favorite student. Plain pride is 骄傲/自豪; 满意 is satisfied.
The object is a method or a product: 改进技术/工作方法 · 加以改进. 改善 is for conditions and relations (改善生活/关系); 提高 raises a level (提高水平).
Plain and unfilled — the stuffed one is 包子, the twisted one 花卷: 一个馒头 · 蒸馒头. A northern staple standing in for rice.
Institutional giving: 提供服务/信息/帮助/机会 · 为客户提供… · 由公司提供. Everyday giving is just 给.
弹钢琴 — 弹 for keyboards and plucked strings, 拉 for 小提琴, 吹 for winds · 一架钢琴 · 学/练钢琴 · 钢琴家.
Human skin: 皮肤很好/干燥 · 皮肤病 · 皮肤科 dermatology. An animal hide or a fruit peel is 皮; leather is 皮革/真皮.
Verb and noun both: 你误会我了 · 别误会 · 产生/消除误会 · 一场误会. 误解 is the formal twin, usually about an idea or text; 弄错 is getting a fact wrong.
The scheduled service, not the aircraft: 航班延误/取消 · 航班号 · 国际/国内航班 · 赶航班. The plane itself is 飞机.
吃早餐 · 早餐店 · 自助早餐 · 含早餐 breakfast included. The spoken form is 早饭; 早点 is northern for morning snacks.
吃晚餐 · 晚餐时间 · 一顿丰盛的晚餐. The spoken form is 晚饭; a formal dinner event is 晚宴; the late-night meal after it is 夜宵.
Your son's daughter; your daughter's daughter is 外孙女. Same 外 split for 孙子 versus 外孙.
By chance, and it takes an object directly: 遇见一个老同学. An arranged meeting is 见面, which uses 和…见面. 碰见 is the spoken twin; 遇到 also covers 困难.
Written register, before the verb or adjective: 仍然很原始 · 他仍然不同意. Speech prefers 还/还是; 依然 is the literary twin.
Meeting a standard, of products and people: 产品不合格 · 合格率 · 考试合格 · 一名合格的老师. Passing an exam mark is 及格 (60分及格).
Announcement and written register: 前方到站 · 前方施工 · 前方路口. Everyday 'in front' is 前面/前边. In war talk it's the front line, against 后方.
Two senses: a physical sign (挂个牌子 · 门口的牌子) and a brand (什么牌子的 · 老牌子 · 杂牌). 品牌 is the marketing word; 名牌 a famous brand.
举办/开运动会 · 参加运动会 · 校运动会 · 运动会开幕式. The Olympics compress to 奥运会; a single contest inside it is 比赛.
Bookish — travel writing and notices: 到公园游玩 · 外出游玩 · 游玩项目. Speech says 玩/去玩儿; a formal tour is 游览/参观.
Noun and adjective both: 身体健康 (the standard wish) · 健康饮食/生活方式 · 心理健康 · 有益健康 · 不健康. Physically sturdy is 结实.
打扫房间/教室 · 打扫卫生 = do the cleaning, a fixed pair · 打扫干净. 洗 is washing with water, 擦 is wiping; 收拾 is tidying rather than sweeping.
Verb 'go through': 经历了很多事 · 经历过战争. Noun = the events themselves: 工作经历 · 一段难忘的经历. 经验 is the know-how you accumulate (经验丰富).
Follows what it surrounds: 房子的周围 · 学校周围 · 周围的人/环境. 附近 is 'nearby' without encircling; 四周 is the more literary 'all around'.
Separable — the count goes inside: 大吃一惊 · 吃了一惊. Also 我很吃惊 · 令人吃惊 astonishing. 惊讶 is the plain adjective; a nice surprise is 惊喜.
Modifier and adverb: 共同点 something in common · 共同语言 · 共同努力 · 共同利益. 一起 is plain side-by-side togetherness; 共同 implies a shared stake.
Read dàifu, and it's the northern spoken address: 王大夫 · 找大夫看看. 医生 is the standard word and the job title.
Muscle power: 很有力气 · 没力气了 · 花力气 · 力气活 heavy manual work. Abstract force is 力量; stamina and energy are 体力/精力.
Formal, stressing a hand in something: 参与讨论/决策/管理 · 参与其中. 参加 is the everyday 'take part in, join' (参加考试/婚礼) and far commoner in speech.
Official announcing, and it takes a clause: 宣布会议开始 · 宣布独立 · 正式宣布. 通知 is notifying people; 公布 is releasing data or a list.
For abstract structures: 建立关系/制度/信心/联系 · 建立起来. A physical building is 盖/建; founding an organization is 成立; 建设 develops a country.
A school composition: 写作文 · 一篇作文 · 作文题/作文课. A published piece is 文章, an academic paper 论文; 写作 is writing as an activity.
Separable: 打了两年工 · 打过工. Wage work for someone else, not a career post: 去餐厅打工 · 打零工 odd jobs. Slang 打工人 = wage earner.
Colloquial and complaining: 他老是迟到 · 老是忘 · 别老是玩手机. Bare 老 does the same (老不听话). Neutral 'always' is 总是; 一直 is continuous.
一扇窗户 · 开/关窗户 · 窗帘 curtain · 窗台 sill. Neutral tone chuānghu. 窗口 is a service counter or a computer window.
Organizing and running an event: 举办展览/比赛/婚礼 · 举办方 the organizer. 举行 stages a ceremony or meeting on the day (举行仪式); 办 is the everyday one.
吃零食 · 买零食 · 一包零食 · 零食柜台. 小吃 is street-stall dishes, not packaged nibbles; 点心 is pastries and dim sum.
Three uses: catching a departure (赶上末班车), pulling level (赶上他/赶上世界水平), and running into a situation (赶上下雨了). Missing it is 没赶上.
Adjective and noun both: 很危险 · 有危险 · 脱离危险 out of danger · 危险品 hazardous goods. Taking a risk is 冒险; risk as probability is 风险.
Written, and it follows the pair: 公司和家之间 · 两者之间 · 朋友之间 · 人与人之间. A span of time takes 期间/之内; the physical middle is 中间.
Formal, and the object is an abstract quality: 具有艺术性 · 具有重要意义 · 具有代表性. Concrete possession stays 有 (有一辆车); 拥有 is owning something substantial.
Written: 他一生都在… · 一生中最重要的… · 度过一生. The spoken equivalent is 一辈子 (等了一辈子); 终身 appears in pairs like 终身学习.
度过童年 · 童年回忆/时光 · 快乐的童年 · 在童年时. It names the period; 'when I was little' in speech is 小时候.
Follows the amount: 一个月以内 · 五公里以内 · 三十岁以内. Same frame as 以上/以下/以外. Speech often prefers 一个月内 or 不到一个月.
Separable: 点过名了 · 点了两次名. Beyond roll call: 点名批评 call someone out by name · 点名要你去 ask for you specifically. Signing yourself in is 签到.
The object is what you're testing into: 报考研究生 · 报考北大 · 报考人数. 报名 is registering for anything; getting in is 考上.
Noun 'result' (选举的结果 · 结果出来了) and a connective 'and then, as it turned out': 我等了半天，结果他没来 — usually something contrary to expectation.
Not fear — the speaker's hedged guess about unwelcome news: 恐怕来不及了 · 他恐怕不会同意. Real fear is 害怕/怕; 大概/也许 hedge without the bad news.
Deep, life-level contentment rather than a passing mood: 生活很幸福 · 幸福的家庭 · 幸福感 · 追求幸福. A good mood is 高兴/开心; 快乐 is the 生日快乐 word.
Mass noun — count with 件/套: 一件家具 · 一套家具 · 买/搬家具 · 家具城. Appliances are 家电.
Takes a verb: 来不及赶地铁 · 来不及解释了. The positive counterpart is 来得及 there's still time. Missing a departure specifically is 赶不上.
唱京剧 — it's sung, so 唱 · 看/听京剧 · 京剧演员/脸谱. 戏曲 is the whole traditional sung-theater family; the modern spoken play is 话剧.
Significance, not word-meaning: 很有意义 · 意义重大 · 纪念意义 · 失去意义. What a word or a remark means is 意思 (这个词什么意思).
A person as a figure of note or a character in a story: 历史人物 · 大人物 a big shot · 小说里的人物 · 人物形象. Personality traits are 性格.
The object is a policy or system: 实行改革/新制度. 执行 carries out an order or task (执行命令); 进行 pairs with activity nouns (进行讨论).
一颗星星 · 满天星星 · 数星星. The reduplicated form is the colloquial one for stars in the sky; compounds use bare 星 (卫星, 恒星), and 明星 is a celebrity.
Tourist-industry word: 旅游景点 · 著名景点 · 景点门票 · 逛景点. The scenery itself is 风景; the formal term is 名胜古迹.
打排球 — 打 for ball games played with the hands, 踢 for 足球 · 排球队/排球场 · 女排 the women's national team.
For pieces of expression: 发表论文/文章 · 发表演讲/讲话 · 发表意见/看法 · 在杂志上发表. A book or magazine is 出版; official data is 公布.
Works as a title and an address: 张教练 · 健身/游泳教练 · 驾校教练 · 当教练. 训练 is the training itself.
The natural world as a whole, usually with 大: 保护/爱护大自然 · 亲近大自然 · 大自然的力量. Bare 自然 leans 'natural, naturally'.
Takes a verb phrase: 愿意帮忙 · 不愿意去 · 你愿意吗? It's consent more than desire — 想 is wanting, 肯 is willing to bother, 情愿 is preferring one option.
School year: 上/念五年级 · 你几年级? · 高年级学生 · 同年级. Don't mix with 年纪 niánjì, a person's age (年纪大了); the class group is 班.
Takes a premise both sides already accept, not new information the way 因为 does; the second clause usually carries 就/那/也 or a suggestion: 既然来了，就别走了.
The span and course of a life as a whole: 人生观 outlook on life · 人生道路 · 人生经历 · 人生的转折点. Daily living is 生活; biological life is 生命.
Adverb, right before the verb: 赶紧走 · 赶紧把衣服收了. Works both for urging someone now and for narrating a quick reaction; 连忙 only narrates the past.
Always modified — 困难时期 · 抗战时期 · 一段时期. A phase defined by its character; 时代 is a whole historical era, 期间 is 'during' a named event: 放假期间.
Neutral-to-warm 'hometown': 家乡话 dialect · 家乡菜. 老家 is the colloquial one you actually say (回老家), 故乡 is literary and nostalgic.
反复练习 · 反复思考 · 反复强调 — doing the same thing again by choice. Also 'relapse / waver': 病情反复 · 反复无常 fickle.
Takes an object directly: 自学日语 · 自学编程 · 是自学的. 自学成才 self-taught success · 自学考试 (自考), the exam-based route to a degree.
Official / signage register, and the object is an action: 禁止吸烟 · 禁止出入 · 严禁 (stronger). Telling a person no in speech is 不许/不让.
The PRC standard spoken variety (Taiwan says 国语, SE Asia 华语): 说/讲普通话 · 普通话很标准 · 普通话考试. The language as a whole is 汉语/中文.
发红包 hand them out · 包红包 make one up for a wedding · 抢红包 grab WeChat ones · 收红包. Also the standard euphemism for a bribe or kickback.
A verb-object 'to charge', not the fee: 停车收费 · 这里收费吗 · 收费标准 · 收费站 tollgate. The money itself is 费用; the opposite is 免费.
Three jobs: adverb 'definitely' 他肯定会来 · verb 'affirm, give credit to' 肯定成绩 · adjective 'affirmative' 肯定的回答. Opposite 否定.
Northern / everyday word; 番茄 is the southern one and the formal or product term — 番茄酱 ketchup, 番茄炒蛋 on a menu. Same vegetable.
Takes the resource as object: 浪费时间 · 浪费钱 · 浪费粮食 · 浪费感情. Predicative 太浪费了. 白费 is effort spent for nothing: 白费力气.
Formal / announcement register: 乘坐地铁 · 欢迎乘坐本次航班. In speech you just say 坐地铁, 坐飞机. 乘 alone is more written still: 乘车.
Normally takes 喝 rather than 吃: 喝酸奶 · 一盒/一杯酸奶. 老酸奶 is the thick set kind; 酸 alone means gone sour: 牛奶酸了.
Written 'hence'; heads the result clause, often after a 由于… clause: 由于成本上升，因此提价. The everyday spoken equivalent is 所以; 因而 is a twin.
The neutral counterpart of 城市 in writing and policy talk: 农村人口 · 回农村 · 农村生活. 乡下 is the colloquial word and 乡下人 can belittle.
Written; takes a noun or verb phrase straight after: 用于教学 · 主要用于购买设备. In speech use 用来 + verb: 这个是用来切菜的.
Goes before the verb once the situation is stated: 没票了，只能走回去. Overlaps 只好 (which stresses reluctant settling); also plain limits: 我只能听懂一半.
Verb-object, and it splits: 上门服务 house calls · 上门维修 · 送货上门 delivery to your door · 找上门来 turn up at your door, usually with trouble.
Attributive noun: 老年人 · 老年生活 · 老年痴呆. To say a person is old you use 年纪大 or 年老. The ladder is 童年–青年–中年–老年.
For problems and consequences, not a person's manner (that's 严肃): 问题很严重 · 严重后果 · 病得很严重. Adverbial too: 严重影响 · 严重不足.
Written-leaning, and it needs an anchor in front (下班之后) or points back to what was just said. Bare 以后 can mean 'in future'; bare 之后 means 'after that'.
A non-predicate adjective: it modifies a noun and doesn't take 很. 公共场所 · 公共汽车 · 公共交通 · 公共卫生. The public as people is 公众 (公众人物).
控制成本 · 控制情绪 · 控制体重 · 控制局面. As a noun after 得到/失去: 火势得到控制 · 失去控制. Potential form is very common: 控制不住自己.
小学–初中–高中–大学, and the years are 初一/初二/初三. 上初中 · 初中生 · 初中毕业. 我初中的时候 = back when I was in junior high.
早上 is the everyday word; 早晨 leans written and points at the early part specifically, 清晨 is literary. A time word, so no preposition: 早晨六点起床.
Unbroken continuation, not a repeated habit (that's 总是): 一直在等 · 一直没消息 · 一直到中午. Also literally 'straight on': 一直往前走.
Two uses: a person is at ease (心情轻松) and a task is undemanding (工作很轻松). Adverbially 'easily': 轻松完成 · 轻松地越过. The verb 'relax' is 放松.
The written figure or a statistic: 一组数字 · 数字很惊人. A phone or room number is 号码. Also 'digital': 数字电视 · 数字化 · 数字经济.
The employer's side: 招聘员工 · 招聘会 job fair · 招聘启事 job ad. The applicant's verb is 应聘 (应聘这个职位); in speech people just say 招人.
Mostly a noun: 反应很快 · 对…的反应 · 化学反应 · 不良反应 side effect. Verb sense 'catch on': 我半天才反应过来. Don't mix it up with 反映 to report/reflect.
Manufacturing specifically: 工业化 · 重工业/轻工业 · 工业区. A line of business is 行业 (服务行业); a whole sector is 产业 (旅游产业).
The street as a place lined with buildings; 马路 is the roadway you cross and 上街 is 'go out shopping'. Also an admin unit: 街道办事处 subdistrict office.
Abstract objects: 加强管理 · 加强合作 · 加强锻炼 · 加强联系. 增强 goes with capacity or confidence (增强体质/信心); raising an amount is 增加.
Verb and noun both: 污染环境 · 空气污染 · 受到污染 · 污染物 pollutant · 治理污染 clean it up.
For things granted to you, usually abstract: 得到帮助 · 得到支持 · 得到承认 · 得到消息. Also the frame 问题得到解决 · 火势得到控制. Physical getting is 拿到/买到.
Two jobs: 'merely' before a verb (我只是想问问) and a softening 'it's just that…' between clauses: 东西不错，只是贵了点. Milder than 但是.
The leaves as goods: 买茶叶 · 一包/一罐茶叶 · 茶叶店 · 好茶叶. What you drink is 茶 — 喝茶, never 喝茶叶.
Adverb 'just casually': 随便看看 · 随便吃点. Alone it means 'whatever, up to you': 随便你. As an adjective it is often criticism: 穿得很随便 · 说话太随便.
Takes a verb phrase or a principle: 坚持锻炼 · 坚持下去 · 坚持原则 · 坚持不懈. Also 'insist that': 他坚持认为自己没错.
Plain 'truthful': 诚实的孩子 · 对我诚实. 老实 overlaps but also carries docile or naive (老老实实, 老实说), which 诚实 never does.
Content you acquire: 学知识 · 掌握知识 · 知识丰富 · 知识面 breadth. Compounds: 知识分子 intellectual · 知识产权 IP. Knowing that something is so is 知道.
Pairs with 首先 in a list: 首先…，其次…，最后…. Also 'second in priority': 质量第一，价格其次 · 其次才想到自己.
看视频 · 拍/发视频 · 短视频 · 视频通话 video call · 视频会议. Watch the parse in 电视频道 — that is 电视 + 频道, not 视频.
Written-leaning: 相同的经历 · 完全相同 · 与…相同 · 大致相同. Everyday speech says 跟…一样. Opposite 不同/不一样.
普遍现象 · 普遍规律, and very often adverbial: 普遍认为 · 收入普遍提高 · 普遍都爱吃. 一般 is 'ordinary, average'; 普遍 is about how widely something holds.
Comments on a whole situation: 太可惜了 · 可惜的是… · 可惜他失败了. Fronted it works like 'unfortunately'. The verb 'to treasure' is 珍惜.
Frames: 对…感到失望 · 让/使我失望 · 别让我失望 · 有点失望. Also a noun. 绝望 is despair, far stronger.
dāngnián 'back in those days': 当年他还是学生 · 想当年. Read dàngnián it means 'that same year', a business-writing use: 当年投产 · 当年见效.
Confirms what was just said: 我确实不知道 · 确实如此 · 确实不喜欢. Overlaps 的确 almost completely, 确实 a touch more spoken. Also adjective 'verified': 消息确实.
About processes, not surfaces (smooth to the touch is 光滑): 一切顺利 · 顺利完成 · 进行得很顺利 · 祝你一路顺利.
The kind of work you do — the form field 职业： — while 工作 is the particular job. Attributively 'professional': 职业选手 · 职业道德 · 职业病.
Blunt but perfectly normal; in a restaurant or someone's home ask for 洗手间/卫生间. 上厕所 go to the toilet · 公共厕所 · 男/女厕所.
As often a noun as a verb: 做出判断 · 判断很准确 · 判断力 · 判断失误. As a verb it takes a clause: 很难判断他说的是不是真的.
News register and usually something untoward: 突发事件 · 事件发生 · 事件的经过. A scheduled event you attend is 活动; an ordinary matter is 事情.
Takes the place as object: 路过邮局 · 顺路路过. It says you happened to be going past, not that you went there; 经过 is the neutral 'go via'.
Verb-object paired with 住院/入院, and it splits: 住了一周院 · 出了院就回家了 · 办出院手续.
Noun 'organized event': 参加活动 · 举办活动 · 搞活动 run a promotion. Verb 'move about, stretch': 出去活动活动. Also 'loose': 这颗牙有点活动.
Knowing about someone or something in depth, or looking into it: 了解情况 · 我不太了解他 · 进一步了解. 理解 is grasping a meaning or sympathising: 我理解你.
Society at large: 社会问题 · 社会地位 · 社会主义 · 社保 social insurance · 走上社会 leave school for the working world. Clubs today are 社团/俱乐部.
锻炼身体 · 坚持锻炼 · 每天锻炼一小时. Also 'temper a person': 在工作中得到锻炼 · 多锻炼锻炼年轻人. Working out at a gym is 健身.
Cover term for ID papers: 有效证件 · 出示证件 · 携带证件 · 证件照 passport-style photo. A specific one is 身份证/护照/工作证.
允许某人做某事 · 不允许 · 经…允许 with permission. Also impersonal: 时间允许的话 · 如果条件允许. Everyday 'let' is 让; the blunt spoken ban is 不许.
Both 'reduce' and 'go down': 减少开支 · 人数减少了. Amounts: 减少了20% (by) vs 减少到20% (down to). Levels and rates take 降低: 降低成本/温度.
Colloquial, northern, for a room inside a house: 收拾屋子 · 屋子里很黑 · 一间屋子. 房间 is the neutral word; 房子 is the building itself.
出租车/公交司机 · 当司机 · 代驾 designated driver. Slang 老司机 = an old hand who knows all the ropes, usually said with a wink.
A country's capital only; a province's seat is 省会 (广东的省会是广州), an autonomous region's is 首府. 首都机场 · 首都北京.
A physical motion: 做动作 · 动作很慢 · 动作快点儿! hurry up · 动作片 action film. Action in the abstract is 行动 or 行为.
The formal counterpart of 用, and it needs an object: 使用手机 · 使用说明 · 使用寿命 service life · 使用方法. In speech: 会用这台打印机.
Modifies a noun, usually with 的: 唯一的办法 · 唯一能帮我的人 · 我唯一担心的是…. The adverb 'only' is 只 — 唯一 doesn't do that job.
A noun only — the answer to a question or puzzle: 正确答案 · 标准答案 · 公布答案 · 答案是…. Replying to a person is the verb 回答/回复.
Neutral in official use (农民工 migrant worker · 农民收入), but thrown at a person it jabs at their manners. In speech 农村人/老乡; a farm owner is 农场主.
Anywhere in the country that isn't where you are: 外地人 · 去外地出差 · 外地口音. Opposites 本地/当地. Abroad is 国外 — 外地 stays domestic.
Quantifies before the noun: 大量资金 · 大量时间 · 大量的水 · 大量照片. Adverbial too: 大量生产 · 大量出口. For 'a lot of people' 很多人 is the natural choice.
做功课 · 检查功课 · 功课很多. Slightly older and Taiwan-leaning — mainland students say 作业. Figurative: 事先做足功课 do your homework on a topic.
The service, the parcel, and loosely the courier: 寄快递 send · 快递到了 · 取快递 collect · 快递员/快递小哥 · 发快递.
Adverb before the verb: 必须遵守. Its negative is 不必/不用 'needn't', while 不能 is 'mustn't'. The adjective 必需 is a different word: 生活必需品.
Needs an open element after it — 谁/什么/多么 or A还是B — plus 都/也 in the main clause: 无论天气如何，他都去跑步. 不管 is the spoken twin.
Phone bars and radio: 信号不好 · 没信号 · 信号强. Figurative: 发出积极信号 · 危险信号. 信号灯 is a traffic light or indicator.
Postposed onto the starting point: 自去年以来 · 改革开放以来 · 长期以来 · 有史以来. The main clause needs something durative: 他一直很忙.
Land as resource or property: 一块土地 · 土地面积 · 土地使用权 · 土地肥沃. The soil itself in farming or science is 土壤; the ground underfoot is 地.
有价值 · 很有价值 · 价值观 values · 实用价值 · 价值连城. Takes an amount directly: 一幅价值百万的画. 价格 is the price tag, 价值 the worth.
Before a quantity or a span: 大约六岁 · 大约需要一小时. 大概 does this too but also means 'probably' about a whole statement; 左右 goes after: 六岁左右.
打基础 lay one · 基础好/差 · 在…的基础上 on the basis of · 基础知识 · 基础设施 infrastructure. A building's physical foundation is 地基.
Intransitive, and its subject is a time or an event, not a person: 春天的到来 · 随着假期的到来 · 新时代的到来. A person arriving is 到/来/到达.
Rhetorical only — pairs with a final 吗 and expects the opposite answer: 难道你不饿吗？· 难道就这么算了？It carries surprise or indignation, so it can sound accusing.
Your college major (我学的专业是医学) and 'specialised': 专业知识 · 专业人士 · 专业设备. As a plain adjective it means skilled: 他很专业 · 太不专业了.
Of a person or a remark, and it implies wit rather than gags: 他很幽默 · 幽默感 sense of humour · 幽默的语言. Telling jokes is 讲笑话; funny is 好笑/搞笑.
Postposed onto a named stretch of time: 放假期间 · 会议期间 · 在此期间. It needs that anchor — an unspecified 'period of time' is 一段时间 or 时期.
Used adverbially or as a modifier: 免费开放 · 免费送货 · 免费试用 · 免费停车. As a predicate it wants 的: 这个是免费的. Charging money is 收费.
Pairs with 就 in the main clause and often wraps with 的话: 如果明天下雨(的话)，我们就不去了. 要是 is the colloquial twin; 假如/倘若 are formal.
除了…以外: with 都 it excludes (除了他，大家都去), with 还/也 it includes (除了英语，还会法语). The 都 or 还 is what tells you which reading is meant.
Mostly abstract now: 电商/社交平台 · 搭建平台 build one · 平台经济 · 交易平台. Physically it's a raised terrace or landing — a station platform is 站台/月台.
Softer and more formal than 对不起, good for emails and small lapses: 很抱歉 · 深感抱歉 · 抱歉，我迟到了. The verb 'apologise to someone' is 向…道歉.
The verb takes a clause with no 'to': 我建议你早点去 · 建议大家看看. Noun: 提建议 · 接受/采纳建议 · 一条建议. 意见 can mean a complaint; 建议 stays constructive.
The verb takes the affected thing directly and usually implies harm: 影响健康 · 影响心情 · 别影响他学习. Noun: 对…产生影响 · 受到影响 · 影响很大.
The four seasons and also 'the season for X': 收获的季节 · 换季 change of season · 季节性 seasonal. A trade's peak and slack seasons are 旺季/淡季.
Speculation adverb, before the subject or the verb: 也许他忘了 · 我也许周末去. Stands alone as 也许吧. 可能 covers the same ground but is also a noun: 有这种可能.
The thing is 有趣; your side of it is 对…感兴趣 — 我很有趣 says you are amusing. 好玩 is fun to do; 有意思 covers both and is more spoken.
The household as a unit: 家庭主妇 · 家庭作业 · 单亲家庭 · 家庭条件 how well-off a family is. The people are 家人/家里人; the place is 家.
Neutral in Chinese, unlike English 'propaganda': 做宣传 promote · 宣传资料/宣传单 leaflet · 宣传部. Commercial advertising is 广告 or 推广.
Takes what you leave as an object: 离开家 · 离开公司 · 离开北京. With no object it means departing for good: 他已经离开了. Leaving something behind is 留下/落下.
From a printer: 打印文件 · 打印一份 · 打印机 · 打印店. Mass-printing books is 印刷; 印 alone is stamping a seal or a pattern.
价格上涨/下降 · 价格高/低 (careful writing prefers 高/低 over 贵/便宜, though 贵 is common in speech) · 优惠价格. 价钱 is the spoken word.
Written register, and the object is a thing or a pursuit: 喜爱音乐 · 深受读者喜爱 much loved. For people and everyday liking use 喜欢; a hobby is 爱好.
Frames: 对…不满 · 感到不满 · 表示不满 · 引起不满. Also a noun: 心里有不满. A notch formal — in speech it's 不满意 or 有意见.
Written comparative frame A低于B: 气温低于往年 · 成绩低于平均水平 · 不低于三年. Its partner is 高于; speech uses 比…低.
Verb-object, so it splits: 开了机 · 开不了机. Covers powering on a phone or PC and a film shoot's first day (今天开机). Shutting down is 关机.
Pattern 对…很重要: 睡眠对健康很重要. The noun is 重要性. The verb 'attach importance to' is a different word, 重视: 他很重视这件事.
Takes a clause or a noun: 保证质量 · 我保证按时完成 · 保证不再犯. Noun: 有保证 · 质量保证 · 保证书. 保障 is institutional safeguarding: 社会保障.
Usually a noun: 同学聚会 · 家庭聚会 · 参加聚会. As a verb it's intransitive: 老同学明天聚会. Casual 'meet up' in speech is 聚一聚 or 聚聚.
Accumulated know-how, treated as a mass: 有经验 · 积累经验 · 工作经验 · 经验丰富. A specific thing you lived through is 经历; a felt first-hand one is 体验.
Adverbial before the verb: 及时处理 · 及时赶到 · 有问题及时说. Predicative: 你来得真及时. 按时 is 'as scheduled', 准时 is 'punctually'.
应用于 · 应用到实际中 · 广泛应用 · 应用题 word problem · 应用程序 app. Applying for a job or school is 申请, never 应用.
Verb: 练习口语 · 练习弹钢琴. Noun: 做练习 · 练习题 · 一道练习. Speech often shortens to 练: 多练几遍. Coached, systematic training is 训练.
管理公司 · 管理时间 · 管理人员/管理层 · 管理员 admin. 经营 is running a business for profit; in speech 管 alone does the work: 这事儿我管不了.
Approving of crowds and noise: 很热闹 · 热闹的集市. Nouny uses: 凑热闹 join the fun · 看热闹 gawk. Its opposite 冷清 means deserted, not quiet (安静).
Attention to detail, mostly adverbial: 仔细看 · 仔细检查 · 仔细想想. 小心 is watching out for danger (小心车); 认真 is taking something seriously.
The object is an organised activity: 参加比赛 · 参加会议 · 参加考试 · 参加工作 start one's career. Joining an organisation is 加入; formal attendance is 出席.
Stands at the front for 'from now on': 今后要多注意 · 今后的发展. Unlike 以后 it can't hang off another event — 下班以后 works, 下班今后 doesn't. Written-leaning.
一道/一个难题 · 解决难题 · 攻克难题 · 给我出难题 put me on the spot. Covers both a hard exam question and a dilemma in life.
The money an activity costs: 一笔费用 · 费用由公司报销/承担 · 生活费用. Specific fees are 费 compounds (学费, 手续费); the price of goods is 价格.
Anyone other than the ones in focus: 帮助别人 · 别人的东西 · 别管别人怎么说. Colloquial 人家 covers the same ground with attitude and can even mean 'yours truly'.
接受礼物/邀请/意见 and, less obviously, 接受教育 · 接受采访 be interviewed · 接受治疗. 接收 is receiving a signal or taking something over.
An ethnic group, not a country (that's 国家): 少数民族 · 汉族/藏族 · 民族文化 · 民族服装. 中华民族 is the nation-as-a-people; legal nationality is 国籍.
With a number it means the decade: 八十年代 · 九十年代末. On its own it is a bygone era: 那个年代 · 年代久远. A person's age bracket is 年龄段.
An organisational unit: 人事部门 · 政府部门 · 相关部门 the authorities concerned. A university department is 系; a company's own is usually 部 (销售部).
Three jobs: adverb 'respectively' 他们分别来自三个国家 · noun 'difference' 没什么分别 · verb 'part ways' 分别多年. The adverb is the common written use.
Takes scope-type objects: 扩大规模 · 扩大影响 · 扩大范围 · 扩大生产. Enlarging a photo is 放大; extending functions or space is 扩展.
Exclamatory frame 多么…啊: 多么晴朗的日子啊. Speech usually drops to 多: 你看他多高兴啊. Also concessive: 无论多么困难，都要坚持.
Structurally complicated, and neutral: 情况很复杂 · 复杂的关系 · 想得太复杂. Something that's a hassle is 麻烦; something hard to do is 难.
Takes a number or a rival: 超过一百人 · 超过预算 · 超过前面的车 · 不得超过三天. Overtaking on the road is 超车; going outside a range is 超出.
Also a resultative complement meaning 'entirely, all gone': 吃干净 · 花得干干净净 · 忘得一干二净. Reduplicates as 干干净净.
Adverbial before the verb: 准时到 · 准时出发 · 准时开始. 按时 is 'as scheduled' over a longer haul (按时吃药, 按时交作业); 及时 is 'in the nick of time'.
Outside academia it means 'look into, think over': 这事儿我们研究研究 — often a polite brush-off. 研究生 grad student · 研究所 institute · 做研究.
Technical and weather-report register: 低温天气 · 低温预警 · 低温保存 keep refrigerated. In ordinary talk you say 很冷 or 温度很低.
Verb-object, and it splits: 降了不少价 · 从没降过价. The product or shop is the subject: 这款电视降价了. Opposite 涨价; a discount is 打折/优惠.
The formal, administrative word — in speech it's just 班: 我们班 · 三班. 班级活动 · 班级管理 · 全班. A single class session is 一节课.
Written, and mostly in 节假日 public holidays · 假日经济 · 假日出游. The stretch of time off is 假期 (寒假/暑假); the verb is 放假.
Adverb 'usually': 我一般七点起床 · 一般来说. Adjective 'nothing special' — 成绩一般 is a polite 'mediocre'. Also 一般的 = run-of-the-mill.
Splits around the duration: 请三天假 · 请了一天假 · 请病假/事假. Ask whom with 向: 向老板请假. The 假 here reads jià.
Modifies with or without 的 (全部(的)工作) and works adverbially: 全部完成 · 全部卖光了. 所有 needs a noun after it; 都 is the adverb that sums the subject up.
The physical middle and an institution alike: 市中心 · 购物中心 · 服务中心. Figurative: 中心思想 main idea · 以…为中心. The middle of an object is 中间/中央.
Verb-object, so it splits: 受了伤 · 受了重伤 · 腿受伤了. It's what happens to you, so nothing follows it — injuring someone else is 弄伤/打伤/伤害.
Large-scale and often abstract: 建设铁路 · 经济建设 · 国家建设 · 基础设施建设. Putting up a house is 盖/建; setting up a system or ties is 建立.
Noun: 收入来源 · 信息来源 · 来源可靠. As a verb it needs 于: 这个词来源于日语. 资源 is resources; a figurative wellspring is 源泉.
The spoken register as against 书面语: 练口语 · 口语很流利 · 口语考试. Calling a word colloquial is 很口语/口语化. Talking to people is 说话, not 口语.
Frames: A与B不同 · 跟…不同 · 各不相同 · 不同的看法. Speech prefers 不一样. As a modifier 不同 also means 'various': 不同的国家.
Institutional register — paperwork at a counter: 办理手续 · 办理签证 · 办理入住 check in · 办理业务. In speech just 办: 去把这事办了.
保护环境 · 保护眼睛 · 保护隐私 · 保护动物 · 自我保护. 保卫 is defending against attack (保卫祖国); maintaining a car or your skin is 保养.
Verb-object, and it splits: 加了两个小时班 · 加了一晚上班. 加班费 overtime pay · 加班加点. The work you do isn't its object — you just 加班.
Verb and noun both: 总结经验 · 总结一下 · 写年终总结, the year-end write-up every office wants. 'In sum' in speech is 总的来说; a paper's abstract is 摘要.
Force in the abstract: 团结就是力量 · 一股力量 · 尽最大力量 · 力量对比. Muscle for lifting is 力气 (没力气了); a team's competitive strength is 实力.
Praise that comes downward — teacher to pupil, boss to staff: 表扬他 · 受到表扬 · 通报表扬. Between equals use 夸/称赞. The opposite is 批评.
Intransitive — the partner goes in a 跟/与 phrase: 跟他们合作 · 合作项目 · 合作愉快, said when closing a deal. 配合 is playing along with someone else's lead.
The 关于… phrase fronts the sentence or modifies a noun (关于历史的书); it doesn't trail after the verb the way English 'about' does. 对于 marks the target of an attitude.
Adverb 'really, I must say', usually before something negative: 实在太难了 · 实在对不起 · 实在不行就算了. As an adjective it praises a person: 他这人很实在.
Hypothetical frame 一旦…，就…: 一旦发生问题，就麻烦了. Points at a future contingency, usually an unwelcome one. Actual sequences take 一…就.
Fact-to-fact: X意味着Y, with a clause after it — 涨价意味着我们要少买点. Its subject is a fact, not a speaker: 'what I mean is' is 我的意思是.
The objects are orders and rules: 执行任务 · 执行命令 · 执行政策 · 强制执行 enforce. 执行力 ability to deliver. In titles it's 'executive': 首席执行官.
Blunt in the third person — 那个女人 can sound dismissive. Neutral choices: 女的 (casual), 女性 (formal or statistical), 女士 (polite address).
Used as a title after the surname: 王经理 · 总经理 GM · 部门经理 · 客户经理. Addressing your own boss that way is normal; the abstract role is 管理者.
一件/一部作品 · 文学作品 · 代表作 signature work · 作品集. It's the finished piece — creating is 创作, and schoolwork is 作业.
艺术家 · 艺术品 · 艺术学院. Figurative 'the art of': 领导艺术 · 说话的艺术. As an adjective, artistic: 很艺术 · 有艺术感. Drawing and fine art is 美术.
Political and institutional: 为人民服务 · 人民币 · 人民日报 · 人民医院. People in general are 人们; 群众 is the masses as against the officials.
Legal citizenship on a form: 国籍：中国 · 加入美国国籍 · 双重国籍 · 放弃国籍. Ethnic identity is 民族; in conversation you just ask 你是哪国人.
Contracted from 科学技术 and used as a modifier: 科技公司 · 高科技 · 科技创新 · 科技园. Pure science is 科学; the technology itself is 技术.
Read bēi here (carry on the back), not bèi. 背包客 backpacker · 背着背包. The everyday word for a two-strap pack is 双肩包.
Sightseers at a destination: 游客很多 · 外地游客 · 游客中心. 旅客 is travellers in transit (旅客须知 on trains); people on board a vehicle are 乘客.
Attributive or with 令人: 难忘的经历 · 令人难忘 · 终生难忘. The subject is the experience, not you — 'I can't forget it' is 我忘不了.
The thing is 感人, the person is 感动: 电影很感人，我看哭了 · 我很感动. 令人感动 · 感人的故事 · 感人至深.
The verb takes a clause: 决定明天出发 · 决定不去了. Noun: 做出决定 · 这是大家的决定. Third sense 'determine': 细节决定成败 · 态度决定一切.
Both a broadcast show and a turn in a performance: 电视节目 · 综艺节目 · 表演一个节目 · 节目单 programme list. A drama series is 电视剧; a channel is 频道.
A non-predicate adjective: 国际关系 · 国际机场 · 国际化 · 与国际接轨 align with global practice. Counterpart 国内; the standalone noun for the world is 世界.
Matching reality closely: 准确的数据 · 判断很准确 · 准确无误 · 准确率. 正确 is right-versus-wrong (答案正确); 精确 is high-precision measurement.
Verb-object, so it splits and reduplicates: 散散步 · 散了一会儿步 · 出去散散步. It's a stroll for pleasure; walking as transport is 走路, hiking is 徒步.
缺少人手 · 缺少经验 · 缺少资金. 缺乏 is the formal twin, better with abstractions (缺乏信心). 少 alone means 'be short by': 少了一个人.
The occupation as written on forms and in the news: 一名教师 · 教师节 · 人民教师. Nobody is addressed as 教师 — the term of address is 老师.
Two senses: the physical faculty (听力下降 · 听力不好) and the listening section of a language exam (听力考试 · 练听力). Medically the sense is 听觉.
Cuts both ways: 为你感到骄傲 proud of you · 是我们的骄傲 a source of pride — but 骄傲自满 and 别骄傲 warn against conceit. Context decides which.
Potential form: 来得及 vs negative 来不及, and 没来得及 for 'didn't manage it in time'. Usually followed by a verb: 现在走还来得及赶上末班车.
一项任务 · 完成任务 · 执行任务 · 分配任务 · 艰巨的任务. It is assigned from above, unlike 工作 (the job you hold) or 作业 (schoolwork).
Two frames: 负责教数学 (in charge of doing) and 对…负责 (answerable for/to): 对结果负责. 负责人 the person in charge · 认真负责 conscientious.
Usually preceded by a scope word: 全国各地 · 世界各地 · 来自各地. Modifies with 的: 各地的风俗. 当地 is the opposite move — 'the local place'.
Written, and about climate or regions: 寒冷的冬天 · 天气寒冷 · 寒冷地区. Your hands, a drink or a room are just 冷/凉. 寒 alone survives in 受寒 · 寒风.
Nearly always in 期中考试 midterm exam; its partner is 期末 (期末考试, 期末成绩). Don't confuse it with 中期, 'mid-period': 中期报告.
过安检 go through security · 安检口/安检门 · 安检员. It's airport and station screening specifically; a workplace safety inspection is 安全检查.
Counted as people: 一个/一名警察 · 当警察 · 交通警察(交警). The institution in news writing is 警方 (警方通报); calling them in is 报警.
具备条件 have what it takes · 符合条件 qualify · 有条件 be in a position to · 无条件 unconditional · 讲条件 bargain over terms. 生活/工作条件 = circumstances.
Written-register cause, usually fronting the cause clause and answered by 因此/所以; 这是由于… also fine. 因为 is the spoken choice and the one that answers 为什么.
Separable: 出了三天差 · 出过一次差 · 出一趟差. The destination usually comes first: 去/到外地出差. 差 reads chāi 'mission, errand' here.
Antonym 细心; 马虎 is the sloppier, more colloquial twin. Set phrase 粗心大意. Describes a person or the doing: 他做事很粗心 · 粗心的错误 · 别太粗心.
Verb, not the noun the gloss suggests: 堵车了 · 路上堵车. Separable — 堵了半个小时车. The place is the subject (高速上堵车); 路很堵 works too.
Always followed by a verb: 无法理解/接受/想象/忍受. Written register; the spoken equivalent is 没办法, which can also stand alone as a whole answer.
取得成绩 · 成绩好/差 · 考试成绩 · 成绩单 report card · 成绩优秀. In official register it means achievements: 取得了很大的成绩.
Literary 这么/这样: 如此复杂 · 如此而已 that's all. Fixed frames: 原来如此 so that's it · 既然如此 in that case · 不过如此 nothing special.
No object — the temperature itself drops: 明天要降温 · 降温十度 · 大幅降温. Also figurative cooling of a craze: 楼市降温 · 给考研热降温.
For things that rise on their own: 经济/人口/收入增长 · 增长了20% · 增长率. Takes an object only in 增长知识/见识/才干. To add a countable amount use 增加.
A叫作B — B is the name given: 这种病叫作近视. Also spelled 叫做. Plain 叫 is the everyday choice; 称为 the formal one.
Adverbial with 以: 以高价买下/卖出 · or attributive: 高价商品 · 高价收购/出售. Opposite 低价. As a predicate you'd say 价格很高 instead.
Attributive with or without 的: 其他人 · 其他的问题. Stands alone as 'the rest': 其他都还好. 其它 is a variant spelling some writers reserve for non-persons.
Takes abstract mass nouns directly, no 的, no measure word: 一切困难 · 一切都会好的. 所有 is for enumerable things (所有的书). Alone it means 'everything'.
Colloquial 但是, heading the second clause: 虽然…可是…. Separate trap: emphatic 可是 in 这可是件大事 'this really is' — that's 可 intensifier plus 是.
Attributive with 的: 真正的朋友/原因. Before a verb it means 'genuinely, actually': 真正了解他的人不多. It doesn't sit in the predicate slot — say 是真正的…. 真的 = 'really'.
Mostly adverbial before the verb: 直接去 · 直接告诉我 · 直接找他. Attributive: 直接原因/影响/关系. Opposite 间接. Colloquially also 'just go ahead and…'.
Two jobs: explain — 说明情况/原因/理由; and 'show that', taking a whole clause — 这说明他不在乎. Noun: 说明书 manual · 使用说明 · 产品说明.
Overlaps with 风景; 景色 usually comes with a describing adjective (景色优美/迷人/宜人), while 风景 owns the compounds 风景区 · 看风景 · 风景照.
Chinese distilled grain liquor, 40–60% — white wine is 白葡萄酒. 喝白酒 · 一杯/一瓶白酒 · 白酒 vs 啤酒/黄酒 · 二锅头/茅台 are 白酒 brands.
Numeric 'and under': 18岁以下 · 60分以下 (Chinese usage normally counts the stated number in). Textual 'the following': 以下内容/几点 · 以下是我的看法.
Time word — before the verb or fronted: 我最近很忙. Points both ways: recent past (最近看了本书) and near future (她最近就要出国了).
回老家 is the default verb; 老家在山东 'my family is from…'. It's the ancestral hometown, not necessarily where you grew up. 家乡/故乡 are the literary words.
讲故事 is the verb (also 听/编故事) · 故事书 · 故事情节 · 童话故事. Reversed, 事故 shìgù is an accident — keep the two apart.
As a verb it needs 为/给: 为人民服务 · 给客户服务 — the beneficiary doesn't follow it directly. Noun: 服务态度/质量 · 服务员 · 售后服务 · 服务业.
兴 is xīng here (xìng in 高兴/兴趣). Adjective: 很兴奋 · 兴奋得睡不着 · 令人兴奋 · 兴奋剂 doping. 激动 is stirred-up emotion generally; 兴奋 is the keyed-up kind.
Objects are abstract: 重视教育/健康/人才/意见. Flip it with 受到/得到/引起重视. Degree words fit: 很/非常重视 · 不够重视 · 高度重视.
Adverb before the verb, usually with 了: 终于到了 · 终于明白了. It marks a long-awaited outcome; for plain sequence use 最后/后来.
Written register, and the object is something staged: 观看比赛/演出/展览/影片/直播. Everyday 看 covers all of it; 观看 is specifically watching as a spectator.
有责任+verb 'have a duty to' (as on the card). Also 负责任 · 承担责任 · 推卸责任 shirk · 追究责任 · 责任心 sense of duty · 责任在我.
Reporting verb — a clause follows after a comma: 专家指出，…. Or a concrete flaw: 指出错误/问题/不足. 出 is the result complement; 指 alone is just 'point'.
Separable: 抬起头来 · 头都没抬. Usually serial with the next verb: 抬头看/望/一看. Unrelated noun sense: 发票抬头 the name a receipt is made out to.
Business-and-news modifier: 全球用户/市场/经济 · 全球第一 · 全球化 globalization · 在全球范围内. 全世界 is the warmer, more spoken equivalent.
Two senses: obligation (你应该去) and inference (他应该到了 'should be there by now'). 不应该 shouldn't vs 应该不 probably not. Alone: 应该吧 · 应该的.
Takes the topic directly (讨论这个案子) or 跟/和某人讨论某事. Formal noun use: 进行/展开讨论 · 讨论会. 商量 is two people settling something practical.
Attributive by default: 著名作家/景点 · 世界著名 · 以…著名. For the predicate slot 有名 is what gets used (他很有名); 著名 leans written.
Transitive — you add something: 增加收入/难度/信心/人手. Amount after: 增加了20%. 增长 is what grows by itself (经济增长); 提高 raises a level or quality.
迷 is the productive fan suffix: 影迷 film · 歌迷 music · 戏迷 opera · 车迷. Sport-specific fans usually collapse to 足球迷/篮球迷. 粉丝 is for celebrities.
Written 有, for substantial or abstract holdings: 拥有股份/资源/专利/数亿用户/发言权. It never covers the existential 'there is' — only 有 does that.
Transitive, object follows directly with no 到: 进入会场 · 进入决赛 · 进入状态 get in the zone · 进入21世纪. Colloquially just 进: 进屋 · 进来.
Adverb 'especially, very': 特别喜欢 · 特别热. Adjective 'unusual': 形状很特别. 特别是 fronts an example. For 'special' as a category use 特殊 (特殊情况).
For devices and organs: 功能很多 · 具有…功能 · 多功能 · 功能强大 · 肝/肾功能. 作用 is the effect something has; 用途 is what it's used for.
In practice Chinese cuisine as opposed to 西餐: 吃中餐 · 中餐厅 · 中餐馆. The 'midday meal' reading is rare — lunch is 午餐/中饭.
X专家 compounds freely: 电脑/医学/教育专家 · 在…方面的专家 · 请教专家. 专业 is the adjective 'professional/one's major'; 专门 the adverb 'specially'.
Needs a set named just before it: 十本书，其中三本是英文的 · 其中之一 one of them · 其中一个 · 其中的高个子. 里面/当中 is the concrete-space version.
In practice usually 大多数: 大多数人 · 多数情况下 · 多数同学. Antonym 少数. Modifies the noun directly, no 的; alone it means 'most of them': 多数都同意.
Pairs with 好处 and takes 对…: 对身体有坏处 · 有好处也有坏处 · 没什么坏处. 缺点 is a flaw in a thing or person; 坏处 is harm done to someone.
性格开朗/内向/固执 · 性格好 · 性格不合 incompatible. 脾气 is temper (发脾气); 个性 is what makes you distinctive; 性格 is the whole personality.
Counted with 对: 这对母女. Spoken 母女俩 'the two of them'. Same frame: 父子 · 父女 · 母子 · 夫妻 · 兄妹 · 姐弟.
Volume goes with 大/小: 声音太大 · 把声音关小点. 好听 describes a voice. Speaking loudly is 大声说/小声说. 嗓子/嗓音 is the voice as an instrument.
Written and formal — in speech and to his face it's 爸/爸爸. 父亲 shows up in writing, introductions, and 父亲节. Possessive drops 的: 我父亲.
Takes a noun or a verb phrase: 拒绝邀请/建议 · 拒绝回答/承认/合作. 被拒绝 works. 谢绝 is the polite notice form (谢绝参观); 婉拒 declines gently.
Mostly a noun: 受/接受教育 · 教育水平 · 高等教育 · 教育部. As a verb with a person object it means to lecture or discipline them (教育孩子); teaching a subject is 教.
Long-term climate, not today's 天气: 气候干燥/温和 · 气候变化 climate change · 亚热带气候. Figurative: 政治气候 · 不成气候 'won't amount to much'.
Street-stall and local dishes, not packaged snacks — those are 零食. 小吃街/小吃店 · 风味小吃 · 地方小吃 · 吃点小吃.
Bare 注意 = 'watch out for, mind': 注意安全/身体/休息. With 到 it means 'notice': 我注意到他没来. Noun-ish: 引起注意 · 注意力 attention span.
帮助他学习 — person plus what they're doing. Noun with 对: 对我很有帮助 · 需要帮助. 帮忙 is separable and takes no object: 帮我个忙 · 帮不上忙.
在…情况下 is the workhorse frame: 在这种/紧急情况下. Also 了解/汇报情况 · 情况怎么样 · 视情况而定. 状况 is the formal word for a state (健康状况).
Pivot: 鼓励+person+verb phrase — 老师鼓励我们多提问. Flip it with 受到/得到鼓励. 表扬 praises what's already done; 鼓励 pushes toward what's next.
Separable: 打了一针 · 打过针 · 打三针. The patient takes 给: 给他打针; from his side 去打针. 打预防针 also means giving someone advance warning.
After a time expression it means 'around': 春节前后 · 十点前后 · 国庆前后. Also 'all told' over a span: 前后花了三年. Spatial: 房子前后 · 前后走动.
Pattern 只有…才…: 只有努力才能成功 — the 才 is what carries 'only if'. Contrast 只要…就… 'as long as'. Plain 'there is only' too: 这里只有大号的.
Three slots: adverb 'separately' before the verb (另外找时间/另外买一个); determiner 另外一个 = 另一个; sentence-opener 'besides' — 另外，我还有个问题。
The ladder is 学士 · 硕士 · 博士. 读/念硕士 study for one · 硕士学位 · 硕士生 the student · 考研 is the entrance-exam route in.
Attributive 明显的差别/变化/进步 · predicate 效果很明显 · clause opener 很明显，他在撒谎. 显然 is the written 'evidently' and only opens clauses.
Attributive with no 的: 传统文化/节日/观念/医学. As a noun: 保持/继承/打破传统 · 反传统 (as on the card) · 传统上 'traditionally' opens a clause.
Proportions: 大部分 · 一部分 · 小部分 · 部分人 'some people'. Adverbial: 部分同意 partly agree. 这部分内容. Read bùfen, 分 neutral tone.
定/实现/达到目标 · 目标明确 · 以…为目标 · 目标是当医生 (a clause can follow 是). Also the physical target of a search or attack: 目标出现了.
Follows its reference point: 毕业以后 · 三天以后 · 下课以后. At the head of a clause and alone it means 'from now on': 以后别这样了.
场 is the classifier: 一场比赛. 参加/举行/看比赛 · 比赛开始/结束. As a verb it takes 跟: 跟他们比赛 · 比赛谁跑得快. 竞争 is rivalry, not a match.
Takes a whole clause: 我感觉他不高兴. With 到 for physically noticing: 感觉到冷. Noun with 种: 有种奇怪的感觉. 觉得 overlaps for opinions but can't be a noun.
Passive in feel but takes no 被 — the subject undergoes it. Objects are abstract, usually two syllables: 受到欢迎/影响/批评/重视/损失/教育.
The questions on a paper: 试题很难 · 一道试题 (道 is the classifier) · 出试题 set them. 题目 is any question or a title; 考题/考卷 are the everyday words.
As a verb it takes a verb phrase: 计划周末去旅行. Noun: 制定/取消/改变计划 · 按计划进行 · 五年计划. 打算 is the lighter spoken 'plan to'.
Fronts a topic, usually before the subject: 对于电脑我一点也不懂. 对 does everything 对于 does plus person-directed actions (对我笑/对我说), where 对于 doesn't fit.
Two lives: attributive 'fundamental' — 根本原因/利益/大法 · 从根本上; and adverb with a negative — 根本不知道 · 根本没去过 'not at all'.
Written 又/再, before the verb: 再次尝试/强调/见面/当选. Unlike 再 it also covers repetitions that already happened (他再次失败了), where speech uses 又.
Attributive or after 到: 中年人 · 中年妇女 · 人到中年 · 中年危机 midlife crisis · 中年发福. The set is 青年 · 中年 · 老年.
Takes a noun or a verb phrase: 需要休息 · 需要三个小时 · 需要你帮忙. Noun: 满足需要 · 根据需要 · 生活需要. Negative 不需要, or 不用 in speech.
Adverb 'fairly, rather' before an adjective — 比较大/比较难 — a hedge, weaker than 很. Verb: 把两个比较一下 · 比较起来 · 无法比较. 相比 is the written comparison marker.
Needs a follow-up clause with 而且/还/也: 不仅便宜，而且好用. Doubled 不仅仅 adds emphasis (as on the card). 不但 is the everyday twin; 不仅 leans written.
复印一份/两份 (份 is the unit) · 复印件 a photocopy · 复印机 · 去复印店. 复制 is copying in general including files; 打印 is printing.
Humanity as a species: 人类历史/文明/社会/进步 · 全人类 · 人类学. For 'people' in general use 人们; 人类 sets humans against animals, machines, or nature.
The compounds are the payoff: 交通工具 means of transport · 工具书 reference work · 生产工具 · 工具栏 toolbar. Figurative: 把人当工具 · 工具人.
Online 'follow': 关注了这个博主 · 取消关注 unfollow. Also 'pay close attention to' an issue: 关注环保/民生. Noun-ish: 引起/受到关注 · 关注度.
Frame 跟/和 A 一样 (+adj): 跟他一样高 · 和以前不一样. Alone: 都一样. Intensified as 一模一样 yìmúyíyàng exactly alike — 模 is mú there.
想办法 come up with one · 有/没办法 · 没办法了 nothing to be done · 想尽办法 · 用这个办法. 方法 is the systematic method (学习方法); 办法 solves the problem at hand.
Documents and news only: 此次活动/会议/事故/访问. Speech uses 这次. Same 此 family: 此外 besides · 此后 · 因此 · 特此.
Making something crafted or produced: 手工制作 · 制作视频/节目/网页 · 制作人 producer. 制造 is industrial output and also 制造麻烦/噪音; 做 is the everyday word.
Separable: 得了两分 · 一分没得. As a noun 'points scored': 得分最高 · 平均得分. 比分 is the scoreline of a match; 分数 is a grade.
Separable: 回了一封信 · 回封信. The addressee takes 给: 给我回信. As a noun 一封回信. For email and chat today it's 回复/回消息.
Adverbial before a verb: 努力学习/工作. Predicate: 他很努力. With a verb phrase: 努力做到最好. Noun in 做出努力 · 白费努力. Degree words fit: 非常努力.
Mostly a noun: 生活水平/习惯/压力/条件 · 日常生活. As a verb it takes no object, just a setting: 生活在农村 · 生活得很幸福. 住 is residing; 活 is being alive.
Takes people and abstractions alike: 尊重父母 · 尊重别人的选择/事实/意见. 互相尊重 · 受到/得到尊重 · 不尊重. 尊敬 is looking up to elders and superiors.
为…干杯 'here's to…': 为友谊干杯 · 为你的成功干杯. 干了！ alone = bottoms up; 我干了，你随意 lets the other off lightly. 敬你一杯 is the polite offer.
21世纪 · 上世纪/本世纪 · 世纪初/中期/末 · 半个世纪 · 跨世纪. Decades need 年代: 上世纪80年代 = the 1980s.
Beyond martial arts: 下功夫 put the work in · 花/费功夫. For the 'time to spare' sense it is usually written 工夫: 有工夫吗 got a minute · 一会儿工夫.
Size takes 多/少, not 大/小: 人口不多 · 人口众多. 人口增长/老龄化/密度 · 人口普查 census. A family's headcount uses 口 alone: 我家有五口人.
Care for a person: 照顾孩子/病人/老人 · 照顾好自己. Second sense, making allowances: 照顾一下他的情绪/困难 · 请多照顾 · 照顾生意 give someone your custom.
Transitive — someone changes something: 改变看法/主意/命运/习惯 · 改变不了. Change that just happens is 变/变化 (上海变化很快). Noun: 发生了改变.
The pre-class half of the pair 预习/复习: 预习课文/生词 · 提前预习. Only for lessons you're about to be taught; 准备 covers everything else.
遵守/违反法律 · 法律责任/规定/效力 · 法律援助. A single statute is 法 (宪法/劳动法); 法规 covers regulations. 合法/非法 are the adjectives.
商业模式 business model · 思维/发展/管理模式 · 飞行模式 airplane mode · 模式化. For someone's lifestyle, 生活方式 is the more usual pairing.
在…过程中 is the main frame: 在学习/谈判过程中 during. Also 整个过程 · 制作/生产过程 · 过程很复杂. 程序 is a set procedure; 步骤 are the individual steps.
Life as biological existence: 珍惜/挽救生命 · 生命危险 · 生命力 vitality · 一条生命. 生活 is daily living; 人生 is the course of a life.
Two jobs: a text message (发/收/回信息) and information (个人信息 · 信息量 · 信息技术). 消息 is news you hear about something: 好消息 · 听到消息.
做报告 = give a talk; 写/交/提交报告 = the document (份 is the unit). As a verb, reporting upward: 向领导报告 · 报告老师！ in class. 报告会 a lecture event.
提/发表/征求意见 for suggestions. But 对某人有意见 means holding a grievance against them, not merely having a view. 意见不一致 · 保留意见 · 意见箱.
有…的历史 states age: 有两千年的历史 · 历史悠久. 历史上 'in history' opens a clause. 学历史 the subject · 历史性时刻 historic moment · 历史遗留问题.
Official release: 发布消息/公告/命令/报告 · 新品发布会 launch event. 发表 is for articles and speeches; 公布 makes results public; 发 is everyday posting.
Goes after the surname as address: 邓主任 · 王主任. 班主任 is a homeroom teacher, 主任医师 a senior consultant doctor. 副主任 deputy.
跟/与…有关 be connected to: 这跟你有关吗. Before a noun it means 'the relevant': 有关部门/单位/人员 · 有关…的书. Opposite 无关: 与我无关.
Adverb before the verb: 四处寻找/张望/走动/打听. 到处 is the everyday equivalent and also follows 是 (到处都是人), a slot 四处 rarely fills.
Preposition 'by way of', before the means: 通过协商/努力/朋友介绍. Verb 'pass': 通过考试/审查 · 获得通过. 经过 is passing through a place or process.
Noun 'showing, conduct': 表现很好 · 在工作中的表现. Verb with 出: 表现出兴趣/勇气/天赋. Reflexive 表现自己 leans toward showing off. 表演 is performing on stage.
A standalone college or conservatory (音乐/美术/电影学院) or a faculty inside a 大学 (商学院/工学院). Below it is the 系 department; 院长 is the dean.
Sets ordinary days against a special one: 平时不学习，考试才着急. Before the verb or fronted: 你平时喜欢做什么. 平常 overlaps and also works as an adjective 'ordinary'.
Escalates the second clause, often paired with 不但/不仅: 不但便宜，而且好用. Even alone it needs a preceding statement. 并且 is flatter and more written.
着 is zháo here. 别着急 · 为孩子着急 (为 marks what worries you) · 着急回家 anxious to get home. Colloquial split: 着什么急！ 'what's the rush'.
Straight before the noun, no measure word: 许多汽车/许多人; 的 optional. Slightly written — 很多 is the spoken default and the one that works as a predicate (人很多).
内容很难/丰富/充实 · 主要内容 · 内容提要 · 以下内容. Paired against 形式 form. Also 'content' in the online sense: 内容创作者 · 优质内容.
Beyond 'exist': 存在问题/困难/差别 is the standard way to say 'there are problems' in reports. Also 存在于…之中 · 不存在 'no such thing' · 客观存在.
Numeric 'and above': 三年以上的经验 · 60分以上 (normally counted as including the number). Textual 'the above': 以上就是我的看法 · 综上所述. Mirrors 以下.
在…之前 or bare X之前: 睡觉之前 · 三天之前. Standing alone it means 'earlier than now': 之前我说过. 以前 is the everyday twin and alone means 'back in the day'.
张 is the classifier: 一张图片 · 发图片 · 配图 · 图片来源. A photograph specifically is 照片; a chart or diagram is 图/图表.
Straight before the noun, no measure word: 任何人/地方/问题/时候. Very at home under negation: 没有任何理由 · 不接受任何借口.
Institutional register: 儿童节 · 儿童医院/文学/乐园 · 儿童票. In conversation you'd say 孩子/小孩儿. 少年 is the older band, 青少年 the teens.
Links two predicates about one subject, often after 不但/不仅: 宽敞并且明亮 · 他答应了并且照做了. Flatter and more written than 而且, which adds 'what's more'.
Adjective, takes no object: 这件衣服很合适 · 合适的人选 · 不太合适. When you need an object use the verb 适合: 这工作适合你. 合身 is clothing fit specifically.
Three uses: attitude nouns — 表示感谢/歉意/关心; reporting a statement — 他表示，会考虑; signifying — 红灯表示停止. 表达 is putting content into words.
Also an adjective meaning 'sound, rational': 这个办法不科学 · 科学地安排时间. Compounds: 科学家 · 科学技术/科技 · 自然/社会科学 · 科学院.
Adverbially it means 'briefly': 简单说一下 · 简单介绍. 不简单 is praise — 'quite something'. Also 结构简单 · 简单的方法 · 头脑简单 simple-minded.
Closes the if-clause, often echoing 如果/要是 at the front, with 就 in the result: 有时间的话，就来吧. Fixed: 不然的话 · 要不然的话 otherwise. Purely optional — the 如果 clause works without it.
X以前: 三天以前 · 下班以前 · 走以前给我打个电话. Alone it means 'in the past': 我以前住在上海. 之前 is the more written twin and points to a specific earlier moment.
Takes the thing or the person directly: 反对这个方案 · 父母反对我们结婚. Degrees: 强烈/坚决反对. Opposite 赞成/支持. Also 表示反对 · 反对意见 · 反对票.
Intransitive and mostly a noun: 变化很大/很快 · 发生了变化 · 气候变化. Nothing follows it as an object — to change something is 改变.
Verb: 代表公司/全体同学发言 · 这不代表我同意. Noun 'delegate': 人大代表 · 派代表. Also 代表作 signature work · 代表性 representative · 代表队.
Pivot: 要求+person+verb phrase (as on the card) · 要求他道歉. Noun: 提出要求 · 符合/达到要求 · 对质量的要求 · 高要求. 要 reads yāo in this word.
调 reads diào here (tiáo in 调整). 对…进行调查 is the formal frame · 调查结果/报告 · 问卷/民意调查 poll · 调查案件 · 社会调查.
Chiefly a romantic date: 去约会 · 有个约会 · 约会对象. A business appointment is 预约 or 约时间. The bare verb 约 does the asking: 约他吃饭.
Concessive, answered by 也/都 in the second clause: 哪怕下雨我也要去 · 哪怕只有一次. 即使 is the written twin, 就算 the colloquial one.
Adverb before the verb: 她总是迟到. 老是 is the grumbling colloquial version. Watch the scope: 总是不来 'never comes' vs 不总是来 'doesn't always come'.
Its main life is as a result complement: 听/看/说/写清楚 · 弄清楚 get it straight · 没听清楚. 我不清楚 = 'I'm not sure'. Predicate: 讲得很清楚.
Written 更, and it prefers a two-syllable word after it: 更加重要/明显/努力. Plain 更 handles 更好/更大. Both imply a basis of comparison.
Marks a past experience now over, usually with 过 or 了: 曾经去过/住过. The negative is 不曾/未曾 or plain 没(有). 已经 is 'already' and points at the present.
申请/获得/拿到奖学金 · 全额奖学金 full ride · 国家奖学金. 助学金 is need-based aid; 学费 is tuition; 奖金 is a work bonus.
Form-field vocabulary: 性别：男/女 · 性别歧视/平等/差异 · 性别比例. For an animal you'd more likely just say 公的/母的.
Textbook cover-term for words and set phrases: 词语搭配 collocation · 常用词语. 单词 is an individual word (esp. in language study), 词汇 the vocabulary as a body, 生词 new words.
The fuller, more written 能; it prefers a two-syllable verb: 能够理解/完成/实现/早日康复. Questions and short answers take plain 能 (能吗？能), and the negative is 不能.
The object is the problem, not the person: 解决问题/矛盾/困难/纠纷. Potential form 解决不了/得了. Passive: 问题得到了解决. 解答 is answering a question.
A变成B, the result following directly: 水变成冰 · 把它变成机会. 成为 is the written 'become' for roles and statuses (成为医生), where 变成 implies transformation.
条 is the classifier: 一条新闻. 看/听新闻 · 上新闻 make the news · 新闻发布会 · 新闻联播. 消息 is a single piece of information you hear.
Verb and noun both: 回忆起往事 · 美好的回忆 · 留下回忆 · 回忆录 memoir. 想起 is the sudden 'it came back to me'; 记得 is simply still holding it.
Adverb before the predicate: 几乎一样 · 几乎所有人 · 几乎每天. With a negative it means 'hardly': 几乎不说话 · 几乎没睡. 差不多 is the spoken 'about, nearly'.
Written: adverb before the verb (最终决定不买) or attributive (最终目标/结果/胜利). 最后 is the neutral 'last in sequence'; 终于 adds relief at a long wait.
People only: 年轻人 · 年轻时 · 他比我年轻两岁 · 年轻有为. A young animal or plant takes 小/幼; a young company is 新成立的.
Written 找, for searches with some weight: 寻找答案/机会/线索/参考书/失踪者. Everyday looking is 找 (找钥匙); the result 'found it' is normally 找到.
Named regions and zones: 贫困/沿海/农村地区 · 亚太地区 · 港澳台地区, a deliberately careful cover term. 地方 is any place; 区 is an urban district.
分析/收集/处理数据 · 数据显示… the frame for citing figures · 数据库 database · 大数据 · 流量数据. 资料 is source material; 数字 are the numerals.
A body of thought, not a single idea — that's 想法/主意. 毛泽东思想 · 思想工作 political persuasion · 思想上 · 思想家 · 解放思想.
The scoreline: 比分是2比1 (X比Y) · 比分领先/落后 · 追平比分 level it · 改写比分. 得分 is points scored; 分数 is a grade on a test.
Separable-ish: 获了大奖 · 获过两次奖. Attributive: 获奖作品/影片/名单/感言. 得奖 is the everyday twin; to name the prize use 获得…奖: 获得诺贝尔奖.
Intransitive, the aircraft is the subject: 飞机九点起飞 · 准时/延误起飞 · 起飞时间. Landing is 降落/着陆. Figurative: 经济起飞.
A domain word, used attributively: 体育课/老师/馆/用品/新闻/比赛. Exercising is 运动 (做运动); an individual sport is a 项目 (体育项目).
Systemic, institutional change: 进行/推行改革 · 改革开放 the Reform and Opening policy · 经济体制/教育改革 · 改革者. Personal change is 改变.
Adjective: 你真幸运 · 幸运的是… 'fortunately' opening a clause · 幸运儿 · 幸运数字. The noun 'luck' is 运气: 运气好 · 碰运气.
Works both ways: 经济发展很快 (intransitive) and 发展经济/旅游业 (transitive). 发展中国家 developing country · 发展成… grow into · 可持续发展.
Where physical states land: 肚子疼/饿/胀 · 肚子饿了 is the normal 'I'm hungry'. The organ itself is 胃 (胃疼). 大肚子 = pregnant, or a beer belly.
发 reads fà here. Separable: 理了个发 · 理过发. 去理发 · 理发店/理发师. For a woman's salon visit you'd more often hear 剪头发/做头发.
Collective and formal — a category of staff: 工作/服务/医务/技术/安保人员 · 全体人员 · 人员不足. A single employee is 员工 or 工作人员.
查/找/收集资料 research material · 参考资料 · 个人资料 profile details · 资料库. 数据 is numeric data; 材料 leans physical or documentary.
Literally a female student, but used for young women generally: 班上的女生 · 女生宿舍 · 那个女生. 女孩(儿) is a girl by age; 女士 is the formal 'Ms'.
Straight before the noun, no measure word: 整个晚上/城市/过程. 全 covers 'all of a set' (全班/全部); 整个 is the one whole thing, undivided.
Separable: 开了两个小时的会 · 开完会 · 开个短会. No object follows it — a specific meeting is 会议: 参加会议 · 召开会议 for convening one.
条 is the classifier: 一条短信 · 发/收/回短信. Strictly carrier SMS — nowadays verification codes and spam; chat messages are 消息 (回消息/发微信).
Romantic love as an abstraction: 爱情故事/小说 · 相信爱情 · 爱情观. Dating is 谈恋爱; loving a person is 爱他. 感情 is the feeling inside a relationship.
Causative and separable: 伤了他的心 hurt his feelings. Also 别伤心 · 为这事伤心 · 伤心事 · 伤心得哭了. 难过 is the everyday 'feel bad'; 悲伤 is written grief.
In practice an email inbox or address: 发到我的邮箱 · 邮箱地址 · 查邮箱 · 企业邮箱. The message itself is 邮件; the street postbox sense lives on in 信箱.
First-hand trying-out: 体验生活 · 体验新功能 · 亲身体验 · 用户体验 UX. 经验 is accumulated know-how; 经历 is the events you've been through.
Formal and collective: 青年人 · 有志青年 · 青年节 · 青少年 teens. In conversation you'd say 年轻人. The ladder: 少年 · 青年 · 中年 · 老年.
Counted with 对: 这对夫妻 · 夫妻俩 · 夫妻关系. 夫妇 is the formal version used after a surname (张先生夫妇). Speech uses 老公/老婆; writing 丈夫/妻子.
坐/乘高铁 · 高铁站/票 · 高铁线路. It's the G-train network; 动车 (D trains) are the slower tier, and 火车 is the general word covering both.
Takes a proposal or a clause: 同意这个方案 · 同意你的看法 · 同意他去. 答应 is agreeing to do what someone asked; 赞成 is being in favor of a course.
Separable: 发了三天烧 · 发高烧 · 不发烧了. Bringing it down is 退烧. Unrelated slang: 发烧友 = an obsessive hobbyist (audiophiles, gear geeks).
Two poles. Admiring: 你真厉害. Severe: 疼得厉害 · 病得很厉害 — as a 得-complement it just intensifies the bad thing. 害 is neutral tone, lìhai.
Verb 'be used to': 习惯了这里的生活 · 不习惯 · 习惯早起. Noun: 好/坏习惯 · 养成习惯 form one · 改掉习惯 · 生活习惯.
家 marks an accomplished practitioner: 作家 · 音乐家 · 科学家 · 摄影家. 位 is the respectful classifier: 这位画家. Someone who just paints is 画画的.
Object is the feeling itself: 感到高兴/意外/惊讶 · 感到压力 · 感到饿. For an opinion or judgement, 觉得/认为 are the natural verbs. 感到 is a shade more written than 觉得.
Written stand-in for 吗 / V-not-V: sits before the verb and the sentence takes no 吗 — 是否愿意 · 请确认是否收到. Also embeds a clause: 不知道他是否会来.
A count of discrete things: 数量多/少 · 增加/控制数量 · 数量上. Its standing partner is 质量 quality (保证质量和数量); the volume of an activity is 量 — 工作量, 饭量.
Any notable figure — writer, scientist, athlete — not just entertainers (those are 明星): 社会名人 · 名人效应 · 名人名言 famous sayings.
Looking for faults or verifying: 检查作业/身体 · 检查一遍 · 检查出问题 (result complement). Also a noun: 做个检查 · 安全检查. Looking information up is 查.
Also how children address any woman of their mother's generation (张阿姨), and the ordinary word for a cleaner or nanny — 请个阿姨. Father's sister is 姑姑.
Locative, sits before the verb as 'inwardly': 心里想 · 心里难受 · 心里有数 know where one stands · 记在心里 · 心里话 what one really thinks. 心中 is the literary twin.
The problem goes first as a topic, never as its object: 钱丢了，怎么办？ Embeds too: 不知道该怎么办 · 该怎么办才好. 怎么办 asks for a fix; 怎么了 asks what happened.
Takes an object or a whole clause: 害怕黑 · 害怕失败 · 害怕他不来. Everyday speech often just uses 怕 (我怕冷); 害怕 is heavier. 恐怕 'I'm afraid that…' is a separate adverb.
Takes a clause or another verb: 忘记带钥匙 · 忘记他说过什么. Speech leans on bare 忘 + 了 (我忘了), and the potential form is 忘不了 can't forget · 别忘了.
Also the computing term: 下拉菜单 dropdown · 菜单栏 menu bar · 右键菜单 context menu. Restaurant: 看菜单 · 点菜.
The verb is 办 or 申请: 办签证 · 申请签证 · 签证到期 expires · 延期/续签 renew · 拒签 be refused · 免签 visa-free · 旅游/学生签证.
The western region of a country, not the West as a civilization (西方): 中国西部 · 西部大开发 · 美国西部片 westerns. A direction from where you stand is 西边/以西.
Grasping the reasoning, and also 'be understanding of': 我理解你的心情 · 请多理解 · 表示理解 · 可以理解 understandable · 理解力. Merely following what's said is 懂/明白.
Always relative to someone: 对我们很有利, or written 有利于 + verb phrase — 有利于健康. Attributive 有利条件/地位. Opposite 不利, same patterns.
Counted 一根香蕉; a bunch is 一串/一把香蕉 · 剥香蕉 peel one · 香蕉皮.
Narrative 'thereupon' — the second clause is the next action: 天黑了，于是我们回家了. Often 于是就. For spelling out a reason's result, 所以/因此 fit better.
The general word: 外语水平 · 外语系 · 学一门外语 (measure 门) · 第二外语. 外文 attaches to written material — 外文书/资料/文献; 外国话 is the colloquial one.
Any man of your father's generation is addressed this way — 张叔叔, 谢谢叔叔. Strictly father's younger brother; his elder brother is 伯伯/大伯. 大叔 = middle-aged guy.
Titles follow the surname in address: 王校长 · 校长好. 当/担任校长 serve as. It covers everything from primary-school head to university president.
Read shēngyi, neutral second syllable. 做生意 be in business · 谈生意 · 生意好/不好 · 生意人. 商业 is commerce as a domain, 业务 a firm's line of work.
Forest at scale; a small stand of trees is 树林. 森林公园 · 原始森林 old-growth · 森林火灾 · 森林覆盖率.
Metric km — the traditional 里 is 500 m, so 一公里 = 两里. 走了三公里 · 时速八十公里 · 每公里 · 平方公里.
Written register, introduces a list and often closes with 等/等等 — 例如北京、上海等. Heads the example itself; the spoken counterpart is 比如(说).
Separable: the spouse goes in a 和/跟 phrase — 和他结婚 marry him · 结过婚 · 结了三次婚 · 结婚十年了. Transitive 'marry sb' is 娶 (a wife) / 嫁给 (a husband).
Frame 对…(很)满意 — 我对结果很满意 — and it also takes the thing directly, as in the card's sentence. 不满意 · 令人满意 · 满意的答复 · 满意度.
In questions it means 'on earth' and wants a wh-word or A-not-A, not 吗: 到底是谁？ · 你到底去不去？ In statements, 'in the end' — 到底还是他赢了. Literal: 坚持到底.
The porn reading only surfaces in fixed pairings — 黄色网站/小说/录像, 扫黄 anti-porn drive; on its own it is just the colour, as in the card's 黄色的裙子.
Usually postposed to the set it partitions: 我们当中最高的 · 三个人当中 · 这当中另有原因. For a physical midpoint, 中间 (坐在中间).
Takes a following verb phrase, not a noun: 打算出国 · 打算怎么办 · 没打算去. Also a noun — 你有什么打算？ 计划 is the formal twin and does take noun objects.
The simultaneity use needs both halves: 一边看书一边听音乐; speech clips it to 边看边听. Separately it is 'one side': 一边高一边低 · 站到一边去.
Beyond 'date' it is life as it is lived: 过日子 get by · 日子过得真快 · 好日子 the good times · 挑个好日子 pick an auspicious one. A calendar date on a form is 日期.
Also 'business day' in delivery and processing language: 三到五个工作日内 within 3–5 business days. Its opposites are 休息日 and 节假日.
Negates necessity, not permission: 不用担心 · 不用谢 · 不用了 'no thanks' when declining. 不要 is a prohibition, 不能 an inability — 不用去 just means there's no need.
School-flavoured 'guy': students, and loosely any young man — 班里的男生 · 那个男生. Adults at work are 男的/男士, a child is 男孩. Pair: 女生.
Verb-object already, so it takes no object of its own: 在家办公 work from home · 办公时间/地点 · 办公用品 supplies · 办公室. General 'work' is 工作/办事.
Of places, and of people holding their noise: 请安静 · 安静一点 · 安静下来 settle down · 安安静静地看书. Of a person's nature it means placid.
Object is whatever gets pulled in: 吸引注意/眼球 · 吸引游客/投资/人才 · 被他的声音吸引 · 很有吸引力 appealing. The magnet sense sits behind all of it.
What is emitted or issued follows: 发出声音/光/气味 · 发出邀请/命令/警告/信号. Sending a message or file is 发送/发过去; 发出 is something leaving its source.
Doubles as a verb 'be X away from', as in the card's sentence: 这里距离市中心十公里 · 距离考试还有三天. Noun: 保持距离 · 有一段距离 quite a way · 距离感.
Formal 'read a text': 阅读理解 reading comprehension · 课外阅读 · 阅读量/习惯 · 阅读障碍 dyslexia. Everyday speech says 看书/看报; 读书 is studying or reading aloud.
走楼梯 take the stairs · 上/下楼梯 · 爬楼梯 climb · 楼梯口 · 楼梯间 stairwell. A single step, or an outdoor flight, is 台阶; the lift is 电梯.
Adverb of the immediate past, right before the verb: 他刚刚出门 · 刚刚才知道. Second sense 'exactly': 刚刚好 just right · 刚刚够. 刚才 is a time word (刚才的事).
Strictly the address string; the site itself is 网站: 网址是什么？ · 把网址发给我 · 复制网址 copy the link. You 访问/上 a 网站, not a 网址.
Separable and intransitive: 大学毕业 (card's line) · 从北大毕业 · 毕业于清华 (formal) · 毕了业再说 · 毕业生/毕业典礼. The school goes before it, or after 从/于.
Needs a 和/与/跟 phrase in front: 和去年相比 · 与他相比. Then 相比之下 by comparison · 相比而言. Plain measuring uses 比 (今年比去年好); 相比 sets up the frame.
Object is the question or the person: 回答问题 · 回答我 · 回答不上来 can't come up with an answer. Also a noun: 他的回答. Replying to a message is 回复; 答应 = agree.
Beyond ugly: 脸色很难看 looking grim or unwell · 输得很难看 lose badly · 闹得太难看 an ugly scene. Parallel to 难听 harsh to hear and 难闻 bad-smelling.
Adverb before the verb: 常常去/常常忘. Negate with 不常 or 很少 rather than 不常常. 经常 is the close twin, a shade more formal and also a modifier (经常性).
Pairs with 多/少 rather than 大/小: 人数很多 · 人数不够 · 统计/清点人数 · 人数超过五百. Same family: 字数 word count, 次数 number of times, 人次 person-visits.
Nearly always about elapsed time, with a negative or a duration: 好久没见 · 好久不见 · 等了好久 · 好久以前. 好 here is 'quite a', as in 好几个/好多.
Grassy ground in general; a manicured lawn is 草坪 (请勿践踏草坪) and open steppe is 草原. Locative takes 上: 在草地上玩.
Follows its landmark: 学校附近 · 这附近 around here · 附近有超市吗？ It is a place word, so it can be the subject or take 在/到 — 就在附近.
开/关空调 turn it on/off · 装空调 install · 空调坏了 · 空调房 an air-conditioned room · 中央空调. The cool air itself is 冷气, the southern and Taiwan word.
Modifier for the details: 具体情况/时间/要求/内容. As a discourse move, 具体来说 to be specific · 具体到每个人. 具体点儿 asks someone to get concrete; opposite 抽象.
In China the whole southern half as a cultural region — 南方人 · 南方话 · 南方菜. The southern portion of a named place is 南部; a direction from you is 南边.
十字路口 crossroads · 丁字路口 T-junction · 到路口左转 · 在路口等我. Chinese directions hang on 路口 the way English uses 'the corner'.
Separable — a length splits it: 放三天假 · 放暑假 · 学校下周放假. Institutions 放假; an individual asking for leave 请假, and the time off itself is 假期.
Financial register — object is the money or charge: 支付费用/租金/工资 · 移动支付 · 支付方式 · 支付宝. Daily speech says 付钱/付款/给钱.
Postposed and personal: 在大家面前 · 摆在我面前 · 困难面前不低头. 前面 is the plain spatial 'ahead' (前面有个路口) with no sense of facing anyone.
The long coat specifically: 一件大衣 · 穿上/脱下大衣 · 羽绒大衣. Any outer layer at all is 外套; a down jacket 羽绒服, a trench coat 风衣.
Verb-object, so it splits: 开了花 · 树上开满了花 · 花开了. Figurative: 心里乐开了花 delighted · 遍地开花 spring up everywhere.
A time word, not an adverb — it can head the sentence or modify a noun: 刚才我在开会 · 刚才的电话 · 刚才那个人. Bare 刚/刚刚 goes before the verb instead (他刚走).
行 is háng here, the 'trade/firm' reading — same as 同行 peers, 内行 an expert. 去银行 · 在银行工作 · 银行卡/账户 · 银行转账.
Neutral-tone sūnzi = grandson; the strategist in 《孙子兵法》 is Sūnzǐ, full third tone — the card's sentence. Daughter's son is 外孙, granddaughter 孙女.
送他一份礼物 / 送礼物给他 · 收到礼物 · 一份 or 一件礼物 · 生日礼物 · 礼物清单. Gift-giving as social custom is 送礼, which hints at currying favour.
Lives in a 对 frame with 有 or 感: 对音乐很有兴趣 / 很感兴趣 · 引起兴趣 · 培养兴趣 · 兴趣爱好 hobbies · 兴趣班 after-school class.
Sharing something good with people: 分享经验/心得/快乐 · 跟大家分享一下 · 分享到朋友圈. Splitting a thing up is 分; sharing a burden is 分担.
Three loads: 建筑材料 physical stock · a dish's ingredients · and paperwork — 申请材料 application documents, 参考材料. 他是块当老师的材料 = the makings of.
The cause behind a fact: 主要原因 · 找出原因 · 原因在于… · 出于…原因. 理由 is the justification you offer (没有理由拒绝); 原因 explains, 理由 defends.
Written 能不能: 请问能否明天答复 · 不确定他能否按时到. The verb follows it directly and the sentence takes no 吗. Speech uses 能不能/可不可以.
Usually a modifier, not a predicate: 快速发展/增长 · 快速通道 fast lane · 快速充电 · 快速反应. Of a thing's actual speed you say 很快. Written and technical.
An indoor sports hall or arena for PE and events — a workout gym is 健身房. 去体育馆打球 · 体育馆开放时间. The open-air stadium is 体育场.
Also 'find it odd', with a clause: 我很奇怪他为什么没来 · 觉得很奇怪. Discourse frame 奇怪的是… oddly enough. Bare 怪 is the adverb 'rather': 怪好看的.
Of a person's quickness: 又聪明又用功 · 聪明的做法 a smart move · 装聪明 act clever. A wise decision is 明智; 聪明反被聪明误 = outsmarting yourself.
Separable — the target goes inside: 生他的气 be angry at him · 别跟我生气 · 生了半天气. 气 alone is the transitive one: 你气死我了 you infuriate me.
Two jobs: the hedge 'seems' — 好像要下雨了 (card's line) · 我好像见过他; and the simile 好像…一样/似的 — 高兴得好像个孩子一样. As a hedge it softens claims.
A formulation or claim, something you weigh for truth: 这种说法不准确 · 换个说法 put it another way · 有一种说法是… there's a saying. 讨个说法 demand an accounting.
The stretch of time itself: 暑假/寒假 · 假期作业 · 假期期间 · 度过假期. Getting it is 放假 (institution) or 请假 (you asking); a public holiday date is 假日.
Indexes single characters; a word-and-phrase dictionary is 词典, also in this deck. 查字典 look it up · 一本字典 · 《新华字典》 is the standard one.
An organised sub-unit, not just a cluster of people: 分成四个小组 · 小组讨论/作业 · 学习小组 · 小组赛 group stage. Its head is 组长.
Separable: 去日本留学 · 出国留学 · 留过两年学 · 留学生/留学申请. The destination normally comes ahead of it with 去/在 — 在英国留学.
People and problems alike: 遇到老朋友 · 遇到困难/麻烦/问题 · 遇到这种情况. 碰到/碰见 is the chattier twin for running into someone; 遇见 is warmer, more literary.
The course as a programme; a single session is 课 (今天有三节课). 选课 pick courses · 课程安排/设置 · 必修/选修课程 · 在线课程 · 课程表 timetable.
Roughly 10–17 and mostly written: 少年时代 boyhood · 青少年 adolescents · 少年犯 juvenile offender · 少年宫. Read shào here, the 'young' reading, not shǎo.
Register scale: 旅馆 budget inn · 宾馆 plain mid-range, slightly dated, state-run in flavour · 酒店 the modern default · 民宿 B&B. 住宾馆 stay at one.
The verb is 刷: 刷信用卡 · 盗刷 a fraudulent charge, as in the card's sentence · 办/申请信用卡 · 还信用卡 pay it off · 信用卡账单. Debit card is 借记卡.
Mostly the staged event: 一场演出 · 演出开始/结束 · 参加/举行演出 · 巡回演出 tour · 演出服. The performing itself is 表演, which takes an object: 表演节目/魔术.
Also asks about availability: 你明天方便吗？ · 方便的话 if it's no trouble · 提供方便. 方便面 instant noodles; 去方便一下 is the euphemism for a toilet trip.
Counted 一本护照 · 办/申请护照 · 出示护照 present it (card's line) · 护照过期 expires · 补办/换发 replace or renew · 护照号码.
记笔记 / 做笔记 take notes — the gloss's 'to take note' is really this collocation. 一份笔记 · 课堂笔记 · 笔记本 means both a notebook and a laptop (笔记本电脑).
A collective, not a way to address one person: 姐妹俩 the two of them · 三姐妹 · 兄弟姐妹 siblings · 好姐妹 close girlfriends · 姐妹城市 sister cities.
Heavier than English 'criticize' — a reprimand, usually downward: 老师批评了他 · 受到/挨批评 get told off · 提出批评. Appraising a work is 评论/评价.
Of people it is warm and hospitable, not romantic passion: 对客人很热情 · 热情招待/欢迎. As a noun, enthusiasm — 工作热情 · 充满热情 · 热情不高.
Object is something scheduled or granted: 取消比赛/航班/会议/预约 · 取消订单 · 取消资格 disqualify. Deleting data is 删除; undoing a decision is 撤销.
Making something new, against 发现 for finding what was already there: 发明电灯 vs 发现新星. Also a noun — 一项发明 · 发明专利 · 发明家.
Idiomatically 'ages', with a note of exasperation: 找了半天 (card's line) · 等了你半天 · 说了半天你还不懂. The literal half-day survives in 上/下半天.
Separable: 拍张照 · 拍了几张照 · 给我拍个照. To photograph a subject, 拍 takes it directly — 拍风景 · 拍我. 照相 is the older-sounding twin.
Commercial food products: 进口食品 · 食品安全/包装/添加剂 · 冷冻食品. What you actually eat is 食物, a cooked dish is 菜. 食品 belongs on labels and in shops.
Separable: 照张相 · 照了几张相 · 给他照相. Sounds a shade dated next to 拍照; 照相机 camera and 照相馆 photo studio keep it current.
Sits in the 可+verb family 'worth V-ing': 可爱 lovable, 可怕 frightening, 可笑 laughable, 可惜 a pity. 长得很可爱 · 可爱的小狗 · 卖萌 is the slangy act of playing cute.
Separable: 开个玩笑 · 别开玩笑了 · 开他的玩笑 / 拿他开玩笑 tease him · 你开玩笑吧？ you're kidding. 玩笑 rarely appears without 开.
Two objects: 提醒我开会 remind me to · 提醒他注意安全 · 提醒一下 · 我提醒过你 I did warn you. It is the neutral 'flag it'; a formal warning is 警告.
For abstractions: 印象深刻 make a strong impression · 深刻的教训/理解/变化 · 深刻反思. Physical depth is plain 深 (水很深).
Adverbial before the verb: 认真学习 · 认真听/认真考虑. Predicate: 他工作很认真 conscientious · 我是认真的 I mean it. Taking a joke literally is 当真.
Works bare before the verb — 他突然摔倒了, no 地 needed — and as a predicate: 太突然了 · 来得很突然 · 突然袭击. 忽然 is the interchangeable adverb-only twin.
Doubles as a noun you handle: 遇到/克服困难 · 有困难找我 · 生活困难 hard up · 困难重重. As an adjective it is weightier and more formal than plain 难.
Anchors to a reference point: 不久以后/之后 soon after · 不久前 not long ago · 出门后不久 (card's line) · 过了不久. Sentence-initially: 不久他就回来了.
Object is a principle or a knack, often a verb phrase: 懂得珍惜 · 懂得感恩 · 懂得怎么做. Understanding words or a language is plain 懂 — 听不懂 · 懂中文.
You 戴 a hat, not 穿: 戴帽子 · 摘/脱帽子 take it off · 一顶帽子. Figurative 扣帽子 pin a label on someone · 绿帽子 cuckold.
Counted 一条裙子 · 穿裙子 · 短裙 miniskirt · 半身裙 when the contrast matters. Careful: 连衣裙 is a dress, not a skirt.
Separable: 洗个澡 · 洗了半个小时澡 · 天天洗澡. It covers bath and shower both; specify with 淋浴 shower or 泡澡 soak. 洗澡水 · 洗澡间.
Fixed frame 对…感兴趣: 她对摄影很感兴趣 · 不感兴趣. The degree word goes inside — 很/非常感兴趣. The noun version is 对…有兴趣.
Indexes words and phrases; single characters are 字典's job. 查词典 · 一本词典 · 汉英/双语词典 · 电子词典. 辞典 is the older, Taiwan-flavoured spelling.
Takes a verb phrase directly: 继续说 · 继续努力 · 继续下去 keep it up. Noun objects are limited to set terms like 继续教育. 接着 moves to the next action; 继续 resumes.
Separable: 搬过三次家 · 帮我搬家 · 下个月搬家. The destination goes with plain 搬 — 搬到北京 · 搬走 · 搬出去 move out. Moving an object is also 搬 (搬桌子).
As an adverb it is an urgent plea, nearly always imperative and usually negative: 千万不要 · 千万别忘了 · 千万记住 · 千万小心. Literal 'ten million': 千万富翁.
一块蛋糕 a slice vs 一个蛋糕 the whole thing · 切蛋糕 · 生日蛋糕 · 奶油蛋糕. Figurative 分蛋糕 / 做大蛋糕 = dividing or growing the economic pie.
Sets up a reversal: 本来想去，后来没去. With 就 it flips to 'was that way all along' — 他本来就不同意. 原来 is 'as it turns out'; 本来 is 'as it was'.
Person first, then what about: 通知他去开会 · 通知大家明天放假 · 提前通知. Also the notice itself — 发/接到通知 · 一份通知 · 录取通知书 admission letter.
Everyday 'grown-up', paired against 小孩: 大人说话小孩别插嘴 · 一个大人两个小孩. The legal term is 成年人. The 'my lord' sense (包大人) is costume-drama only.
上名单 / 列入名单 be on the list · 名单上没有他 · 公布名单 announce · 黑名单 blacklist · 获奖/参赛名单. It is names specifically; a shopping list is 清单/单子.
Takes a whole clause and usually opens with no subject: 听说他要走了. 听说过 = have heard of (没听说过这个人). It flags hearsay, softening what you can't vouch for.
Hedges quantities and states: 差不多十点 about ten · 差不多好了 nearly done · 跟他差不多高. 差不多了 also closes things off ('that'll do').
Resultative — negate with 没, not 不: 没收到你的邮件. Potential forms: 信号收不到 can't get a signal · 收得到. 收 alone is the act — 收礼物 · 收快递.
Transitive: 适合老年人 (card's line) · 适合初学者 · 这本书适合我. Its mirror 合适 is the predicate with no object — 这件衣服很合适 · 找个合适的时间.
With 了 it means vanished: 钥匙不见了 · 人不见了. Bare 不见 is refusing a meeting — 他谁都不见. Set phrases: 好久不见 · 不见不散 be there or be square.
Northern China as a cultural half — 北方人 · 北方话 · 北方菜, roughly north of the Huai River. The northern part of a named place is 北部; a direction from you, 北边.
The spoken counterpart of 例如: 比如说吧 · 比如这个 · 比如水果，苹果香蕉都行. It can head a fragment mid-conversation; 例如 belongs to writing and lists closing in 等.
Object is the reaction it triggers: 引起注意/重视 · 引起误会/争议/不满 · 引起火灾. 造成 is for damage done (造成损失), 导致 for a bad outcome.
Also 'in short supply / strained': 时间紧张 · 资金紧张 · 关系紧张 tense relations · 局势紧张. Of people: 别紧张 relax · 紧张得说不出话.
Written-register 好像: 他似乎不太高兴 · 似乎有些道理 · 事情似乎并不简单. Adverb only, so it can't run the 好像…一样 comparison. Speech prefers 好像/看起来.
Everyday word for a patient; hospital signage and medical writing say 患者 (糖尿病患者). 照顾病人 · 病人家属 the family · 重症病人.
Preposition plus a noun, then the main clause: 按照计划进行 · 按照规定办 · 按照他的说法. 根据 is close but leans evidential (根据调查); 按 is the clipped spoken form.
'Then / go on': 你接着说 carry on · 先吃饭，接着看电影 · 紧接着 right after. Also literal — 接着! catch it. 继续 resumes the same activity; 接着 starts the next.
In practice 'email', short for 电子邮件: 发/收一封邮件 · 邮件地址 · 查收邮件. A parcel is 包裹, courier delivery 快递; 邮件 as physical post is postal-service language.
Negative by default: 严重的后果 · 承担后果 bear the consequences · 后果自负 you're liable · 后果不堪设想 unthinkable. Neutral outcomes are 结果.
Everyday 'quality': 质量好/差 · 提高/保证质量 · 质量问题 a defect · 产品质量 · 生活质量. Physics 'mass' is the same word; Taiwan says 品质 for the quality sense.
Fronts the clause as an inference from evidence: 看来今天要下雨了 · 看来他是不来了. With a person it becomes a viewpoint frame: 在我看来 in my view · 在他看来.
Verb-object: 手机关机了 · 关了机 · 关机重启. Its pair is 开机 boot up. Closing an app is 关掉/退出; hanging up a call is 挂电话.
Needs an open-ended slot — a wh-word, A-not-A, or 多么 — and 都/也 in the second clause: 不管谁来都一样 · 不管多难也要做. Spoken; 无论/不论 are the written twins.
Covers taste and smell both: 味道很香/很怪 · 什么味道？ On its own, 有味道 often hints at a bad smell; figuratively it is 'has character' (这幅画很有味道). Colloquial 味儿.
Correlative with 而且/还/也: 他不但聪明还很勤奋. Same subject, 不但 follows it; different subjects, 不但 goes first — 不但我去，他也去. 不仅 is the written twin.
A refusal or verdict: 这样不行 · 我不行了 I'm done for. Also a degree complement where it just means 'extremely': 累得不行 dead tired · 疼得不行.
The occasion itself: 传统节日 · 过节 celebrate one · 节日气氛 festive mood · 节日快乐. A day off work is 假日/假期; 节日 is about what's being marked.
Written 不管: 不论天气怎样 · 不论男女老少 · 不论如何. Same requirement — an open slot, then 都/也 in the second clause. 无论 is interchangeable and commonest.
Weightier than 谢谢, for speeches and writing: 感谢大家的支持 · 表示感谢 · 感谢信 · 非常感谢. Takes a person plus what for; everyday thanks is 谢谢.
Transitive — you 开发 something: 开发新产品/软件/市场 · 开发资源 · 开发商 property developer · 开发区. 发展 is growth without an object (经济发展).
An identifying string, not a quantity: 电话号码 · 身份证号码 · 房间号码 · 拨号码 dial. Speech shortens it to 号 (我的手机号). Counting numbers are 数字.
Verb-object like 放假: 三点放学 · 放学以后 · 还没放学. Going to school is 上学; 下课 ends a single period, 放学 ends the school day.
Sad, but also physically wretched: 心里很难过 · 胃里难过 queasy · 为他难过 feel bad for him · 别难过. 伤心 is sharper grief; 难受 is the same discomfort minus the sorrow.
保持冷静 keep calm · 冷静下来 cool off · 你冷静点 · 冷静地分析. It is level-headed judgement, not coldness toward people — that is 冷淡/冷漠.
Pairs with 大/小: 压力很大 · 工作/学习压力 · 承受压力 bear it · 减轻/缓解压力 relieve · 给他很大压力 · 有压力才有动力.
Usually with 就: 马上就来 · 马上就要开始了 for an imminent event. 立刻/立即 are the crisper, more formal versions; 马上 stretches to 'in a bit' in practice.
Mass-ish noun: 一件行李 a piece · 收拾行李 pack · 托运/取行李 check in and collect · 手提行李 carry-on · 行李箱 suitcase. Read xíngli, neutral second syllable.
Adverb summing a total, before the verb: 一共多少钱？ · 一共有五个人 · 一共花了两小时. 总共 is the same with a formal tinge; 一起 means jointly, not a total.
Formal 'talks' as much as chat: 与对方对话 · 展开/进行对话 · 中美对话. A film's spoken lines are 对白; a software dialog box is 对话框.
老年人 is the neutral demographic term (老年人优惠); 老人 is everyday, and 老人家 the respectful way to address one. 照顾老人 · 空巢老人 empty-nesters.
Mostly institutional: 对外开放 · 开放时间 opening hours · 向学生开放 · 改革开放. Of a person, 思想开放 open-minded. The flower sense in the card's line is literary.
Food, air and novelty alike: 新鲜的水果 · 新鲜空气 · 新鲜事 something new · 新鲜感 the novelty · 图个新鲜 do it for the novelty · 没什么新鲜的.
Object is time, people or an event: 安排时间/工作/住宿 · 安排他去 assign him · 安排好了 all set. Also a noun — 你有什么安排？ · 课程安排 the schedule.
Object is normally the person: 原谅他 · 请你原谅我 · 请多原谅, the set formula in letters. 不可原谅 unforgivable. Asking for it is 请求原谅; apologising is 道歉.
Formal 'correct' for answers, views and decisions: 正确答案 · 正确的做法 · 正确对待. Speech just says 对 (你说得对). 准确 = accurate, a different axis.
Two directions: 我怀疑他在撒谎 suspect that he is, and 怀疑自己的能力 doubt it. Takes a noun or a clause · 值得怀疑 questionable · 毫无疑问 beyond doubt.
Almost always a modifier: 常用词 · 常用汉字 · 常用工具/方法 · 最常用的. As a predicate you would say 很常用 or 经常用.
Determiner or standalone: 别的颜色 · 还有别的吗？ · 我不想要别的. Note that 'other people' has its own word, 别人, far commoner than 别的人.
Member by subscription or enrolment: 办会员 sign up · 会员卡/价 · 付费会员 · 会员制. A member of a team or family is 成员 (家庭成员); of a party, 党员.
Object is a burden or an intensity: 减轻压力/负担/痛苦/症状 · 减轻处罚 lighten a penalty. 减少 cuts a count (减少人数); 减轻 makes what remains easier to bear.
Urging tone, mostly in commands and plans: 赶快走吧 · 你赶快去看看 · 赶快把事办完. 赶紧 is the more colloquial twin; 马上 states timing without the push.
Separable, and normally reduplicated in narrative: 点了点头 · 点点头 · 点了一下头. 点头同意/答应 nod one's assent. Its opposite is 摇头.
Lives in set well-wishes and descriptions: 合作愉快 · 旅途/周末愉快 · 心情愉快 · 玩得很愉快. For 'I'm happy' right now, 高兴/开心; 愉快 rates the experience.
Commercial register: 购物中心 mall · 购物车 shopping cart, also the website kind · 网上购物 · 购物节. Everyday speech says 买东西 or 逛街.
Recognising by sight, and a touch colloquial: 我认得他 · 认得路 know the way · 不认得这个字. 认识 is the neutral default and covers being acquainted.
讲/说个笑话 tell one. Also a verb meaning mock: 别笑话我 don't laugh at me · 让人笑话 be laughed at. 闹笑话 make a fool of yourself · 成了个笑话 a laughing stock.
Three roles at once: host to a 客人, owner of a pet or property, and master. 男/女主人 the man or woman of the house · 主人公 the protagonist of a story.
Leaving something behind or keeping it: 留下一张纸条 · 留下地址/电话 · 给他留下好印象. 留下来 = stay on. What is left over by itself is 剩下 (剩下三个).
As a bare noun it is the motorway — 走高速, the card's line, short for 高速公路. As a modifier: 高速发展 · 高速运转 · 高速摄影. 高铁 is the train (高速铁路).
