Counted 一份报纸 · 看报纸, clipped to 看报 in speech · 订报纸 subscribe · 登在报纸上 appear in the paper. 报社 is the newspaper as an organisation.
Republican head of state: 当选总统 elected · 总统大选 · 前总统 · 总统府. China's leader is 国家主席; a head of government elsewhere is 总理/首相.
Colloquial 很多, normally right before a noun: 好多人 · 好多次. Same spoken 好 as 好大 · 好久不见. Written prose prefers 很多/许多.
付现金 pay cash · 收现金 · 现金支付 (vs 刷卡/转账) · 现金流 cash flow · 提现 cash out a balance. Small change is 零钱.
The eastern region inside a larger area: 中国东部 · 东部沿海 · 城市东部. 东边/东面 is the side relative to a spot; 东方 is the East as direction or culture.
Formal 现在, naming the current stage: 到目前为止 so far · 目前的情况 · 就目前来看 · 目前还没有决定. Heads the clause or sits right after the subject.
Economic-sector sense dominates: 信息/文化产业 · 产业链 supply chain · 产业升级 · 支柱产业. 工业 is manufacturing; 行业 the trade you work in.
The written location string: 家庭住址 · 收货地址 shipping address · 详细地址 · 留个地址. Digital too — 邮箱地址 · IP地址; a URL is 网址.
Negates obligation, not ability: 不必担心 · 不必客气 · 你不必每次都来 · 大可不必 quite unnecessary. 不用 is the everyday spoken version; 别 tells someone not to.
Reading trap: 似 = shì only in this particle (sì in 似乎/相似). Clause-final, usually paired with 像/跟/好像: 像孩子似的 · 跟没事人似的. Colloquial twin of …一样.
Separable (动了手 · 动过手); the person you strike takes 对 — 对孩子动手. Other sense is getting started: 自己动手 DIY · 赶快动手做 · 动手能力 hands-on skill.
Said of things watched or read — 表演/比赛/演讲/片段: 演得很精彩 · 精彩极了 · 精彩瞬间. A person's quality is 优秀/出色.
The compass direction in the abstract, and 'the East' as a culture: 太阳从东方升起 · 东方文化 · 东方明珠. The east side of a place is 东边/东面, its region 东部.
Intransitive — the destination attaches with 去/到: 去欧洲旅行 · 到处旅行. 旅游 leans sightseeing (旅游景点/业); 旅行 is the journey — 旅行社 · 旅行箱; work trips 出差.
Modifies abstractions: 美好的生活/回忆/未来/时光 · 美好的祝愿; predicate too — 生活很美好. A beautiful face or view is 美丽/漂亮.
Literally in front of you (眼前一亮 · 眼前一片漆黑) and 'immediate', often hinting at short-sightedness: 眼前的问题 · 只顾眼前利益. 目前 is the neutral 'currently'.
Pairs with 都: 全身都是汗 · 全身无力 · 全身发抖 · 全身上下. 浑身 is the more colloquial twin; 全身心投入 = throw yourself in wholeheartedly.
Measure word 篇: 一篇文章 · 写/发表文章. Idiom 在…上做文章 make an issue of it · 大做文章. 论文 is an academic paper; 报道 a news story.
Blue-collar specifically: 建筑工人 · 农民工 · 工人阶级 · 一名工人. An office employee is 员工/职员; 工作人员 is 'staff on duty'.
办/补办身份证 get or replace · 出示身份证 show ID · 刷身份证 scan it · 身份证号码. 身份 alone is status or identity — 身份证明 · 隐藏身份.
Object is abstract and slow-building: 积累经验/知识/财富 · 长期积累 · 靠阅读积累. Also a noun — 知识的积累. Saving money bit by bit is 攒(钱).
Transitive: 面对现实 face facts · 面对困难/挑战/失败 · 面对镜头. 面临 is the more passive 'be confronted with' (面临危机). 面对面 face-to-face.
Adverb anchored to an event just narrated: 从此以后 · 从此再也不… · 从此改变了一生. When the starting point is now, 今后/从今以后 is more natural.
Noun in practice: 实现梦想 · 梦想成真 · 追求梦想 · 儿时的梦想. As a verb it takes a clause: 我梦想有一天…. 理想 is the sober, planned aspiration.
A thing seen as for sale: 商品价格/质量 · 退换商品 · 商品房 privately sold flat. 产品 is what a maker produces (产品设计); 货 is the stock itself (进货/发货).
Formal 'or else': first clause states what's required, 否则 the consequence — 要复习，否则很难通过. Spoken equivalents 不然/要不然; 否则 rules in writing and notices.
Two ranges: ecology — 环境保护/污染 · 环保; and a place's feel — 餐厅环境不错 · 学习/生活环境. Also circumstances: 在这种环境下. 气氛 is an occasion's mood.
Counts human generations and product versions: 这一代人 · 上一代/下一代 · 新一代 · 一代又一代. 年代 is a decade (八十年代); 时代 the era itself.
Two jobs: comparison A不如B(+adj) — 我不如他高 · 今年不如去年; and 'might as well' — 不如我们明天去 · 与其等着不如动手. 连…都不如 is the insult form.
Described with 高/低: 收入很高 · 提高收入 · 月收入 · 人均收入 · 收入水平. The verb sense 'take in, include' survives in 收入词典/教材.
到/在年底 · 年底之前 · 年底结算/总结. Pairs with 年初; 年末 is the written twin. The year-end bonus, though, is 年终奖 — 年终, not 年底.
Formal and often figurative: 人生道路 · 走自己的道路 · 道路建设/施工 · 道路两旁. Everyday speech says 路/马路; 公路 is the intercity highway.
Tool as subject, verb phrase after, usually framed 是…用来…的: 这把刀是用来切菜的 · 这笔钱用来买书. With a purpose noun switch to 用于 — 用于教学.
The calendar slot as data: 出生日期 · 截止日期 deadline · 定/改日期 · 日期不详. A day as lived experience is 日子 — 过日子 · 好日子.
Wood as lumps of stuff: 一块木头 · 木头房子 · 木头做的. Of a person, emotionally dense — 他就是块木头 · 木头人 (also the freeze game 一二三木头人).
Pop/professional singer, counted with 名/位: 流行歌手 · 民谣歌手 · 一名歌手. A trained classical vocalist is 歌唱家; 歌星 is a star.
Adverb before the verb: 提前完成/通知/退休; the amount follows it — 提前两天告诉我. Transitive too: 把会议提前到周三. Opposite 推迟/延期.
Adverb between subject and verb: 他们全都同意 · 食物全都吃完了. Whatever it covers must sit before it, so objects get fronted — 把书全都搬走.
Written frame, usually 在…之中: 在这些人之中 · 沉浸在工作之中 · 在不知不觉之中. Speech uses …里/…中. Same 之 as 之一 · 之内 · 之后.
坐电梯 take the lift · 等电梯 · 电梯坏了/停了 · 电梯口. An escalator is 扶梯/自动扶梯; stairs are 楼梯; a ladder is 梯子.
The verb is 举: 举个例子 · 举了一个很好的例子 · 拿他当例子. In writing 例如/比如 introduce the example itself; 例 alone lives in 例外 · 案例 · 举例说明.
School-world word for parent-as-guardian: 家长会 · 学生家长 · 家长签字 · 家长群. Your own parents in conversation are 父母/爸妈.
Written/commercial register for 买: 购买力 purchasing power · 购买商品/保险 · 在线购买 · 购买者. 采购 is bulk buying for an organization; 购物 is shopping.
Adverb before a verb or a quantity: 仅仅睡了三小时 · 仅仅是个开始 · 仅仅因为一句话. Written cousin of 只; most often met in 不仅仅是… 'not merely'.
Intransitive: 试验成功了 · 取得/获得成功. To succeed AT something use 成功地+verb or verb+成功 — 手术做成功了 · 成功地解决. 成功人士 · 成功率.
Object is a place or institution: 参观工厂/博物馆/校园. Visiting a person is 拜访/看望; 访问 is an official visit (访问中国); 游览 is sightseeing.
看风景 · 风景优美/秀丽 · 风景区 scenic area · 风景照 · 沿途的风景. 景色 is how a scene looks at a moment (景色迷人); 景点 the individual tourist spot.
Two lives: transport running behind — 火车晚点了半小时 · 航班晚点; and colloquial 晚点(儿) 'a bit later' — 晚点再说 · 晚点给你打电话.
Hedging 'for the most part', not 'fundamentally': 基本上同意 · 基本上没问题 · 基本上都完成了. Bare 基本 is the adjective — 基本工资 · 基本要求.
Perspective-sensitive: inside China it usually means foreign students there (来华留学生); a Chinese abroad is 中国留学生. Verb: 出国留学 · 留学美国 · 留学生活.
读研究生 do a postgrad degree · 考研 sit the entrance exam · 研究生毕业 · 在读研究生. The degree itself is 硕士 or 博士; an undergrad is 本科生.
A verb in Chinese though a noun in English: 感冒了 · 得了重感冒 · 感冒药. Slang 对…不感冒 = not into it — 我对足球不感冒. 流感 is influenza.
Often the readership as a body: 广大读者 · 读者来信 · 读者群 · 读者反馈. Same -者 family as 观众 (watchers) and 听众 (listeners).
Stage register with a song as object: 演唱一首歌 · 演唱会 concert · 现场演唱. Everyday singing is 唱歌; 演奏 is playing an instrument; 翻唱 a cover.
Adverb before a two-syllable verb: 互相帮助/理解/尊重/影响. 相互 is the one that can also sit before a noun — 相互关系 · 相互作用.
Predicate after the noun: 经验丰富 · 内容/营养丰富 · 资源丰富. Also a verb 'enrich': 丰富业余生活 · 丰富词汇量. Set phrase 丰富多彩 rich and varied.
The intercity road: 高速公路 expressway · 国道/省道 · 公路两旁 · 修公路. A street in town is 马路/街道; 道路 is the abstract cover term; rail is 铁路.
Two jobs: shelve a matter — 这事明天再说吧 · 等我回来再说; and 'besides' adding a reason — 太贵了，再说也不好看. Both are everywhere in speech.
The formal/zoological name; everyday speech just says 熊猫. Counted with 只: 两只大熊猫 · 熊猫馆. 小熊猫 is a different animal, the red panda.
Place word: X的对面 or bare 对面 — 学校对面 · 马路对面 · 坐在我对面 · 对面楼. 对方 is the opposing party in a deal or match, not a location.
心情好/不好 · 心情不错 · 没心情做饭 not in the mood to · 影响心情 · 心情愉快/沉重. 情绪 is the state you lose control of — 情绪激动 · 闹情绪.
Tech/formal register for transmitting: 发送邮件/短信/文件 · 发送成功. Speech just says 发 (发个微信); posting a parcel is 寄; 送 alone is to deliver or see off.
打扫卫生 = do the cleaning (the whole phrase) · 讲卫生 be clean about oneself · 个人/公共卫生 · 不卫生 unsanitary · 卫生纸 · 世界卫生组织.
Transitive on the thing you want: 申请签证/奖学金/退款/破产. The body applied to takes 向 — 向公司申请. Noun too: 提出申请 · 申请表/申请人.
Beyond the literal (阳光明媚 · 阳光照进来), it is an adjective for people — 这个男孩很阳光 upbeat and wholesome — and 'above-board': 阳光工程 · 阳光收费.
Adverb before verbs of change, usually with 了: 大大提高了效率 · 大大降低成本 · 大大缩短时间. Report/written register. Unrelated: 大大小小 'of all sizes'.
Written, often technical — the object is information or resources you go and fetch: 获取信息/数据/权限/利润. 获得 is the general 'obtain'; 取得 pairs with 成绩/进展.
A big public room inside a building: 酒店大厅 lobby · 候机/候车大厅 · 展览大厅. A home's living room is 客厅; an auditorium 礼堂.
Often the bond between people: 两人感情很好 · 培养感情 · 伤感情 · 感情用事 act on emotion. 感觉 is a sensation or hunch; 情感 the written abstract noun.
Warm and slightly folksy — narration and older speakers: 小姑娘 · 一个漂亮姑娘 · 姑娘家. Peers say 女孩(儿)/女生; in many regions it also means one's own daughter.
发奖金 hand out · 领/拿奖金 · 高额奖金 prize money · 年终奖金, usually shortened to 年终奖. 奖学金 is a scholarship; 工资/薪水 the base pay.
Institutional register: 项目/部门负责人 · 主要负责人 · 有关负责人 (news-speak for an unnamed official). The verb 负责 takes 对 for accountability — 对结果负责.
Northern colloquial 一起: 一块儿去 · 咱们一块儿吃饭 · 跟我一块儿. Usually erhua'd in speech; writing prefers 一起. Different 块: 一块钱 · 一块蛋糕.
Separable: 休了三天假 · 休一个月的假 · 正在休假. 请假 is asking to be let off; 放假 is the institution closing (学校放假); 带薪休假 paid leave.
Colloquial 如果, and it wants 就 in the second clause: 要是你不来，我就… · 要是下雨的话就不去了. 的话 can close the condition; 万一 fills the slot for something feared.
Objects are things put into order: 整理房间/行李/资料/笔记 · 整理思路. 收拾 is the spoken twin for tidying (and 收拾人 = teach someone a lesson); 打扫 removes dirt.
Mostly a noun: 两者的区别 · 有什么区别？· 区别在于… · 区别对待 treat differently. As a verb it wants 开/出来 — 区别开来 — and 区分 is the commoner choice.
Trends and diseases alike: 很流行 · 流行起来 · 流行歌曲/服装 · 流行性感冒 → 流感. It is about spread, not affection — a well-liked thing is 受欢迎.
Written twin of 互相, and the one that can precede a noun: 相互作用 interaction · 相互关系 · 相互之间. Before verbs the two overlap — 相互/互相帮助.
Whoever wrote this particular text: 这本书的作者 · 作者不详 · 原作者 · 作者简介. 作家 is a writer by profession, independent of any one work.
Clause-initial written frame: 随着经济的发展，生活水平提高了 — the main clause must state a change tracking the first. Plain 'follow someone' is 跟着/跟随.
Ranks people and their output against a standard: 优秀学生/教师/员工 · 成绩优秀 · 优秀作品/传统. A dazzling performance is 精彩; a well-made product 优质.
News register uses it for the commenting public: 网友纷纷留言 · 有网友表示. Personal sense is a friend known only online — 我的一个网友. 网民 is the statistical term.
The counterpart in a deal, call, match or argument: 与对方合作 · 对方公司/球队 · 站在对方的角度 · 对方不接电话. 对面 is the physical other side.
Both directions: 我很感动 I was moved, and 这部电影感动了很多人. The result takes 得 — 感动得流下了眼泪. 令人感动 · 感人 is the adjective 'touching'.
Small, cheap lodging, and the word feels dated: 住旅馆 · 一家小旅馆. A modern hotel is 酒店, the older state-run kind 宾馆, a hostel 青年旅舍, a homestay 民宿.
Three homes: the media button 按暂停/暂停键; a sports timeout 叫暂停; and official suspension 暂停营业/服务. Transitive too — 暂停比赛.
Short for 笔记本电脑 = laptop, and context decides — 买了个笔记本 usually means a computer. The paper kind is often 本子; taking notes is 记笔记.
Doing something properly and thoroughly: 好好休息/学习/想想 · 好好活着. In speech it erhuas with a tone shift — hǎohāor (好好儿). Often carries urging or mild scolding.
Wants an object: 加快速度/脚步/进度/建设. Bare 'speed up' is 加速 (车加速了) or 快点儿 in speech; the opposite is 放慢.
应届毕业生 = this year's fresh graduate, the phrase in every job ad; 往届毕业生 earlier years'. 大学/高中毕业生 · 毕业于北大. 毕业 itself is separable — 毕了业.
对 X 的态度: 他对工作的态度很认真 · 态度决定一切 · 服务态度 · 端正态度 straighten it out · 表明态度 state where you stand.
Adverb 'expressly, for that alone': 专门来看你 · 专门为你准备的 · 专门关押政治犯. Attributive with 的 for 'specialized': 专门知识/机构. 专业 = major, professional-grade.
Reading splits the sense: xiōngdì = brothers as a set (兄弟俩 · 兄弟公司 sister company); xiōngdi with neutral 弟 = little brother or 'buddy' — 好兄弟 · 兄弟，帮个忙.
Clinical/statistical register for the category: 男性用户/患者/角色 · 以男性为主 · 男性化. Everyday speech says 男的/男人; forms just print 性别：男.
dāying, neutral second syllable. Consent to a request: 答应我一件事 · 他答应了 · 答应下来. Also 'answer when called' — 叫了半天没人答应. 同意 is agreeing with a view.
Ambiguous between 元旦 (Jan 1) and 春节 — 农历新年 disambiguates. 新年快乐 · 新年好 · 过新年 · 新年愿望/计划.
Radio and PA systems: 听广播 · 广播电台 · 校园广播 · 广播体操 · 广播了一条消息. 播放 is playing a file; 直播 is livestreaming.
Resignation to a second-best option: 没有车，他只好走路 · 只好等下次. 不得不 stresses outside compulsion; 只能 can also mean simply 'the only possible way'.
参加高考 sit it · 备战高考 · 高考成绩/分数线 · 高考状元 top scorer · 复读 repeat the year. 中考 is the same at the end of middle school; 考研 for postgrad.
The shop-floor customer: 顾客至上 · 招待顾客 · 老顾客 regular. A firm's account is 客户 (客户经理); a guest 客人; a passenger 乘客.
States an observed regularity, its conditions usually attached: 他往往工作到半夜 · 这种事往往发生在冬天. 常常 is plain frequency and can look forward — 以后常常来.
The paved city street you cross: 过马路 · 马路对面 · 马路边. 街(道) is the street as a place with shops; road names use 路 (中山路); 马路杀手 = a menace at the wheel.
Standing on ceremony: 你太客气了 · 别客气 · 跟我还客气什么 · 说客气话 · 不客气 answers 谢谢. General good manners is 有礼貌.
At home as an attributive: 普通人/普通朋友/普通话 · 一顿普通的家常便饭. As a predicate it can sound dismissive — 这衣服很普通. 一般 also means 'so-so'; 平常 'usual'.
Separable: 报了名 · 报不上名. What you sign up for follows as a verb phrase — 报名参加比赛 · 报名学游泳 · 网上报名 · 报名费 · 报名截止.
Intransitive — what failed is the subject: 投资失败了 · 手术失败. Losing a match is 输; failing an exam 没考过/不及格. 以失败告终 · 失败是成功之母.
少数人 · 极少数 · 少数服从多数 the minority yields to the majority · 少数情况下. Fixed term 少数民族 = ethnic minority. Counterpart 多数/大多数.
A measurement, stated directly: 他身高一米八 · 身高多少？· 量身高 · 身高体重. To say someone IS tall you switch to 个子高/长得高; objects have 高度.
Corrects the appearance just raised: 看起来很忙，实际上没做什么. Heads the clause or follows the subject. 事实上 is the written twin; 其实 the everyday spoken one.
Category/scientific word: 植物园 · 植物油 · 观赏植物 · 属于…科植物 · 动植物. A plant you keep is 花/盆栽; the verb 'to plant' is 种(植).
Playing media: 播放视频/音乐/广告 · 播放器 player · 播放量 view count · 循环播放 loop. 广播 is radio/PA; 直播 live; speech just says 放 — 放首歌.
Verb wants 到 for a completed perception: 感受到他的好意 · 亲身感受. As a noun it is your reflective takeaway — 谈谈你的感受 · 真实感受. 感觉 is the raw sensation.
The room in a home or hotel; in public you ask for 洗手间 (polite) or 厕所 (blunt, and what signs say). 上卫生间 · 打扫卫生间 · 公共卫生间.
Formal, and it takes an object — noun or verb: 停止说话/营业/使用 · 心脏停止跳动. Speech says 别说了 or 停下来; 停 alone halts a vehicle.
Time word before the verb: 我将来想当医生 · 将来你会明白. 未来 is the formal noun and takes measured spans (未来五年 · 未来的城市); 今后 = from now on.
Frame X 分为 N 个部分/类/阶段: 这本书分为三个部分 · 可分为两类. The whole is the subject, so no 被 is needed. 分成 is the everyday version; 分开 separates things.
Adverb before the verb, and it loves negation: 暂时不能确定 · 暂时没有消息 · 暂时离开. With 的 it modifies a noun — 暂时的困难. 临时 means ad hoc (临时决定 · 临时工).
Attributive: 日常生活/工作/用品/开支 · 日常对话. It labels the routine kind of thing, not a frequency — 'every day' is 每天/天天. (Net slang has begun using 很日常.)
Written and elevated: 美丽的风景/姑娘/家乡 · 美丽动人. Speech says 漂亮/好看. 美好 goes with abstractions (美好的回忆); 美丽 with what you can see.
One page; the whole site is 网站 and its address 网址. 打开/刷新/关闭网页 · 网页加载慢 · 网页版 the browser version as opposed to the app.
Title follows the surname: 王教授 · 副教授 · 客座教授 · 当上了教授. The same word doubles as a formal verb 'impart' — 教授汉语/课程. A schoolteacher is 老师.
Look at something to get information from it: 查看记录/邮件/详情/天气 · 查看一下. 检查 inspects for faults (检查身体/作业); 查询 queries a system (查询余额).
Going back over what you have studied: 复习功课/生词 · 复习备考 · 好好复习. 预习 is the counterpart before class; 回顾 reviews events, not material.
The documentary word: 填年龄 · 年龄段 age bracket · 上学的年龄 · 适龄. Asking a person politely uses 年纪 — 您多大年纪. To state it, Chinese just says 他二十岁.
Two senses: still valid — 优惠券还有效吗 · 有效期 · 有效证件; and producing results — 有效的方法 · 有效控制成本. 行之有效 proven effective · 无效 void.
Weather only: 气温下降/回升 · 最高/最低气温 · 平均气温. A room, oven or water has 温度; a body 体温; 天气 covers the weather as a whole.
Attributive and written: 现有资源/条件/设备/技术 · 充分利用现有的…. It labels what is already on hand versus what you would add. 原有 = what was there before.
Commercial launch is the live sense: 推出新产品/套餐/政策 · 隆重推出. The company is the subject. 上市 is going on sale; 发布 is announcing (发布会).
交通方便/不便 well-connected · 交通堵塞 · 交通事故 · 交通工具 means of transport · 公共交通 · 交通规则. Freight haulage is 运输; commuting 通勤.
The Net as industry and infrastructure: 互联网公司/行业/思维 · 移动互联网. Day to day you say 上网 · 网上 · 网络 (网络不好). 因特网 is a dated transliteration.
Counted with 部: 一部电视剧 · 看电视剧 · 追剧 follow a series · 改编自小说. 电影 is film, 综艺 variety shows, 连续剧 the older word for a serial.
Described with 快/慢: 速度很快 · 加快/放慢速度 · 以每小时60公里的速度. 进度 is how far along a task is; 效率 is output per effort.
The inner self as against what you show: 内心深处 deep down · 内心世界 · 发自内心 heartfelt · 内心强大. 心里 is the everyday 'in my mind' — 心里想 · 心里难受.
对 X 的印象: 我对他印象很深 · 第一印象 · 印象深刻 · 留下好印象 · 没印象 don't recall it at all · 印象中 as I remember it.
Pattern 把 X 翻译成 Y: 翻译成英语 · 翻译过来. Also the person — 他是我们的翻译 · 当翻译. 口译 interpreting vs 笔译 written work; 译文 the resulting text.
The substance, in health and supply contexts: 食物中毒 food poisoning · 浪费食物 · 食物链. Packaged goods are 食品 (食品安全); a meal is 饭/饭菜.
Adverb before the verb: 我不得不带伞出门 · 不得不承认. Marks outside compulsion, stronger than 只好. 不得不说 'I have to say' is a stock opener.
Intransitive, for measures that fall: 气温/价格/成绩/销量下降 · 明显下降 · 下降了三个百分点. Lowering something yourself is 降低 (降低成本); markets 下跌; planes 降落.
Two slots: quantity — 钱/时间不够 · 不够用; and degree before an adjective — 不够快 · 不够认真 · 做得还不够好. 不足 is the written version (资金不足).
Institutional noun for the teaching side of a school's work: 教学工作/质量/方法/改革 · 教学楼 · 承担教学任务. Teaching a person something is 教 — 教我汉语.
空气新鲜/清新 · 空气污染/质量 · 呼吸新鲜空气 · 空气流通. The mood of a room is 气氛 (气氛尴尬); 气体 is gas in the chemical sense.
发工资 payday · 涨/加工资 a raise · 工资高/低 · 基本工资 · 工资条 payslip. 薪水/薪资 is the formal register (年薪 · 薪资待遇); 奖金 sits on top.
Collective and written — the ocean as a domain: 海洋生物/资源/污染 · 海洋公园 · 海洋性气候. The sea you swim in or look at is 海/大海 — 去海边 · 大海很蓝.
Object is usually something earned: 赢得尊重/信任/支持/掌声/时间 (赢得比赛 works too). Beating a person is plain 赢 — 赢了他; 获得 covers prizes, 取得 progress.
Measure word 支: 一支球队. 支持/加入/组建球队 · 国家队 · 主队/客队 home and away. 队 alone suffices in context — 我们队赢了; a teammate is 队友.
Also the dining room of a home and the canteen of an institution: 学生餐厅 · 客厅和餐厅. Eating out: 饭店/饭馆 for Chinese places, 食堂 a cafeteria.
Said on parting for the night, not on meeting — the evening greeting is 晚上好. 说/道晚安 · 晚安，好梦 · 跟孩子说声晚安.
Connector at the head of a clause: …，相反，他笑了. Also predicate and attributive — 与我想的相反 · 朝相反的方向走 · 恰恰相反. 反而 does the job inside a sentence.
The general measure: 水/房间/烤箱的温度 · 温度计 thermometer · 调温度. Outdoor weather takes 气温, a body 体温. Figurative 有温度 = warm-hearted.
Separable and deliberately vague: 出去办点事 run an errand · 办完事就回来. Judging someone: 办事认真/靠谱 · 办事效率. 办事处 is a branch office; 办公 is office work.
Both directions: 我今天很无聊 I'm bored, 这本书很无聊 it's boring. Of a person's behavior it means 'don't be daft' — 你真无聊 · 无聊的玩笑. 没意思 is softer.
Fail to catch: 错过班车/机会/末班地铁 · 错过了就没有了 · 千万别错过. Missing a person is 想念/想; arriving late is 迟到; skipping over something is 漏掉.
Adverb before the verb, often with 会: 偶尔会去爬山 · 偶尔喝点酒. Rarer than 有时候. For 'by chance, accidental' switch to 偶然 — 偶然发现 · 偶然的机会.
Clause frame with 再/就 in the main clause: 等到饭做好了，你再叫大家 · 等到那时就晚了. Plain 等 can do the same job; 到时候 picks the moment up afterwards.
Charitable kindness, not romance: 有爱心 · 献爱心 donate · 爱心人士 · 爱心捐款. Of a person it is a standing quality — 她很有爱心. Romantic love is 爱情.
Separable: 停一下车 · 车停好了. Covers parking and pulling up: 停车场 car park · 停车位 · 禁止停车 · 靠边停车 pull over.
Your view or notion: 说说你的想法 · 改变想法 · 有想法 (also 'has ambition'). 主意 is a concrete plan you propose — 出个主意 · 好主意; 意见 is formal, often a complaint.
For hypotheticals you would rather avoid: 万一下雨呢 · 万一他不来怎么办. As a noun in 以防万一 just in case · 有个万一. 要是/如果 are neutral; 万一 carries the worry.
Noun: 达到/符合标准 · 制定标准 · 高标准. Also adjective 'textbook-perfect': 标准答案 · 普通话很标准 · 动作很标准. 水平 is the level reached; 规定 the rule laid down.
Confirms what you had predicted: 我就知道会下雨，果然下了 · 他果然来了 · 果然不出所料. The expectation must be on the table first. 居然/竟然 mark the opposite surprise.
完美的计划/结局 · 完美结合 · 追求完美 · 完美主义者 perfectionist · 不完美. It is flawlessness, not wholeness — that is 完整 (完整的一套); 完全 is the adverb.
Takes a noun or a whole clause: 强调纪律 · 他强调（说）我们必须准时 · 强调…的重要性 · 一再/反复强调. 重视 is valuing something highly rather than saying so.
Verb takes a whole clause: 公司规定不能迟到 · 法律规定…. Noun: 按照/根据规定 · 违反规定 · 有明文规定. 规则 is a game's rules; 制度 the institutional setup.
Job interviews only — a journalist's is 采访. 参加/通过面试 · 去一家公司面试 · 面试官 · 电话面试/终面. 笔试 is the written test alongside it.
Adjective and noun both: 他很自信 · 充满自信 · 缺乏自信 · 自信心 · 自信能完成. Confidence in something outside you is 信心 with 对 — 我对他有信心.
The system in the abstract: 语言能力/环境/天赋 · 肢体语言 body language · 编程语言 · 几种语言. A named one takes 语/文 — 汉语 · 英文; a spoken variety 话 (上海话).
Usually 有/没有必要 + verb: 没必要生气 · 有必要说清楚. Attributive: 必要的准备/条件 · 不必要的麻烦 · 必要时 if need be. 需要 is what someone needs.
Polite address opening a speech or email: 各位，欢迎… · 各位来宾/同事/朋友 · 各位好. It addresses those present; 大家 is neutral and works in the third person too.
People watching — TV, sport, theatre: 现场观众 · 观众席 · 电视观众 · 观众反响热烈. Listeners are 听众, readers 读者; onlookers 围观群众.
Object is a state you hold steady: 保持安静/清洁/冷静/距离 · 保持联系 keep in touch · 保持健康. 维持 keeps something barely going (维持秩序); 保留 reserves or holds back.
目的是 + verb phrase: 来的目的是了解市场 · 达到目的 · 别有目的 ulterior motive · 目的地 destination. 目标 is the target you aim at (定目标); 意义 is significance.
Organizational insides more than physical ones: 公司内部 · 内部消息/资料/矛盾 · 内部处理 handled in-house. A box's inside is 里面; 外部 is the counterpart.
Adverb before the verb: 他们同时走了. Frames 在…的同时 while doing X · 与此同时 meanwhile. As a connector 同时(也) adds a further point rather than marking simultaneity.
Physical and abstract both: 菜市场 · 市场经济 · 市场份额 market share · 开拓市场 · 这产品很有市场 there's demand for it. A shopping mall is 商场.
对 X 有信心: 我对你有信心 · 对未来充满信心 · 增强/失去信心 · 必胜的信心. 自信 is self-confidence as a trait; 相信 is believing a claim.
有能力 + verb: 有能力完成 · 工作/学习/沟通能力 · 能力强 · 提高能力 · 能力范围之内. 水平 is the level reached; 本事 the colloquial 'what you can pull off'.
对…公平: 这样对他不公平 · 公平竞争/交易 · 公平对待 · 不公平. 平等 is equality of status (男女平等); 公正 is impartiality in judgment (公正判决).
For traditions, buildings, civilizations — things that have lasted: 古老的传说/民族/建筑/文明. An old person is 年老/上了年纪; 古代 means 'in antiquity'.
Literal: 地下室 basement · 地下停车场 · 地下水 · 地下管道. Figurative 'covert': 地下工作/组织 · 地下乐队. 地上 is the counterpart; 底下 is 'underneath' something.
Object is something formulated: 提出建议/意见/要求/问题/申请/方案 · 提出批评. Casually bringing a topic up is 提到/说起; submitting a document is 提交.
Separable, and the partner takes 跟/和: 跟你分手 · 他们分手了 · 分了手. Also plain 'part ways' with companions. Marriage ends in 离婚; blunt slang 甩了.
The technique for doing something: 学习/减肥方法 · 用什么方法 · 方法不对 · 教学方法. 办法 is the fix for a problem — 想办法 · 没办法; 方式 is the manner (生活方式).
做手术 covers both having one and performing it — context decides; 动手术 likewise. 接受手术 undergo (formal) · 手术室 · 大/小手术 · 手术很顺利. Colloquially 开刀.
对 X 有好处: 多劳动对身体有好处 · 有什么好处？ Also a payoff — 拿好处 · 好处费 kickback. 坏处 is the counterpart; 优点 is a merit; 利益 formal interests.
Adverb before the verb, at home with negation: 永远不会忘记 · 永远不分离 · 永远记得你. Attributive with 的 — 永远的痛. A stretch that actually ran takes 一直.
有特点 = has something distinctive about it (他写的字很有特点) · 主要特点是… · 抓住特点. 特色 is a flavor you'd advertise — 地方特色 · 特色菜; 优点 a virtue, 缺点 a flaw.
Reading trap: 重 = chóng here. Redoing from scratch, often because the first try failed: 重新开始/考虑/安排 · 重新做一遍. 再 sets up a future repeat, 又 reports a past one.
Two senses: someone's course of action, usually judged — 我不同意他的做法 · 这种做法不妥; and how a dish is made — 红烧肉的做法. 方法 is the neutral technique.
Office document and computer file both: 打开/保存/上传/发送文件 · 文件夹 folder · 一份文件. Officialdom: 下发文件 · 红头文件. 资料 is material; 档案 the archive.
Attributive with or without 的: 同样的错误 · 同样(的)问题. Also an adverb 'likewise' before the verb — 我同样不同意 · 他同样也来了. Comparisons use 一样 — 跟他一样.
Head hair only — body hair is 毛 (眉毛 · 汗毛). 剪/洗/吹/染头发 · 掉头发 · 一根头发 · 头发干了. 发 alone shows up in 理发 · 发型 · 白发.
A writer by vocation: 当作家 · 著名作家 · 青年作家 · 作家协会. 作者 is whoever wrote this particular text; 记者 reports, 编辑 edits, 写手 writes for hire.
Bringing a topic into the conversation: 老师提到了一本书 · 刚才提到过 · 一提到他就…. 提起 is the near-identical alternative; 提出 formally puts a proposal forward.
朝/往那个方向走 · 方向感 sense of direction · 迷失方向 · 指明方向. Figurative uses abound: 努力的方向 · 研究方向 one's research area · 方向盘 steering wheel.
Goes straight onto the noun, no 的 needed: 各种问题/原因/颜色 · 各种各样的书. 各 distributes one by one (各位 · 各国); 每 iterates; 所有 is 'all of them' as a set.
The neutral cover term; in speech people often say 爸妈: 我爸妈都退休了. 为人父母 being a parent · 父母双方 both parents · 父母亲 (formal) · 单亲家庭.
Usually adverbial before the verb: 主动帮忙 · 主动联系我 reach out first · 主动承认. Opposite 被动 · 主动权 the initiative (掌握主动权) · 化被动为主动.
A piece of news, or word reaching you: 听到消息 · 得到消息 · 有他的消息 word from him · 好/坏消息 · 消息灵通 well-informed. 新闻 is the news story as reported.
Takes a whole clause: 发现他不在了 notice that… It's coming upon something; 找到 is finding what you were looking for. Also a noun: 新发现 · 重大发现.
把重点放在…上 put the emphasis on · 突出重点 · 重点是… Also attributive and adverbial: 重点大学 key (elite) university · 重点介绍 focus on covering.
Separable in the fuel sense: 加了油 · 加满油. As a cheer it's intransitive — 给他加油 / 为他加油 cheer him on, not 加油他. 加油站 · 加把油 put in more effort.
一定要 must · 一定会 surely will. Note 不一定 = not necessarily, while 一定不 = definitely won't. Attributive it means 'a certain, given': 在一定程度上 · 一定的基础.
Before the verb or the number: 至少要三天 · 他至少四十岁了. 起码 is the colloquial equivalent; 最少 is the superlative 'the fewest'. Concessive: 至少他来了.
The designated spot in a plan or record: 时间和地点 · 集合地点 · 考试地点 · 出事地点. 地方 is the everyday general word ('somewhere', and also 'room').
处 is chǔ here (cf. chù in 到处/办事处). 处理问题/文件/投诉 · 处理不当 mishandle · 进行处理. Also 'clear out cheap': 降价处理 · 处理品 discounted seconds.
量体重 / 称体重 weigh yourself · 控制体重 · 减轻体重 · 体重增加/下降 · 体重超标 over a healthy weight. The scale itself is 体重秤/称.
晒太阳 bask in the sun · 出太阳 the sun's out · 太阳落山. In everyday speech it also stands for the sunshine itself: 今天太阳很大 it's blazing.
Attributive 'personal, one's own': 个人意见 · 个人隐私 · 个人简历. After a pronoun it means 'personally': 我个人认为. 私人 is private as opposed to public (私人时间).
在…身边 at one's side, and figuratively the people around one: 身边的人/朋友 · 留在身边 · 带在身边. Also 'on one': 我身边没带钱 I've no cash on me.
Attributive, needing no further measure word: 各个部门 · 各个方面. In writing terse 各 + noun is often preferred: 各国 · 各方. Set phrase 各个击破 beat them one by one.
Separable — the person goes in a 跟/和 phrase, never after the verb: 跟他见面 · 和朋友约在这里见面 · 见过一面 · 见了一次面 · 好久没见面了.
A named age with a character of its own: 信息时代 · 新时代 · 时代变了 · 跟上时代. 时期 is a phase (困难时期), 年代 a decade (八十年代), 时候 plain 'when'.
Respectful and neutral, for people: 奶奶去世了 · 去世多年. 过世 sits at the same level; 逝世 is reserved for eminent figures; 死 is blunt and is what you use for animals.
Becoming a member: 加入球队/公司/工会/微信群. Taking part in an event is 参加: 参加会议/婚礼/比赛. Also the literal 'add in': 加入少量盐 · 加入新元素.
Two jobs: attributive 'former, original' — 原来的计划 · 恢复到原来的状态; and the mirative 'oh, so…' on discovery — 原来是你！· 原来他早就知道了. Often with 怪不得.
Nature itself is 大自然; bare 自然 as a noun is mostly attributive: 自然风景/资源/现象. Adverb 'as a matter of course': 努力了自然会有结果. 不自然 = stiff, awkward.
The institutional cover term for a workforce: 公司员工 · 员工培训/福利 · 老员工. Counted with 名: 三名员工. 职员 is office staff; 工人 manual workers.
The formal, category-level word: 职场女性 · 女性用品 · 女性主义 · 中年女性. 女的 is the colloquial 'a woman'; 妇女 is the official/administrative term (三八妇女节).
Beyond arithmetic it's a connective 'and on top of that': 工作忙，加上身体不好，就没去. Often 再加上. As a verb the thing added follows: 加上一句话 · 加上盐.
The verb takes a whole clause: 证明他没说谎 · 事实证明… As a noun it's a document that gets issued: 开一张证明 · 收入证明 · 身份证明.
Anaphoric — it points back to a time already established in the context: 当时我不在 · 当时的情况. 那时候 does the same job more colloquially; 当年 = back in those years.
Takes abstract levels: 提高水平/效率/质量/警惕/收入. Physical lifting is 抬高/举起. 改善 for conditions (改善生活), 增加 for amounts, 提升 is the formal cousin.
Abstract objects only — effects and feelings: 产生影响/兴趣/矛盾/误会/怀疑. Making goods is the same characters reversed, 生产: 工厂生产产品.
Interchangeable with 怎么样, a shade more written. Also a manner adverbial before the verb: 不知该怎样做 · 怎样才能… Predicate: 你最近过得怎样？
Always includes the listener — that is the whole point (我们 may exclude them). Northern and colloquial; southern speakers just say 我们. 咱 alone can mean 'I' up north.
Something comes into view or into existence: 出现问题/错误/新情况 · 屏幕上出现… 发生 overlaps here (发生问题 is fine) but leans to events happening.
'In the world' needs 上: 世界上最高的山 · 世界上没有… Also 全世界 · 世界各地 · 世界观 worldview · 世界杯. Someone's private world is 内心世界.
出生于1990年 (written) · 出生在北京 · 出生率. Keep clear of 出身 chūshēn, which is family or social origin: 出身农民家庭 · 出身贫寒.
Homophone trap: 心理 = the mind as an object of study (心理学 · 心理医生 · 心理压力) vs 心里 = inside one's heart (心里想 · 心里难过). 心理作用 = it's all in your head.
点外卖 / 叫外卖 order in · 送外卖 deliver · 吃外卖 · 外卖员/外卖小哥 the rider · 外卖平台. In Taiwan the same service is 外送.
Takes a full clause and states a considered judgement: 我认为这样不行. 觉得 is softer and more subjective; 以为 implies you were wrong. 被认为是… is regarded as.
Enumerates: 首先…其次…最后. Also 'be the first to' before a verb: 首先发言 · 首先要考虑安全. For plain 'do X then Y' sequencing use 先…再…: 先洗手再吃饭.
Attributive (主要原因/内容/问题) or adverbial (主要是因为… · 我主要负责…). It rarely takes 很; as a predicate it shows up as 主要是…: 主要是钱的问题.
Covers fiction generally, not just novels: 长篇/中篇/短篇小说 · 科幻小说 · 武侠小说. Counted 一本/一部. Reading fiction is 看小说 rather than 读.
先…然后… sequences steps in any tense, plans included. 后来 narrates only what already happened. In casual speech 然后 also just chains one sentence to the next.
Colloquial: 玩得很开心 have fun · 开开心心 · 不开心. 高兴 works in writing too and can mean 'willing' (我不高兴去). 拿他开心 = have fun at his expense.
Intransitive — the place goes in a 从/向 phrase: 从北京出发 · 向山顶出发. Figuratively 'take as one's starting point': 从实际出发 · 出发点 motive, premise.
在…中间 in the middle of, or among: 坐在中间 · 在两座山中间 · 中间人 go-between. 之间 is the written 'between' and needs two items (朋友之间); 中心 is the center point (市中心).
Two jobs: adjective 'nothing special' (很平常的事 · 平常心 an even keel) and adverb 'ordinarily' (平常我不喝酒). 平时 covers only that adverb sense.
Reading trap: dìfang 'a place' vs dìfāng 'local, as against central' — 地方政府 · 地方话. Also 'room': 没地方坐; and 'the part/aspect': 这是我佩服他的地方.
As much a noun as an adjective: 注意安全 · 保证安全 · 安全第一 · 安全感 sense of security · 安全带/安全出口. 平安 is 'safe and sound' about a person (一路平安).
Order flips the meaning: 完全不同意 = not at all vs 不完全同意 = not entirely. Modifies verbs and adjectives: 完全黑了 · 完全正确 · 完全可以 · 完全没想到.
看样子要下雨了 by the look of it · 一副很累的样子 wearing a look of… · 装样子 put on a show · 别这个样子. Also the style/design of a thing: 这双鞋的样子.
对…的看法 one's view on · 谈谈你的看法 · 改变看法. Watch out: 对他有看法 means having a gripe with him, not merely an opinion — 意见 doubles the same way.
Pattern 把A当作B: 把他当作真正的朋友 · 别把我的话当作耳边风. 当 is dàng here, not dāng. 当成 is the colloquial twin; 看作 the more written one.
Last in a sequence, noun or adverb: 最后一次 · 排在最后 · 最后他还是走了 · 到最后. 终于 is 'at last, after all the waiting' (终于到了); 最终 is the formal 'ultimately'.
Size as a dimension, from an antonym pair: 大小合适 · 一样大小 · 看看大小. Numbered sizes are 号/尺码. Set phrase 没大没小 = showing no respect for one's elders.
Stands alone as a reply: 当然可以！· 当然了. Also concessive in argument: 当然，这也有风险，但… Set phrase 理所当然 as a matter of course · 想当然 take for granted.
Abstract targets: 达到目的/目标/标准/水平/要求 · 达到…的程度. Arriving somewhere physically is the reverse compound 到达: 到达山顶.
Past narration only — 'and then, later on': 后来他就走了 · 后来怎么样了？Future sequencing uses 以后/然后: 以后再说. 后来居上 the latecomer overtakes.
Describes the thing that frightens, never your own feeling — being scared is 害怕/怕: 可怕的后果 · 太可怕了. 恐怖 is stronger and more graphic (恐怖片, 恐怖分子).
做作业 / 写作业 · 交作业 hand in · 布置作业 assign · 批作业 grade. In technical registers it's an operation or task: 高空作业 · 作业区.
Also a resultative complement: 说明白 make it clear · 想明白 figure out · 听明白了. 懂 is knowing a subject or language (懂中文); 明白 is grasping what's being said.
Also the technical antonym of 先天: 后天的努力 · 后天因素 acquired rather than innate. Time series: 前天·昨天·今天·明天·后天·大后天.
Also a warning that takes an object: 小心车 · 小心地滑 · 小心别摔了 — 'watch out for' rather than just 'be careful'. 小心翼翼 gingerly. Being meticulous is 细心.
Rated 高/低: 水平很高 · 提高水平 · 水平有限. 生活水平 standard of living · 汉语水平考试. The literal 'horizontal' survives in 水平线 · 水平方向.
Both a guest at home and a customer in a shop: 家里来客人了 · 招待客人. 顾客 is the commercial customer proper, 客户 a client or account, 乘客 a passenger.
Adverbial 'officially': 正式开始/成立/宣布. Attributive: 正式场合 · 正式文件 · 正式员工 = a permanent (not temporary) employee. Opposite 非正式/随便.
About how often something turns up: 常见的错误/疾病/问题 · 这种情况很常见. 'Ordinary, run-of-the-mill' is 普通; 常见 is specifically 'often encountered'.
对…有用 useful for: 这本书对我很有用. The negative is 没用, which of a person means hopeless: 你真没用 · 说了也没用 it's no use saying it.
Beyond 'the best', it is the everyday 'had better': 你最好早点去 · 最好别告诉他 — sitting before the verb. 还是…吧 is the softer way to give the same advice.
Slightly formal — announcements and writing: 到达北京 · 准时到达 · 到达时间/大厅. Everyday speech just uses 到: 我到了. Abstract goals take 达到 instead.
有个性 means distinctive, one's own person (and can be a mild dig: 太有个性了). The neutral 'temperament' is 性格: 性格开朗. 个性化 personalized.
Both 'split them up' and 'part ways': 把两个人分开 · 他们分开很久了 (a couple). 分开付 pay separately · 分开住. As a complement: 分得开 · 分不开.
只要…就… a sufficient condition: 只要不下雨就行. Contrast 只有…才… the necessary one: 只有努力才能成功. It can also trail the main clause: 我去，只要你也去.
Written and forward-looking: 未来五年 · 未来一周 · 未来的世界 · 有未来. 将来 is the everyday 'in future' about one's own life (将来想做什么); 以后 is plain 'afterwards'.
One 公斤 = two 斤, and market prices are almost always quoted per 斤 (500 g): 苹果多少钱一斤. 千克 is the scientific-register synonym of 公斤.
Takes a noun phrase, usually with a classifier: 成为一名护士 · 成为可能 · 成为朋友. Adjectival change uses 变 (变胖了); 变成 is turning into; 当老师 is the colloquial way to name a job.
Emphatic identity: 我要的就是这个 · 就是他！Concessive 就是…也: 就是下雨我也去 even if. 就是说 that is to say · 好就是好. Sentence-final 就是了 = and that's that.
把A当成B — the colloquial twin of 当作: 把这里当成自己的家 · 别把我当成小孩. 看成 leans to 'mistake for': 我把她看成她姐姐了.
Takes a direct object, no preposition: 关心孩子 · 关心国家大事 · 受到关心. 担心 is worrying something bad will happen; 在乎 is minding whether (我不在乎).
他很有文化 means he is educated and literate, not 'cultured in the arts'; 没文化 = uneducated. Otherwise: 中国文化 · 文化交流 · 文化程度 (schooling level on forms).
Nearly always negated, and the two negatives differ: 从来不说谎 = never does, as a habit; 从来没说过谎 = has never done, needing 过. 从来如此 is about the only common positive.
The written medium as against speech: 文字材料 · 文字说明 caption · 文字工作 editorial work · 文字游戏 wordplay. Individual characters are 汉字/字; a language is 语言.
对…放心 feel easy about: 妈妈对我不放心. Separable: 放心不下他 · 放得下心. Common as reassurance: 你放心吧 · 放一百个心. Opposite of 担心.
The purpose clause comes first: 为了健康，她锻炼身体. To put purpose after the verb, use 是为了…: 我这么做是为了你. Causes take 因为; in writing 为了…而…
Pairs with 出口 exit — but mind the trade senses of the same words: 进口 = import, 出口 = export. 入口处 at the entrance · 地铁入口 · 网站入口 portal.
Of systems and regions rather than careers: 经济/工业/交通发达 · 发达国家. Of the body it means well-developed: 肌肉发达 · 四肢发达，头脑简单 all brawn, no brains.
You 骑 a bike, never 开: 骑自行车去 · 骑车. 单车 is the southern word, 脚踏车 Taiwanese. 自行车道 bike lane · 共享单车 shared bikes.
The event follows the verb: 发生了一起事故 · 发生了什么事？Abstract events only — 发生变化/战争/矛盾/关系. A scheduled event 'taking place' is 举行: 会议在北京举行.
Takes a person or a whole clause: 相信他 · 相信他会成功 · 我有理由相信… Bare 信 is the colloquial version and carries the religious sense (信基督教); 信任 is standing trust.
Two uses: 'fits exactly' — 时间正好 · 这双鞋正好; and the coincidence adverb 'as it happens' — 我正好路过 · 你来得正好. 刚好 is an exact synonym, a touch more colloquial.
The mode or manner of doing something: 生活方式 · 思维方式 · 付款方式 · 以…的方式. 方法 is a technique for a task (学习方法); 办法 is the colloquial 'a way out' (没办法).
The everyday word, predicate or attributive: 他很有名 · 有名的餐厅. 著名 is written and almost always attributive (著名作家). 出名 is the verb 'become famous': 一夜出名.
Also a preposition of process: 经过三年的努力，他成功了 · 经过讨论. And a noun, the course of events: 说说事情的经过. As a verb the place follows directly: 经过学校门口.
A written-register 很: 十分感谢 · 十分重要 · 十分满意. Rare in casual speech, where 很/特别/非常 do the work. Distinct from the literal 十分 'ten points'.
在…方面 in the area of: 在学习方面. Balanced pair 一方面…另一方面… on one hand… on the other · 各方面 · 方方面面. Sides in a dispute use bare 方: 双方 · 我方.
Functioning as it should: 一切正常 · 恢复正常 · 正常工作/运转 · 不正常. 平常 is 'ordinary, nothing special'; 正规 is 'proper, by the book' (正规医院).
Takes an object or a whole clause: 担心孩子 · 担心他会出事. Mildly separable: 担什么心 · 别担这个心. 为…担心 worry on someone's behalf. Opposite 放心.
有/没有机会 · 抓住机会 seize · 错过机会 miss · 趁这个机会 take the chance to · 机会难得. Counted with 个. 机遇 is the loftier 'break in life'.
Double-object: 推荐我参加比赛 · 给你推荐一本书 · 把他推荐给公司. 推荐信 letter of recommendation · 推荐人 referee · 值得推荐. 介绍 is introducing, not endorsing.
Written and impersonal — rules, ethics, legal text: 尊重他人 · 关心他人 · 不得损害他人利益. In speech it's 别人; 人家 is the colloquial 'other people' with attitude.
Beyond the school subject, 地理位置 is the everyday way to say 'location': 地理位置很好 · 地理环境 · 地理条件. Terrain proper is 地形.
Predicate ('is online now'): 他现在在线; and attributive: 在线教育/支付/客服. 上线 is going live or logging on; 网上 is the general 'on the internet': 网上买的.
Formal and technical; in speech people just say 删: 删了吧 · 把他删了 unfriend him. 删除文件/记录/评论 · 删除键. 取消 is cancelling, not deleting.
The block is counted 栋/幢, a flat inside it 套: 一套公寓. In speech one's own flat is just 家/房子; 公寓楼 · 单元 is the stairwell number in an address.
Category-level and a bit written — geography and environment: 河流污染 · 众多河流 · 保护河流. Naming an actual one, people say 河/江: 门前那条河 · 长江.
创造奇迹 work wonders · 出现奇迹 · 生命的奇迹 · 七大奇迹. The adverb needs 般地: 奇迹般地康复. It's secular — a religious miracle is 神迹.
Takes a verb phrase or a noun directly: 擅长滑雪 · 擅长交际 · 不擅长数学. Written register; 拿手 is the colloquial twin (拿手菜 signature dish), 善于 the formal synonym.
摆姿势 strike a pose · 姿势正确/不对 · 保持这个姿势 · 睡姿. Physical only — a stance in an argument is 立场/态度, and 姿态 is the figurative posture (高姿态).
The level of schooling on a CV: 大学以上学历 · 高学历 · 学历要求. 学位 is the degree itself (硕士学位) — Chinese forms list the two separately.
Chiefly in the proper names of towers: 国贸大厦 · 写字楼. 厦 is shà here (though 厦门 is Xiàmén). Counted 栋/座. A residential high-rise is 高楼/楼房.
浏览网页/新闻/资料 · 浏览器 web browser · 浏览量 page views. It's skimming, so it pairs with 一下/一遍: 大致浏览了一遍. Close reading is 细读/仔细看.
Both a person's palate — 合我的口味 · 各人口味不同 — and how strongly a dish is seasoned: 口味重/清淡. 味道 is the flavour the food actually has: 味道不错.
Said straight to the person: 恭喜你 · 恭喜恭喜 · 恭喜发财. 祝贺 is the written/formal 'congratulate' (祝贺大会召开), and 贺 gives 贺卡 · 贺电.
受到/获得好评 · 广受好评 well received · 五星好评. Its opposite 差评 is the everyday e-commerce word: 给了个差评. 评价 is the neutral 'evaluation'.
Written register, and 于 must be followed by what is helped: 有助于健康 · 有助于提高效率. Everyday equivalent 对…有帮助 / 有好处. Negative form 无助于.
Written; introduces the means, then the achievement: 凭借努力考上大学 · 凭借经验. Speech uses 靠: 靠自己. Bare 凭 also works: 凭什么 · 凭本事.
对…有益 good for: 对身体有益 · 有益健康. Written — speech says 对…好 / 有好处. Attributive: 有益的经验 · 有益无害. Opposite 有害.
Collective — trees as a mass: 树木茂盛 · 种植树木 · 保护树木. A single one is 一棵树, not 一棵树木. Same collective pattern as 车辆 · 书籍 · 人口.
Practically fixed to heritage: 历史悠久 · 悠久的文化/传统. A long-lasting relationship or effect takes 长久 instead: 长久的友谊. 源远流长 is its literary partner.
Commercial register — the listed price of goods: 售价六百块 · 原售价. Asking in a shop is 多少钱; 价格 is the neutral 'price', 价钱 the colloquial one, 定价 the price as set.
Verb pattern 用A比喻B: 用蜜蜂比喻勤劳的人. As a noun: 这是个比喻 · 比喻手法 · 打比喻. In speech 打个比方 (make an analogy) uses 比方, not 比喻.
Scientific register: 昆虫学 · 昆虫标本 · 昆虫世界. Everyday speech says 虫子 for any bug: 有只虫子. Counted with 只.
Written register — reports and notices: 丢失物品 · 数据丢失 · 财物丢失. In speech it's plain 丢: 钱包丢了 · 把钥匙丢了. 丢 alone also means throw away (丢垃圾).
More descriptive than 忙: 忙碌的一天 · 忙碌的身影. It also works as a verb, 'bustle about': 为家人忙碌了一辈子. To say you're busy right now, people say 我很忙.
把…存放在… leave something somewhere for keeping: 行李存放处 · 存放贵重物品. 存 alone covers money in a bank (存钱); 保存 is preserving so it doesn't spoil.
Mostly nominal in practice: 住宿费 · 提供住宿 · 安排住宿. As a verb it means boarding: 学生在校住宿. The place you stay goes with plain 住: 住酒店.
Of objects and products: 外形设计 · 外形美观 · 外形相似. A person's looks are 外表/长相; a purely geometric shape is 形状.
Abstract objects: 加深理解/印象/感情/矛盾 · 加深对他的了解. Also intransitive: 危机不断加深 · 颜色加深. Digging something deeper is 挖深.
Written and newsy: 灾区急需食物 · 急需资金/人才. Also attributive: 急需的药品. Everyday urgency is 急着要 / 马上要: 我急着要用.
往返于A和B之间 shuttle between · 往返票 return ticket · 往返时间. Formal; the colloquial 'there and back' is 来回: 来回两小时 · 来回跑.
The verb is 打: 打折扣 · 打八折 = 20% off (the number is the fraction you pay). Figurative: 执行时打了折扣 done half-heartedly · 不打折扣 without compromise.
叫救护车 is how you call one — 快叫救护车！In mainland China you dial 120 for it (110 police, 119 fire). 救护车赶到 · 送上救护车.
Sentence-initial, for dismay or surprise: 哎呀，忘带钥匙了！哎哟 is for physical pain, 唉 (āi) the resigned sigh, and bare 哎 hails someone.
Used as a verb about a given night: 昨晚又失眠了 · 经常失眠. The condition is 失眠症. The everyday way to say you can't drop off is 睡不着.
Weather forecasts: 明天继续升温. Figuratively 'heat up', common in news: 房市升温 · 关系持续升温. Opposite 降温, which also means a craze cooling off.
The southern word for the mother's mother; northerners say 姥姥. Written/formal 外祖母. Her husband is 外公. Your father's mother is 奶奶.
Part of the set 亲情 (family) · 友情 (friends) · 爱情 (romantic). Abstract and a bit literary: 重视亲情 · 亲情割不断. Feelings toward one particular relative are 感情.
Both a noun and a separable verb: 我们合个影 · 合张影 · 合影留念 · 一张合影. The other party joins with 跟/和: 跟老师合影.
The southern counterpart of northern 姥爷; written/formal 外祖父. Paired with 外婆. Your father's father is 爷爷 — the 外 marks the mother's side.
Everyday speech uses bare 汗: 出汗 · 流汗 · 满头大汗 · 一身汗. 汗水 is the fuller, more literary form and carries the toil metaphor: 汗水换来的成绩.
Northern and colloquial (Beijing) for the mother's mother; southerners say 外婆. Second syllable neutral (lǎolao). Her husband is 姥爷.
Intransitive and one-sided — the person who lost out: 他失恋了 · 失恋以后. The couple's act of splitting is 分手 (跟他分手了); ending a marriage is 离婚.
The starch part of a meal, as against the 菜 dishes: 主食是米饭还是面条？· 少吃主食. Restaurants ask 主食要什么. Its counterpart is 副食.
Form-filling register, and specifically where a person lives: 填写住址 · 家庭住址. The general word for any address — shop, website, email — is 地址: 邮箱地址.
看急诊 go to the ER · 挂急诊 register for it · 急诊科/急诊室 · 急诊病人. Ordinary by-appointment care is 门诊.
You 打太极拳: 每天早上打太极拳. Often shortened to 太极. Figuratively 打太极 = to deflect and stall instead of answering: 他跟我打太极.
The verb is 画: 画国画 · 学国画. Full form 中国画; the medium is 水墨. It contrasts with 油画 oil painting. A practitioner is 国画家.
A four-character predicate for programmes, activities, and life: 活动丰富多彩 · 生活丰富多彩 · 丰富多彩的文化. Objects in many colours are 五颜六色 instead.
The verb is 逛 — you stroll it: 晚上去逛夜市. Same 逛 as 逛街 · 逛超市. What you eat there is 小吃.
Two lives: the school eraser (用橡皮擦掉) and rubber as a material in compounds — 橡皮筋 rubber band · 橡皮艇/筏 dinghy · 橡皮手套. Industrial rubber is 橡胶.
Separable: 挂个号 · 挂了专家号 · 挂错科了 — the first step at a Chinese hospital, before seeing a doctor. Also postal: 挂号信 registered mail.
A verb-object pair like 下雨, so it splits: 刮大风 · 刮了一夜的风 · 风刮得很大. As a weather event it needs no subject: 今天刮风了.
保质期三个月 · 过了保质期 expired · 在保质期内. It's the shelf life, not the printed date — that's 生产日期 / 到期日. A goods warranty period is 保修期.
Northern colloquial, paired with 姥姥; southerners say 外公. Second syllable neutral, lǎoye — 老爷 lǎoyé with full tone is a 'master/lord' (老爷车 vintage car).
The candidate's side of 招聘 (the employer's side): 去公司应聘 · 应聘这个职位 · 应聘者 applicant. The interview itself is 面试; submitting an application is 投简历.
Both orders occur: 三十八摄氏度 and 摄氏三十八度. In daily speech people drop it entirely: 今天三十八度. Below zero is 零下五度. Fahrenheit is 华氏度.
Separable, and the everyday form is 举个例子: 我举个例子 · 举几个例子说明. 举例说明 is the set written phrase. The example itself is introduced by 比如/例如.
Literary and descriptive: 夏天的夜晚 · 寂静的夜晚. For appointments and clock time people say 晚上 (晚上八点 · 晚上见); the small hours are 夜里/半夜.
多年的友情 · 深厚的友情. 友谊 is the more formal word and the one used between nations and institutions (友谊赛 friendly match). Set phrase 友情出演 = guest appearance.
停车位 is the full form; 车位 is the slot you rent or buy in a compound: 租个车位 · 没有空车位. The lot itself is 停车场, the act 停车.
The general schedule, and in news the 'timeline': 制定时间表 · 没有时间表. School timetables are 课程表; train and flight ones 时刻表; a meeting agenda 日程.
The tourism-administration word for a managed attraction: 5A级景区 · 景区门票 · 进景区. Scenery itself is 风景/景色; a single spot within it is a 景点.
Marks a second, incidental action: 出去的时候顺便买瓶水 · 顺便问一下 · 顺便说一句 by the way. 顺路 is specifically 'on the way there'; 趁机 is seizing the chance.
The building, and standard in proper names: 国家大剧院 · 人民剧院. Films go in an 电影院. 剧场 is the auditorium itself; a theatre company is 剧团.
A person's trait — attentive to detail: 她做事很细心 · 细心的照顾. 小心 is guarding against danger; 仔细 is the adverb for doing something carefully: 仔细看 · 仔细想想.
Verb and noun both: 咳嗽得厉害 · 咳嗽了一整夜 · 止咳 · 咳嗽药水. Second syllable neutral (késou). A single cough is 咳一声.
The benign kind — admiring envy with no ill will: 我很羡慕你 · 羡慕他有时间. Resentful jealousy is 嫉妒/忌妒. 令人羡慕 enviable · 羡慕不已.
Takes the form or the field as object: 填写表格/申请表/个人信息. In speech just 填: 填一下这张表. 填空 is filling in blanks; 写 alone is plain writing.
Colloquial and northern-flavoured; 手臂 is the neutral written word. Second syllable neutral (gēbo). Counted 条/只. Saying: 胳膊拧不过大腿 — you can't fight power.
Attributive before mass quantities: 少量盐 · 少量资金 · 少量多次. For countable people and things use 少数: 少数人 · 少数民族. Opposite 大量.
Also the figurative one: 站在人生的十字路口. For directions, bare 路口 is what people say: 前面路口右转 · 到路口往左拐.
Airport fixtures: 登机口 gate · 登机牌 boarding pass · 登机时间 · 开始登机. Specifically a plane — boarding a train or bus is 上车, a ship 上船/登船.
Separable: 度了一个星期的假 · 去海边度假. 度假村 resort · 度假胜地. The days off are 假期; 休假 is taking leave from work, 放假 the institution closing.
Technical and anatomical: 人体结构 · 人体器官 · 人体艺术 the nude in art. Your own body and health is 身体: 身体不好 · 锻炼身体.
过 is the verb for marking any occasion: 过节 · 过年 · 过生日 · 过中秋. Separable: 过个好节. Watch the homograph 有过节 = to have bad blood with someone (他俩有过节).
A disposition or a momentary blush: 她很害羞 · 别害羞. 不好意思 is situational embarrassment (and a polite 'sorry to bother you'); 内向 is introverted as a character.
Separable: 跟他打个招呼 · 打了声招呼. Two senses — saying hello, and giving advance notice: 不打招呼就动手 without warning · 事先打个招呼 give a heads-up.
Describes the thing that gets a laugh: 这个笑话很好笑 · 觉得好笑. 可笑 is derisive — absurd, worthy of scorn. A funny person is 幽默; done for laughs is 搞笑.
About how rarely something turns up: 这种情况很少见 · 少见的机会. 罕见 is the formal, stronger word (罕见病). Set phrase 少见多怪 = ignorance makes everything look strange.
挤牙膏 squeeze it out — figuratively, giving up information a bit at a time: 别跟挤牙膏似的. Counted 支/管. The brush is 牙刷, the act 刷牙.
找零钱 give change · 换零钱 break a note · 身上没零钱. The transaction word alone is 找零. Pocket money is a different word, 零花钱.
量体温 / 测体温 take a temperature · 体温计 thermometer · 体温正常/偏高. Running a fever itself is 发烧: 孩子发烧了.
Searching through a source — files, records, a database: 查找资料 · 在文件里查找. Plain 找 is looking for anything (找钥匙); 查 is checking or verifying (查字典 · 查一下).
打乒乓球 — 打 for anything struck with hand or bat (打篮球, but 踢足球). The sport and the ball share the word; the table is 乒乓球台. Shortened to 乒乓.
降低车速 slow down · 车速过快 · 控制车速. The 速 series works the same way: 时速 speed per hour · 限速 speed limit · 加速/减速.
Money given to a child or kept for small purchases: 给零花钱 · 攒零花钱 save it up · 零花钱不够. 零钱 is physically small change — a different word.
The gated residential compound Chinese city life is organized around: 我们小区 · 小区门口 · 小区物业 the management company. A loose 'neighbourhood' is 附近/街区.
Extended family only — parents, siblings and children are 家人, not 亲戚: 远房亲戚 distant relative · 亲戚朋友 · 走亲戚 do the rounds of relatives at New Year.
Counted with 把: 一把钥匙 · 配钥匙 have a copy cut · 钥匙扣 keyring. Second syllable neutral (yàoshi). The lock is 锁: 锁门 · 开锁.
Doubles as a noun, the worries themselves: 有很多烦恼 · 为钱烦恼 · 自寻烦恼 make trouble for oneself. 麻烦 is a practical hassle; bare 烦 = annoyed (我很烦 · 别烦我).
一年四季 means 'all year round', not just 'the four seasons': 一年四季都很热. 四季分明 is the stock phrase for a climate with distinct seasons. Listed as 春夏秋冬.
